title: Radiographer fracture detection with and without AI assistance in prospective emergency department use

zh_title: 急诊科前瞻性使用中放射技师有无AI辅助的骨折检测
summary: 单家急诊科三个月前瞻部署，13名放射技师对2496例检查配对阅片；AI独立敏感性75.6%，辅助后技师准确率由97.6%小幅升至98.0%。
key_points: AI独立敏感性75.6%，细微骨折仅46.2%

reason: 前瞻真实部署、人机对照，但单中心且提升有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems for fracture detection perform strongly in controlled settings, but prospective real-world evidence is limited. In a three-month deployment in one emergency department, thirteen radiographers in a radiographer-led screening programme independently interpreted 2496 consecutive musculoskeletal examinations (one radiographer per examination), reviewed output from a commercial deep-learning system, then recorded a final decision, giving 2496 paired reads against a radiologist reference standard. Standalone AI sensitivity was 75.6%, falling to 46.2% for subtle fractures, below the radiographers’ baseline sensitivity of 91.6%. Radiographers’ baseline accuracy was high (97.6%; specificity 99.0%) and improved modestly with AI assistance (98.0%; exact McNemar p = 0.0064). With AI assistance, radiographers corrected 11 errors and introduced 1, a net gain of 10 cases. Subgroup gains were directionally consistent but not significant after correction. Radiographers changed their decision in only 11 of 729 discordant cases, and most negative interactions were correct AI recommendations not adopted. No or incomplete AI output was returned for 8.8% of acquired examinations. AI assistance delivered a small, selective benefit arising from complementary rather than superior algorithmic performance. Operational reliability proved as consequential as diagnostic accuracy, and behavioural inferences rest on few events. Downstream clinical outcomes were not measured.
zh_abstract: 用于骨折检测的人工智能（AI）系统在受控环境中表现出色，但前瞻性的真实世界证据有限。在一家急诊科为期三个月的部署中，十三名放射技师在由放射技师主导的筛查项目中，独立解读了2496例连续的肌肉骨骼检查（每例检查由一名放射技师解读），随后查看一套商用深度学习系统的输出结果，并记录最终判断，从而获得以放射科医师为参考标准的2496组配对解读。AI单独使用时的敏感度为75.6%，对细微骨折则降至46.2%，低于放射技师91.6%的基线敏感度。放射技师的基线准确度较高（97.6%；特异度99.0%），在AI辅助下略有提高（98.0%；精确McNemar检验 p = 0.0064）。在AI辅助下，放射技师纠正了11处错误，同时引入了1处错误，净增10例。各亚组的获益方向一致，但经校正后均不显著。在729例不一致的病例中，放射技师仅在11例中改变了其判断，且大多数负向交互是未被采纳的正确AI建议。在8.8%的已采集检查中，AI未返回输出或输出不完整。AI辅助带来了小幅且有选择性的获益，其来源是算法与人的表现互补，而非算法本身更优。运行可靠性与诊断准确度同样重要，而关于行为的推论所依据的事件数较少。未测量下游临床结局。

title: An interpretable graph reasoning framework for enhanced diagnosis in fundus fluorescein angiography
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 可解释图推理框架用于荧光素眼底血管造影诊断
summary: 提出FFA-RGNet，建模不同造影期与解剖位置的病灶时序模式；在2651例患者25,312张图像的多中心数据上训练，内部测试F1为95.38%，并报告多中心与前瞻验证表现一致。
key_points: 多中心数据集：2651例患者、25,312张FFA图像
内部测试F1 95.38%，优于九个基线模型

reason: 眼科专科，含多中心与前瞻验证，但样本中等，属值得一看档，眼科方向小幅加分
abstract: Fundus fluorescein angiography (FFA) is the gold standard for diagnosing retinal vascular diseases. However, interpretable artificial intelligence (AI) systems for FFA image analysis that align with clinicians’ reasoning processes and real-world diagnostic workflows remain scarce. In this study, we introduce an interpretable graph reasoning framework, FFA-RGNet, that explicitly models the temporal patterns of fine-grained lesions across imaging phases and anatomical locations for disease diagnosis from sequential FFA images. FFA-RGNet was trained and validated on a large, fine-grained, multi-center dataset consisting of 25,312 FFA images from 2651 patients. FFA-RGNet outperformed nine baseline models on the internal test set, achieving an F1-score of 95.38% (95% CI: 92.24%–97.88%), and demonstrated consistent performance across multi-center and prospective validation datasets. Its diagnostic performance not only surpassed that of ophthalmologists, residents and ophthalmology students, but also improved their diagnostic F1-score by 7.48% to 14.11% when used as an assistive tool. Comprehensive inference analysis further revealed its superior ability to correctly recognize fine-grained semantic entities, and to learn stable, disease-specific graph reasoning patterns aligned with clinical knowledge. These results suggest that FFA-RGNet enables accurate diagnosis with interpretable reasoning progresses, highlighting its strong potential as a reliable AI system for FFA interpretation and clinical decision support.
zh_abstract: 眼底荧光素血管造影（FFA）是诊断视网膜血管疾病的金标准。然而，能够与临床医生的推理过程及真实世界诊断流程相契合、可解释的FFA图像分析人工智能（AI）系统仍然稀缺。在本研究中，我们提出了一种可解释的图推理框架FFA-RGNet，它显式地对跨成像时相和解剖位置的细粒度病灶的时间模式进行建模，用于基于序列FFA图像的疾病诊断。FFA-RGNet在一个大型、细粒度的多中心数据集上进行了训练和验证，该数据集包含来自2651名患者的25,312幅FFA图像。在内部测试集上，FFA-RGNet优于九种基线模型，F1分数达到95.38%（95% CI：92.24%–97.88%），并在多中心和前瞻性验证数据集上表现一致。其诊断性能不仅超过了眼科医生、住院医师和眼科学生，而且作为辅助工具使用时，可使他们的诊断F1分数提高7.48%至14.11%。全面的推理分析进一步揭示，该模型在正确识别细粒度语义实体方面能力更强，并能学习到与临床知识一致的、稳定的、疾病特异性的图推理模式。这些结果表明，FFA-RGNet能够在可解释的推理过程中实现准确诊断，凸显了其作为FFA判读和临床决策支持的可靠AI系统的巨大潜力。

title: Performance of artificial intelligence for fracture detection: an umbrella review and second-order-meta-analysis
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: AI骨折检测性能：伞状综述与二阶meta分析
summary: 纳入50项系统综述/meta分析（涉及387项原始研究），其中21项meta分析进入二阶汇总，AI合并敏感性为0.897（95% CI 0.882–0.911）。
key_points: 已预注册PROSPERO，检索六个数据库至2025年4月

reason: 大规模系统综述类证据汇总，综述类上限6分
abstract: Abstract Fractures affect approximately 178 million people annually, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools for fracture detection are increasingly approved by regulators. We conducted an umbrella review and second-order meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD42024516414), searching six databases to 4/06/2025 for systematic reviews or meta-analyses of AI fracture detection using any imaging modality. Screening, extraction, and quality assessment were performed in duplicate. We assessed review quality using AMSTAR-2, primary-study overlap using corrected covered area, and certainty using GRADE. Fifty reviews were included (25 systematic reviews and 25 meta-analyses; 387 primary studies). Twenty-one meta-analyses (269 primary studies) contributed to second-order meta-analysis, with slight overall overlap (4.31%). Pooled AI sensitivity was 0.897 (95% CI 0.882–0.911; 95% prediction interval 0.753–0.962) and specificity 0.904 (95% CI 0.891–0.916; prediction interval 0.824 to 0.950). Comparative evidence showed no consistent differences for AI, clinicians, and AI-assisted clinicians: however, this data was sparse and inconclusive. No review reported adverse events or other safety outcomes. Certainty was very low/low for almost all outcomes; all meta-analyses were rated critically low/low on AMSTAR-2. Although published estimates suggest high diagnostic accuracy, real-world and comparative performance remain uncertain. Prospective external validation, multi-reader-multi-case studies, and randomised trials are needed before broad clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: 摘要 每年约有1.78亿人受到骨折影响，用于骨折检测的人工智能（AI）工具正越来越多地获得监管机构批准。我们开展了一项伞形综述和二阶荟萃分析（PROSPERO CRD42024516414），检索了六个数据库至2025年6月4日，纳入使用任何影像模态的AI骨折检测的系统综述或荟萃分析。筛选、数据提取和质量评估均由两人独立完成。我们使用AMSTAR-2评估综述质量，使用校正覆盖面积评估原始研究的重叠情况，并使用GRADE评估证据确定性。共纳入50篇综述（25篇系统综述和25篇荟萃分析；387项原始研究）。21篇荟萃分析（269项原始研究）纳入二阶荟萃分析，总体重叠程度轻微（4.31%）。AI的合并敏感度为0.897（95% CI 0.882–0.911；95%预测区间0.753–0.962），特异度为0.904（95% CI 0.891–0.916；预测区间0.824至0.950）。比较性证据显示，AI、临床医生和AI辅助临床医生之间无一致差异，但这些数据稀少且无定论。没有综述报告不良事件或其他安全性结局。几乎所有结局的证据确定性均为极低/低；所有荟萃分析在AMSTAR-2上均被评为极低/低质量。尽管已发表的估计值提示诊断准确度较高，但真实世界表现和比较性表现仍不确定。在广泛临床应用之前，需要开展前瞻性外部验证、多读者多病例研究和随机试验。

abstract: Intraoperative frozen-section diagnosis of central nervous system (CNS) lesions guides surgical decisions but is challenged by artefacts, diagnostic complexity and time constraints. This advantage was retained in the temporal and external test cohorts. We further organized a WHO-aligned diagnostic hierarchy, where FOCUS also outperformed comparator models. title: Scalable drift monitoring in medical imaging AI
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 医学影像AI的可扩展漂移监测
summary: 提出模块化框架MMC+，基于CheXstray的多模态数据一致性做实时漂移检测，可利用基础模型嵌入免去站点专用编码器训练，并用MGH新冠期间数据验证。
key_points: 聚合多数据流，用统计检验或距离度量
利用基础模型嵌入，无需站点特定编码器训练

reason: 部署监测方法有新意，单机构数据验证，属值得一看档
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into clinical medical imaging has advanced diagnostics but also poses challenges in maintaining long-term reliability as input data change. To address this, we present MMC+, a modular framework for scalable drift monitoring that builds on our CheXstray framework for real-time drift detection using multi-modal data concordance (MMC). MMC+ provides a flexible architecture that enables cost-effective continuous performance monitoring in real-world healthcare settings. The framework’s capabilities include aggregating information from multiple data streams using statistical tests or distance metrics, leveraging foundation model embeddings to remove the need for site-specific encoder training, and quantifying uncertainty to better communicate drift significance. Validated with data from Massachusetts General Hospital during the COVID-19 pandemic, MMC+ effectively detects significant data shifts that correlate with performance changes and indicates when AI systems may deviate from acceptable performance bounds. The code for MMC+ is publicly available (Link: https://github.com/FJDorfner/MedImaging-ModelDriftMonitoring/tree/MMC_plus ), promoting broader adoption of AI solutions in clinical settings. Our framework significantly advances drift detection while promoting transparency and collaboration in clinical AI research.
zh_abstract: 将人工智能（AI）整合到临床医学影像中，推动了诊断的进步，但也给在输入数据发生变化时保持长期可靠性带来了挑战。为此，我们提出了MMC+，一种用于可扩展漂移监测的模块化框架，它建立在我们先前用于利用多模态数据一致性（MMC）进行实时漂移检测的CheXstray框架之上。MMC+提供了灵活的架构，可在真实世界医疗环境中实现具有成本效益的持续性能监测。该框架的功能包括：使用统计检验或距离度量整合来自多个数据流的信息；利用基础模型嵌入，无需针对特定机构训练编码器；以及量化不确定性，以便更好地传达漂移的显著性。利用COVID-19大流行期间来自麻省总医院的数据进行验证，MMC+能够有效检测与性能变化相关的显著数据偏移，并提示AI系统何时可能偏离可接受的性能界限。MMC+的代码已公开（链接：https://github.com/FJDorfner/MedImaging-ModelDriftMonitoring/tree/MMC_plus），以促进AI解决方案在临床环境中的更广泛采用。我们的框架显著推进了漂移检测，同时促进了临床AI研究的透明度与协作。

title: Patient-specific rubric-based evaluation of large language models across longitudinal cancer care
zh_title: 基于患者特异性评分细则评估大模型在肿瘤全程照护中的表现
summary: 提出NPC-RubricBench，基于两中心405例鼻咽癌纵向记录，评估30个LLM在六阶段照护中的推理，发现诊断强不代表后续照护强。
key_points: 941个患者阶段单元，17,688条标准
评估30个通用与医学LLM
诊断表现不能迁移到下游照护
reason: 纵向肿瘤LLM基准，两中心，未经评审，偏好上调
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in specialty medicine, yet existing evaluations largely focus on isolated clinical encounters rather than tracking how clinical responsibilities evolve across a longitudinal care pathway. Here we introduce NPC-RubricBench, a phase-aware benchmark for evaluating multistage clinical reasoning across the cancer care continuum, using nasopharyngeal carcinoma as a defined disease context. Curated from longitudinal records of 405 patients across two cancer centers, the benchmark comprises 941 patient-phase units across six sequential care phases and 17,688 patient-specific atomic criteria spanning five evaluation dimensions, with each assessment strictly restricted to decision-time clinical evidence. Evaluating 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs revealed that strong diagnostic performance does not carry over to downstream care. We evaluated 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs, showing that high diagnostic performance did not translate into improved downstream care. Instead, the dominant failure modes reversed across phases. Explicit decision errors dominated anatomical staging at 48.2%, whereas decision omissions dominated initial work-up and post-treatment follow-up at 33.4% and 30.4%, respectively. In the evaluated model set, medically adapted models showed higher omission rates than general-purpose models. Moreover, varying query granularity exposes a critical specification trade-off: broad open-ended requests degrade Decision Quality across all 30 models, while more detailed, checklist-like prompts raise Decision Quality but reduce Evidence Faithfulness and Safety Adherence. Furthermore, NPC-RubricBench demonstrates that static diagnostic benchmarks are insufficient to ensure consistent clinical reliability over time, highlighting the importance of phase-adaptive safeguards in multistage medical AI.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在专科医学中显示出前景，但现有评估主要集中于孤立的临床诊疗环节，而非追踪临床职责如何在纵向诊疗路径中演变。在此，我们提出NPC-RubricBench，这是一个具有阶段感知特性的基准，用于评估贯穿癌症诊疗全程的多阶段临床推理，并以鼻咽癌作为限定的疾病背景。该基准整理自两家癌症中心405例患者的纵向记录，包含涵盖六个连续诊疗阶段的941个患者-阶段单元，以及跨越五个评估维度的17,688条患者特异性原子标准，每项评估严格限定于决策时点可获得的临床证据。对30个通用型和医学专用LLM进行评估发现，较强的诊断性能并不能延续到下游诊疗。我们评估了30个通用型和医学专用LLM，结果显示高诊断性能并未转化为更好的下游诊疗。相反，主要失败模式在各阶段间发生了反转。解剖学分期中以明确的决策错误为主，占48.2%；而初始检查和治疗后随访中则以决策遗漏为主，分别占33.4%和30.4%。在所评估的模型集合中，医学适配模型的遗漏率高于通用型模型。此外，改变提问粒度揭示了一个关键的指令设定权衡：宽泛的开放式请求会使全部30个模型的决策质量（Decision Quality）下降，而更详细、类似清单的提示可提高决策质量，但会降低证据忠实性（Evidence Faithfulness）和安全性依从性（Safety Adherence）。此外，NPC-RubricBench表明，静态诊断基准不足以确保长期一致的临床可靠性，凸显了在多阶段医学AI中采用阶段自适应保障措施的重要性。

title: Synthetic Hospital: An Open, Verifiable, Physician-Validated Longitudinal EHR Benchmark
zh_title: Synthetic Hospital：开放、可验证、经医师验证的纵向EHR基准
summary: 提出完全合成的纵向电子病历基准，含1,268名患者、5,602次就诊，诊断与时序关系均对应标准本体并可溯源。
key_points: 基于公开医学教育材料构建，不含受保护健康信息
事实依据对应ICD-10-CM、SNOMED CT、LOINC
旨在解决真实EHR无法开放共享与缺乏可验证真值的问题
reason: 开放纵向EHR基准，规模中等，预印本
abstract: Frontier language models are rarely used in clinical workflows because the realistic, longitudinal benchmarks needed to develop them are scarce. Real electronic health record (EHR) data cannot be openly shared due to privacy, ethics or data use issues and it does not contain verifiable ground truth since the chart records only reflect what clinicians documented. We introduce Synthetic Hospital, an open, fully synthetic, fact-grounded longitudinal EHR benchmark that resolves the open sharing and verifiable ground truth barriers. Built entirely from public medical-education material with no protected health information, it comprises 1,268 longitudinal patients and 5,602 encounters, where every diagnosis, finding, and temporal relation is grounded in standard ontologies (ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT, LOINC) and with a complete provenance chain back to its source medical education material. Syntheti
zh_abstract: 前沿语言模型很少用于临床工作流程，因为开发它们所需的真实、纵向基准十分稀缺。真实的电子健康记录（EHR）数据由于隐私、伦理或数据使用问题无法公开共享，且由于病历仅反映临床医生的记录内容，其不含可验证的真实标准（ground truth）。我们提出了 Synthetic Hospital，这是一个开放的、完全合成的、基于事实的纵向EHR基准，解决了公开共享和可验证真实标准的障碍。该基准完全由公开的医学教育材料构建，不含受保护的健康信息，包含1,268名纵向患者和5,602次就诊，其中每个诊断、发现和时间关系都以标准本体（ICD-10-CM、SNOMED CT、LOINC）为依据，并具有可追溯至其来源医学教育材料的完整溯源链。Syntheti

title: M4Bench: Evaluating Procedural Specification for Clinical EHR Derivation Agents
zh_title: M4Bench：评估临床EHR变量推导智能体的流程规范
summary: 提出基于MIMIC-IV与eICU的28项临床变量推导任务基准，评估编码智能体及临床医生审核技能的作用。
key_points: 含15个任务族共28项推导任务
技能使奖励较无技能基线提升0.136
规范完整性贡献大部分增益
reason: 新基准、有对照分解，但为预印本且规模小
abstract: Clinical research over electronic health records depends on derived variables whose definitions sit outside the schema, in item codes, time windows, missingness rules, and output-grain choices that change cohorts and downstream conclusions. We introduce M4Bench, 28 clinical derivation tasks across 15 task families on MIMIC-IV and eICU, to test whether AI coding agents can reproduce such derivations and how clinician-reviewed agent skills change their results. Its controls decompose the value of skills into specification completeness, delivery format, and schema familiarity. In a Docker-isolated Codex campaign (GPT 5.4 Mini and GPT 5.5), skills raise reward by 0.136 over the no-skill baseline, with 26 of 28 tasks improving. Specification completeness accounts for most of this gain: on an eight-task control subset, an operational spec alone raises reward by 0.162, and skills add only 0.024
zh_abstract: 基于电子健康记录的临床研究依赖于派生变量，而这些变量的定义不在数据库模式之内，而是体现在项目编码、时间窗、缺失值规则和输出粒度的选择中，这些因素会改变队列并影响下游结论。我们提出了M4Bench，包含MIMIC-IV和eICU上15个任务家族共28项临床派生任务，用以检验AI编码智能体能否复现此类派生，以及经临床医生审核的智能体技能（skills）如何改变其结果。其对照设置将技能的价值分解为规范完整性、交付格式和模式熟悉度。在基于Docker隔离的Codex实验中（GPT 5.4 Mini和GPT 5.5），技能使奖励比无技能基线提高0.136，28项任务中有26项得到改善。规范完整性解释了其中大部分增益：在一个包含八项任务的对照子集中，仅操作性规范即可使奖励提高0.162，而技能仅额外增加0.024

title: A Computationally Efficient Multi-Section Whole Slide Image Analysis for Capturing Prostate Cancer Multifocality in Biochemical Recurrence Prediction
zh_title: 多切片全视野图像分析捕捉前列腺癌多灶性以预测生化复发
summary: 提出高效的多切片WSI框架预测前列腺癌术后生化复发，使用789例患者23,451张切片，风险评分在多变量Cox中保持独立预后价值。
key_points: 通过子采样降低训练与推理成本

abstract: Prostate cancer is among the most frequently diagnosed malignancies in men worldwide. However, precise prediction of biochemical recurrence (BCR) after radical prostatectomy remains challenging. Here, we propose a computationally efficient multi section whole slide image analysis framework designed to capture the whole gland tumor landscape. We curated a large scale dataset comprising 23,451 slides from 789 patients and systematically optimized patch and slide sub sampling to substantially reduce the computational cost of training and inference. Under this efficient configuration, the framework achieved strong predictive performance for 1- and 2-year BCR, with discrimination and clinical net benefit comparable to or exceeding those of established clinical benchmarks. In multivariable Cox proportional hazards analysis, the AI derived risk score remained an independent prognostic factor am
zh_abstract: 前列腺癌是全球男性中最常被诊断的恶性肿瘤之一。然而，精确预测根治性前列腺切除术后的生化复发（BCR）仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一种计算高效的多切片全玻片图像分析框架，旨在捕捉整个腺体的肿瘤全貌。我们整理了一个大规模数据集，包含来自 789 例患者的 23,451 张玻片，并系统优化了图像块和玻片的子采样，从而大幅降低训练和推理的计算成本。在这种高效配置下，该框架对 1 年和 2 年 BCR 取得了出色的预测性能，其区分能力和临床净获益与既有临床基准相当或更优。在多变量 Cox 比例风险分析中，人工智能衍生的风险评分仍是独立的预后因素，

title: AI-guided deep visual proteomics reveals recurrence-associated morpho-molecular signatures within triple-negative breast cancers
zh_title: AI引导的深度视觉蛋白质组学揭示三阴性乳腺癌复发相关形态-分子特征
summary: 用复发风险热图指导组织取样和质谱空间蛋白质组学，在156例三阴性乳腺癌患者中分析高、低风险区域的分子差异。
key_points: 156例患者，高低风险区共存于肿瘤内
从两例复发病例分离46个AI定义区域
高风险区富集有丝分裂程序
reason: 病理AI与蛋白质组学结合、预后相关；仅两例做蛋白质组，预印本
abstract: Outcome informed AI can localize prognostically relevant regions in digital pathology, but directly characterizing the molecular basis of these spatial predictions remains challenging. Here, we developed an outcome informed, AI-guided deep visual proteomics framework that uses recurrence-risk heatmaps to guide physical tissue sampling and mass spectrometry-based spatial proteomics in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). In 156 patients, high- and low-risk regions coexisted within the tumor compartment and showed distinct nuclear and architectural features, indicating intratumoral variation beyond broad tissue identity. Guided by these maps, we physically isolated and profiled 46 AI-defined high- and low-risk tumor regions from two recurrent cases. High-risk regions were enriched for mitotic programs, whereas low-risk regions showed immune- and antigen-presentation-associated programs. W
zh_abstract: 以预后结局为导向的人工智能能够在数字病理中定位与预后相关的区域，但直接刻画这些空间预测背后的分子基础仍具挑战。在此，我们开发了一种以结局为导向、由人工智能引导的深度视觉蛋白质组学（deep visual proteomics）框架，利用复发风险热图指导三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）的组织实物取样及基于质谱的空间蛋白质组学分析。在156例患者中，高风险与低风险区域同时存在于肿瘤区域内，并表现出不同的细胞核和结构特征，提示肿瘤内部存在超出宽泛组织类型之外的异质性。在这些热图的引导下，我们从两例复发病例中物理分离并分析了46个由人工智能界定的高风险和低风险肿瘤区域。高风险区域富集有丝分裂相关程序，而低风险区域则表现出与免疫和抗原提呈相关的程序。W

title: PRISM: Pathology Reliability In Scarce-label Medicine. A Tile-level Benchmark of Pathology Foundation Models
zh_title: PRISM：病理基础模型在稀缺标注下的可靠性基准
summary: 预印本提出切片级基准，从模型选择、标注比例、校准和跨机构迁移评估八个病理基础模型，共864次线性探针实验。

abstract: Pathology foundation models are typically benchmarked on classification performance at full label availability and on in-distribution test sets, while calibration, behavior at low label budgets, and robustness under cross-institutional shift are seldom evaluated jointly. We introduce PRISM, a tile-level benchmark that measures the reliability of pathology foundation models along four axes: model choice, label fraction, calibration, and out-of-distribution transfer. PRISM evaluates eight foundation models (CLIP, PLIP, CONCH, UNI, Virchow2, GigaPath, H-Optimus-0, Midnight) on six tile-level datasets at six label fractions (1% to 100%) with three seeds (864 linear probe runs), extended with a five-hospital Camelyon17 study of 20 directed transfer pairs. zh_abstract: 病理基础模型通常基于完整标签条件下的分类性能和分布内测试集进行基准评测，而校准性、低标注预算下的表现以及跨机构分布偏移下的稳健性很少被联合评估。我们提出 PRISM，这是一个图块级基准，从四个维度衡量病理基础模型的可靠性：模型选择、标签比例、校准和分布外迁移。PRISM 在六个图块级数据集上、以六种标签比例（1% 至 100%）和三个随机种子（共 864 次线性探针运行）评估八种基础模型（CLIP、PLIP、CONCH、UNI、Virchow2、GigaPath、H-Optimus-0、Midnight），并扩展了一项涉及五家医院、20 个有向迁移对的 Camelyon17 研究。出现了四种现象。(i) 在完全监督下，AUROC 排名在各数据集中一致地预测温度缩放后的校准排名（Spea

title: Longitudinal retinal imaging and auxiliary tasks for discrete-time survival prediction of referable diabetic retinopathy and maculopathy: a retrospective cohort study

summary: 预印本回顾性队列研究，在伦敦糖尿病眼筛查数据上，评估多次就诊图像及辅助目标能否改善rDR/rM进展的生存预测。

abstract: Deep learning can predict progression to referable diabetic retinopathy (rDR) and referable maculopathy (rM) from screening photographs, but existing models ignore the prior images that screening programmes hold. We assessed whether multi-visit (MV) images and auxiliary objectives that model the future visit improve prognostic prediction. In this retrospective cohort study of macula-centred photographs from the South-East London Diabetic Eye Screening Programme (UK), eyes without referable disease at baseline and with a follow-up at 20-28 months were split into development (72,559 eyes, 36,648 patients) and test (17,917 eyes, 9,071 patients) sets. A time-aware discrete-time survival model predicted incident rDR (R2 or R3), rM (M1), or either (rDR/rM). We compared baseline-only input with up to three visits (MV), alone or with auxiliary supervision of future-visit age (MV+age) or future-v
zh_abstract: 深度学习可以根据筛查照片预测向可转诊糖尿病视网膜病变（rDR）和可转诊黄斑病变（rM）的进展，但现有模型忽略了筛查项目所保存的既往图像。我们评估了多次就诊（MV）图像以及对未来就诊建模的辅助目标是否能改善预后预测。在这项回顾性队列研究中，我们使用英国东南伦敦糖尿病眼病筛查项目以黄斑为中心的照片，将基线时无可转诊疾病且在20–28个月有随访的眼睛分为开发集（72,559只眼，36,648名患者）和测试集（17,917只眼，9,071名患者）。一个时间感知的离散时间生存模型用于预测新发rDR（R2或R3）、rM（M1）或二者之一（rDR/rM）。我们比较了仅基线输入与最多三次就诊（MV）的输入，单独使用或联合对未来就诊年龄的辅助监督（MV+age）或未来就诊

title: AnyCXR: Human Anatomy Segmentation of Chest X-ray at Any Acquisition Position using Multi-stage Domain Randomized Synthetic Data with Imperfect Annotations and Conditional Joint Annotation Regularization Learning
zh_title: AnyCXR：基于合成数据的任意拍摄角度胸片解剖分割
summary: 仅用由3D CT生成的10万余张合成X线片训练，实现54个解剖结构的多器官分割，并在多个真实数据集上零样本泛化（预印本）。
key_points: 多阶段域随机化生成合成胸片
条件联合标注正则化利用不完整标签

reason: 合成数据加零样本多数据集泛化，有新意，预印本
abstract: Robust anatomical segmentation of chest X-rays (CXRs) remains challenging due to the scarcity of comprehensive annotations and the substantial variability of real-world acquisition conditions. We propose AnyCXR, a unified framework that enables generalizable multi-organ segmentation across arbitrary CXR projection angles using only synthetic supervision. The method combines a Multi-stage Domain Randomization (MSDR) engine, which generates over 100,000 anatomically faithful and highly diverse synthetic radiographs from 3D CT volumes, with a Conditional Joint Annotation Regularization (CAR) learning strategy that leverages partial and imperfect labels by enforcing anatomical consistency in a latent space. Trained entirely on synthetic data, AnyCXR achieves strong zero-shot generalization on multiple real-world datasets, providing accurate delineation of 54 anatomical structures in PA, late
zh_abstract: 由于缺乏全面的标注以及真实采集条件存在很大差异，胸部 X 线片（CXR）的稳健解剖分割仍具挑战。我们提出 AnyCXR，这是一个统一框架，仅使用合成监督即可实现跨任意 CXR 投影角度的可泛化多器官分割。该方法结合了多阶段域随机化（MSDR）引擎与条件联合标注正则化（CAR）学习策略：前者可从三维 CT 容积生成超过 100,000 张解剖学上真实且高度多样的合成 X 线片，后者通过在潜在空间中强制解剖一致性来利用部分且不完美的标签。AnyCXR 完全在合成数据上训练，在多个真实世界数据集上实现了很强的零样本泛化，可在 PA、侧位等投影中准确勾画 54 个解剖结构

title: Identity or Evidence? Auditing Evidence Dependence in Agentic Life-Science Benchmarks

summary: 独立改变实体身份与证据，审计临床结局基准、Biomni和LAB-Bench任务，发现部分题目仅凭名称即可作答，质疑基准是否真正检验证据推理（预印本）。

abstract: Agentic life-science benchmarks give an agent evidence about a named entity and score an answer against a recorded outcome. That score tests reasoning over evidence only if the evidence, rather than the name, determines the answer. We examine this distinction by varying identity and evidence independently on a clinical-outcome benchmark and published tasks from Biomni and LAB-Bench. Blinding identity matters little when a prompt contains a decisive sequence or passage. It matters a great deal when the prompt is mostly a name and candidate list (0.742 named versus 0.082 blinded; chance 0.093). Across 96 LAB-Bench LitQA2 questions, the gap increases under one fixed passage-redaction scheme (+0.000 to +0.135; per-instance slope +0.147, p= 0.004). zh_abstract: 智能体（agentic）生命科学基准会向智能体提供关于某一命名实体的证据，并依据已记录的结果对答案评分。只有当决定答案的是证据而非名称时，该评分才能检验基于证据的推理。我们在一个临床结局基准以及Biomni和LAB-Bench的已发表任务上，独立改变身份信息和证据，以考察这一区别。当提示中包含决定性的序列或段落时，对身份进行盲化影响很小。而当提示主要由名称和候选列表构成时，影响非常大（具名为0.742，盲化后为0.082；随机水平为0.093）。在96道LAB-Bench LitQA2问题中，在同一固定的段落遮蔽方案下，差距增大（+0.000至+0.135；每个实例的斜率为+0.147，p=0.004）。在临床基准上，无证据的回忆探测与预测准确率相当，并能还原出特定数据库的项目计数。因此，我们认为

title: When Rubrics Fail: Hallucinations Reveal Blind Spots in Medical AI Evaluation
zh_title: 评分细则失效：幻觉暴露医学AI评估盲区
summary: 研究发现基于rubric的医学LLM评估常漏掉临床相关幻觉；作者构建幻觉分类体系与临床医生验证的错误注入流程，在HealthBench等基准上检验。

在HealthBench等三个基准上，幻觉常未改变评分

reason: 医学LLM评估方法有新意，经临床医生验证；预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Hallucinations can undermine clinician trust in LLMs, making it important that evaluation methods capture clinically relevant errors. Rubric-based evaluation has become the leading approach for assessing LLMs in medicine, but it is unclear whether rubric scores reflect such errors. We first study this in a controlled setting using MedHallu, finding that more specific rubrics better distinguish correct from hallucinated responses. To test this systematically, we develop a taxonomy of medical hallucination types and a clinician-validated error-injection pipeline that creates matched correct and error-injected responses. Across HealthBench, HealthBench Professional, and LiveMedBench, our clinically relevant hallucinations are missed by rubrics, often leaving scores unchanged. zh_abstract: 幻觉可能削弱临床医生对大语言模型（LLM）的信任，因此评估方法能够捕捉具有临床相关性的错误十分重要。基于评分细则（rubric）的评估已成为医学领域评估 LLM 的主要方法，但评分细则得分是否反映此类错误尚不清楚。我们首先在受控环境中使用 MedHallu 对此进行研究，发现越具体的评分细则越能区分正确回答与幻觉回答。为系统性地检验这一点，我们构建了医学幻觉类型的分类体系，并建立了经临床医生验证的错误注入流程，该流程可生成相匹配的正确回答与注入错误的回答。在 HealthBench、HealthBench Professional 和 LiveMedBench 上，我们所构造的具有临床相关性的幻觉会被评分细则漏检，往往使得分保持不变。我们发现，评分细则在明确核查事实时最为有效，而对于额外的或未

abstract: [Internal and emergency medicine] Epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) is significantly associated with cardiovascular disease and poor prognosis. Deep learning (DL) models have been explored for automatic EAT segmentation, but systematic evidence verifying their effectiveness is currently lacking. We conducted this meta-analysis to evaluate the accuracy of DL models for EAT segmentation and quantification, aiming to support the development of automated tools. We searched the Cochrane Library, Embase, Web of Science, PubMed, and IEEE Xplore through February 20, 2026. Studies reporting DL-based quantitative EAT segmentation were included. Quality was assessed with QUADAS-2. The Dice similarity coefficient (Dice), correlation coefficient (R), and Bland-Altman bias were used to evaluate segmentation efficacy, the correlation between automated segmentation and reference standards, and consistency, respectively. A random-effects model with the Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman method pooled these measures. Thirty eligible studies were included, covering five image types. For non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT), the pooled Dice was 0.888 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.853-0.924), and the pooled R reached 0.973 (95%CI: 0.958-0.982). The contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CECT) subgroup performed best, yielding a Dice of 0.910 (95% CI: 0.881-0.939) and an R of 0.989 (95% CI: 0.976-0.995). This meta-analysis quantifies the accuracy of DL models for EAT segmentation and volume quantification. The findings indicate that DL achieves robust accuracy on both NCCT and CECT images. However, given that most current studies rely on internal validation, future work should prioritize large-scale, multicenter external validation to support the translation of these promising DL tools into robust clinical diagnostic systems.
zh_abstract: 【内科与急诊医学】心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）与心血管疾病及不良预后显著相关。深度学习（DL）模型已被用于EAT自动分割，但目前缺乏验证其有效性的系统性证据。我们开展了这项荟萃分析，以评估DL模型用于EAT分割和定量的准确性，旨在为自动化工具的开发提供支持。我们检索了Cochrane Library、Embase、Web of Science、PubMed和IEEE Xplore，检索截至2026年2月20日。纳入报告基于DL的EAT定量分割的研究。采用QUADAS-2评估质量。分别以Dice相似系数（Dice）、相关系数（R）和Bland-Altman偏倚来评估分割效能、自动分割与参考标准之间的相关性以及一致性。采用Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman方法的随机效应模型对这些指标进行合并。共纳入30项符合条件的研究，涵盖五种图像类型。对于非增强计算机断层扫描（NCCT），合并Dice为0.888（95%置信区间[CI]：0.853-0.924），合并R达0.973（95%CI：0.958-0.982）。增强计算机断层扫描（CECT）亚组表现最佳，Dice为0.910（95% CI：0.881-0.939），R为0.989（95% CI：0.976-0.995）。这项荟萃分析量化了DL模型用于EAT分割和体积定量的准确性。结果表明，DL在NCCT和CECT图像上均能达到稳健的准确性。然而，鉴于目前大多数研究依赖内部验证，未来工作应优先开展大规模、多中心的外部验证，以支持将这些有前景的DL工具转化为稳健的临床诊断系统。

title: MRI of brain metastases in the era of immunotherapy, targeted agents, and artificial intelligence: from detection to treatment response assessment.

abstract: [Magma (New York, N.Y.)] Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is central to the detection, treatment planning, and response assessment of brain metastases (BM). However, advances in stereotactic radiosurgery, immunotherapy, and targeted therapy have substantially altered the imaging appearance and treatment response patterns of BM, which are not fully captured by conventional imaging and conventional size-based response criteria. This review discusses the evolving role of MRI in BM, from optimized lesion detection to treatment response assessment. We review advanced contrast-enhanced MRI techniques, including three-dimensional turbo spin echo black-blood imaging and post-contrast T2-weighted FLAIR, as well as recent developments in artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted detection. We also examine limitations of RANO-BM and discuss the emerging role of AI-based volumetric analysis for quantitative longitudinal assessment. For differentiating radiation necrosis from tumor progression, we review diffusion and perfusion MRI, MR spectroscopy, and emerging approaches including chemical exchange saturation transfer imaging, radiomics, and tumor habitat analysis. Finally, we highlight how the integration of optimized MRI protocols, multi-parametric imaging, and validated AI-based quantitative tools may improve treatment response assessment and support more precise clinical decision-making for patients with BM.
zh_abstract: [Magma (New York, N.Y.)] 磁共振成像（MRI）在脑转移瘤（BM）的检出、治疗规划和疗效评估中处于核心地位。然而，立体定向放射外科、免疫治疗和靶向治疗的进展已显著改变了BM的影像表现和治疗反应模式，而传统影像学和基于大小的传统疗效标准并不能完全反映这些变化。本综述讨论了MRI在BM中不断演变的作用，从优化病灶检出到治疗反应评估。我们回顾了先进的对比增强MRI技术，包括三维快速自旋回波黑血成像和增强后T2加权FLAIR，以及人工智能（AI）辅助检测的最新进展。我们还探讨了RANO-BM的局限性，并讨论了基于AI的体积分析在定量纵向评估中的新兴作用。对于放射性坏死与肿瘤进展的鉴别，我们回顾了扩散和灌注MRI、磁共振波谱，以及包括化学交换饱和转移成像、影像组学和肿瘤生境分析在内的新兴方法。最后，我们强调，整合优化的MRI方案、多参数成像以及经过验证的基于AI的定量工具，可能改善治疗反应评估，并为BM患者更精准的临床决策提供支持。

title: OneEEG: A Unified Signal-Visual Multimodal Language Model with Task-Aware Mixture of Projectors for Multi-Task EEG Understanding

summary: 提出统一的EEG多模态大模型OneEEG，联合数值与视觉脑电表征，采用任务感知混合投影器，并构建指令数据集OneEEG-Instruct与基准OneEEG-Bench。

abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces, and cognitive-state analysis, yet EEG modeling remains fragmented across task paradigms. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a promising interface for flexible multimodal reasoning, but their ability to understand EEG inputs remains limited. In this work, we propose OneEEG, a unified EEG-MLLM framework for multi-task EEG understanding. By training on our curated OneEEG-Instruct, a multi-task EEG instruction-tuning dataset, OneEEG jointly models numerical EEG representations and visual EEG representations, and introduces a task-aware Mixture of Projectors (MoP) to align heterogeneous EEG features across different task families with the LLM embedding space. We further establish OneEEG-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating current MLLMs and our method on multi-task EEG understanding. Experiments show that existing MLLMs have limited ability to interpret EEG inputs, while OneEEG achieves stronger performance by integrating numerical and visual EEG representations with task-aware EEG-to-LLM projection. Extensive ablations and analyses further reveal the effects of visual EEG renderings, MoP variants, router behavior, and feature dispersion across EEG tasks.
zh_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）广泛应用于临床评估、脑机接口和认知状态分析，但 EEG 建模在不同任务范式之间仍较为割裂。近期的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）为灵活的多模态推理提供了有前景的接口，但其理解 EEG 输入的能力仍然有限。在本研究中，我们提出了 OneEEG，一个用于多任务 EEG 理解的统一 EEG-MLLM 框架。通过在我们构建的多任务 EEG 指令微调数据集 OneEEG-Instruct 上训练，OneEEG 联合建模数值型 EEG 表征和视觉型 EEG 表征，并引入任务感知的投影器混合（Mixture of Projectors，MoP），将不同任务类别的异质 EEG 特征与大语言模型的嵌入空间对齐。我们还建立了 OneEEG-Bench，用于评估当前 MLLM 及我们的方法在多任务 EEG 理解上的表现。实验表明，现有 MLLM 解读 EEG 输入的能力有限，而 OneEEG 通过整合数值型和视觉型 EEG 表征并采用任务感知的 EEG 到大语言模型的投影，取得了更强的性能。大量消融实验和分析进一步揭示了视觉 EEG 渲染、MoP 变体、路由器行为以及跨 EEG 任务的特征离散度所产生的影响。

abstract: Recent advancements in foundation models (FMs) have catalyzed a paradigm shift in medical image analysis. Unlike traditional task-specific artificial intelligence (AI) models, FMs leverage large-scale datasets to learn generalized representations that can be adapted to downstream clinical applications. Despite the rapid proliferation of FM research in medical imaging, there is a lack of unified synthesis that systematically maps the evolution of architectures, training paradigms, and clinical applications across modalities. To address this gap, this review provides a comprehensive and structured synthesis of FMs in medical image analysis by systematically organizing studies into two primary categories: vision-only foundation models (VFMs) and vision-language foundation models (VLFMs), based on their architectural foundations, training strategies, and downstream clinical tasks. abstract: Artificial intelligence systems are transforming scientific discovery by accelerating specific research tasks, from protein structure prediction to materials design, yet remain confined to narrow domains requiring substantial human oversight. Exponential growth of scientific literature and increasing domain specialisation constrain researchers capacity to synthesise knowledge across disciplines and develop unifying theories, motivating exploration of more general-purpose AI systems for science. Here we show that a domain-agnostic, agentic AI system can independently navigate the scientific workflow, from hypothesis generation through data collection to manuscript preparation. abstract: Mental health research on social media has been dominated by English-language datasets and DSM-5-centered resources, limiting cross-lingual and cross-cultural understanding of online mental health expression. The dataset distinguishes users with explicit self-disclosure evidence from broader disorder-related participants through an LLM-assisted annotation pipeline, and is released in a rigorously de-identified, controlled-access format. abstract: Wearable devices provide continuous access to physiological signals such as ECG and PPG, offering a path to answering users' questions about their own physiological state and to early detection of cardiac and physiological abnormalities. Yet existing mobile health (mHealth) systems are largely limited to task-specific prediction pipelines or reactive question answering over static summaries. They lack the temporal reasoning, persistent physiological context, and proactive monitoring required for long-term signal streams. To advance this setting, we introduce VitalBench, a longitudinal physiological monitoring benchmark comprising 1,862 QA pairs for reactive question answering and 90.2 hours of continuous ECG/PPG recordings for proactive monitoring, covering cardiac, physical activity, and stress-related tasks. Building on this resource, we propose VitalAgent, a tool-augmented agentic fra
zh_abstract: 可穿戴设备可持续获取心电图（ECG）和光电容积脉搏波（PPG）等生理信号，为回答用户关于自身生理状态的问题以及早期发现心脏和生理异常提供了途径。然而，现有的移动健康（mHealth）系统大多局限于针对特定任务的预测流程，或基于静态摘要的被动式问答。它们缺乏长期信号流所需的时间推理、持续的生理上下文以及主动监测能力。为推进这一方向，我们提出了 VitalBench，这是一个纵向生理监测基准，包含用于被动式问答的 1,862 个问答对，以及用于主动监测的 90.2 小时连续 ECG/PPG 记录，涵盖心脏、身体活动和压力相关任务。在此资源的基础上，我们提出了 VitalAgent，一个工具增强的智能体框架（原文此处截断）

title: How Much Can AI Virtual Cells Gain from Unified Perturbational Modeling?

abstract: Predicting how individual cells respond to perturbations is a central task in artificial intelligence virtual cell (AIVC) modeling. However, integrating perturbation datasets is challenging because they differ in measured gene sets, perturbation types and cellular contexts. Existing AIVC predictors are typically developed for specific settings, limiting their applicability across heterogeneous datasets. Here, we investigate the extent to which AIVC predictors can benefit from unified perturbational modeling (UPM), a novel paradigm designed to integrate heterogeneous Perturb-seq datasets into a single predictive model. To this end, we introduce three unification modules into a variational autoencoder (VAE)-based AIVC predictor to address these sources of heterogeneity: gene-channel alignment, shared perturbation encoding, and joint embedding of gene expression and identity. We systematically evaluate and validate the individual contributions of these modules. Building on UPM, we assemble a dataset of 110 million cells spanning over 22,000 genes, four perturbation types and 76 cellular contexts, and use 89.7 million cells from 71 contexts to train a unified AIVC predictor with more than one billion parameters. Across genetic perturbation benchmarks, UPM achieves the highest PES and gene-wise response correlation among the evaluated models. It also improves all four evaluation metrics over State on the five held-out Tahoe-100M cell lines and over Stack on the cytokine benchmark. UPM also improves combinatorial perturbation prediction relative to specialized predictors. In the HSC application, our model achieves a 40.0% improvement in accuracy on a downstream task involving the recapitulation of effects induced by the knockdown of hepatic stellate cell (HSC)-related targets. Our implementation is openly available at https://github.com/youlab2025/UPM.

abstract: Single-cell proteomics provides a direct functional readout of cellular states, but targeted assays measure limited and non-identical protein panels, fragmenting information across experiments. Here, we present ProtCell, a foundation model developed using approximately 380 million cells from 98 datasets for pretraining and evaluation. ProtCell combines protein-identity and continuous-abundance embeddings in a transformer encoder and learns cell- and protein-level representations through masked abundance modeling. ProtCell first connects fragmented profiles through transferable annotation and batch correction while preserving biological organization. It then extends limited profiles through abundance reconstruction and inference of an unmeasured cytotoxic protein program enriched in natural killer cells and memory CD8$^+$ T cells. The learned protein dependencies further guide the selection of compact panels that retain information for profile reconstruction and biological classification. ProtCell thus provides a framework for connecting fragmented proteomic profiles, extending information beyond measured panels and guiding more informative measurements.

title: Building virtual cell dynamics that evolve with biological measurements
zh_title: CellCompass：随生物测量演化的虚拟细胞动力学智能体
summary: 提出智能体系统CellCompass，将科学智能体与可扩展动力学引擎结合，建模细胞状态转变与群体变化，并构建含100个模拟场景的DynBench100基准。
key_points: 智能体按新测量设计并改进动力学模型
涵盖状态转变、群体变化、命运与分子读出
发布DynBench100模拟单细胞时间序列基准
reason: 虚拟细胞智能体方法新颖并带基准，但为预印本且基于模拟，值得一看档，偏好加分
abstract: Virtual cell models built from single-cell measurements need to predict how cells change over time, but new biological measurements often reveal dynamical relationships that existing models cannot express. Translating such measurements into dynamics therefore requires deciding what biological relation should be modeled, where it should enter the formulation and how its recovery should be validated. Here we present CellCompass, an agentic AI system that couples a scientific agent with an extensible dynamical engine for modeling state transitions and population change, along with fate and molecular readout. CellCompass reuses existing formulations when sufficient and designs, implements and refines new ones when experimental measurements introduce additional constraints. To assess this capability, we developed DynBench100, a benchmark of 100 simulated single-cell time-course scenarios with hidden dynamical ground truth. CellCompass achieved the highest aggregate performance among the tested general-purpose and biomedical agents across six dynamical tasks. Across four real single-cell studies, it retained an existing velocity-growth model to reconstruct context-dependent epithelial-mesenchymal transition and developed three new dynamical formulations for distinct experimental measurements. In drug-response data, incorporating metabolic RNA labeling reduced pulse-control identifiability error by 31.1%, revealing staged response programs and generating testable predictions for perturbing a candidate adaptive program. In hematopoietic lineage tracing, incorporating clonal barcodes improved clone-fate agreement by 54% over the strongest dynamical baseline, identifying early lineage priming among transcriptionally similar progenitors. Finally, in time-resolved CITE-seq data, CellCompass reduced future surface-protein distribution error by 13.2% for RNA-initialized trajectories, uncovering lineage-specific temporal offsets between transcriptional and protein programs. Together, CellCompass provides a framework in which virtual-cell dynamics can expand with the biological measurements used to constrain them.
zh_abstract: 基于单细胞测量构建的虚拟细胞模型需要预测细胞如何随时间变化，但新的生物学测量往往揭示出现有模型无法表达的动力学关系。因此，将此类测量转化为动力学，需要决定应对何种生物学关系建模、该关系应在公式的何处引入，以及如何验证其恢复结果。在此，我们提出 CellCompass，这是一种智能体（agentic）人工智能系统，它将一个科学智能体与一个可扩展的动力学引擎相结合，用于对状态转变和群体变化以及命运和分子读出进行建模。当现有公式足够时，CellCompass 会重用它们；当实验测量引入额外约束时，它会设计、实现并改进新的公式。为评估这一能力，我们构建了 DynBench100，这是一个包含 100 个模拟单细胞时间序列场景、且带有隐藏动力学真值的基准。在六项动力学任务中，CellCompass 在所测试的通用型和生物医学智能体中取得了最高的综合性能。在四项真实单细胞研究中，它保留了现有的速度-增长模型以重建依赖于情境的上皮-间充质转化，并针对不同的实验测量开发了三种新的动力学公式。在药物应答数据中，纳入代谢性 RNA 标记使脉冲对照可识别性误差降低了 31.1%，揭示了分阶段的应答程序，并为扰动某一候选适应性程序产生了可检验的预测。在造血谱系追踪中，纳入克隆条形码使克隆命运一致性比最强的动力学基线提高了 54%，识别出转录相似的祖细胞之间存在早期谱系启动。最后，在时间分辨的 CITE-seq 数据中，对于以 RNA 初始化的轨迹，CellCompass 使未来表面蛋白分布误差降低了 13.2%，揭示了转录程序与蛋白程序之间存在谱系特异性的时间偏移。总之，CellCompass 提供了一个框架，使虚拟细胞动力学能够随用于约束它的生物学测量而扩展。

title: From task-specific AI to multimodal foundation models in PET/CT: a readiness framework for clinical translation.
zh_title: 从任务专用AI到PET/CT多模态基础模型：临床转化就绪度框架
summary: 叙述性综述梳理2021年1月至2026年7月PET/CT中的AI，区分任务专用模型、预训练表示、视觉语言系统与智能体，并提出就绪度框架。
key_points: 涵盖重建、衰减校正、分割、预后建模等任务
区分专用模型、可提示模型、VLM、通用基础模型候选与智能体

reason: 综述上限6分，主题命中基础模型与多模态偏好
abstract: [Frontiers in nuclear medicine] Artificial intelligence in PET/CT is evolving from narrowly optimized systems toward reusable pretrained representations and multimodal models. PET/CT is a demanding test case because clinically meaningful interpretation must preserve quantitative molecular information while integrating anatomic CT, acquisition metadata, longitudinal examinations, and free-text imaging reports. This focused narrative review synthesizes literature reported from January 2021 through July 2026, spanning PET reconstruction and enhancement, attenuation correction, segmentation, outcome modeling, pretrained representations, vision-language systems, and agentic workflows. We distinguish task-specific models, reusable pretrained representations, promptable models, vision-language systems, generalist foundation-model candidates, and agentic systems according to demonstrated capabilities, while separately considering evaluation benchmarks. Task-specific deep learning has demonstrated promising technical performance in low-count imaging and whole-body tumor analysis, but most evidence remains retrospective and restricted by radiotracer, disease, scanner, institution, or endpoint. Emerging PET-native studies demonstrate label-efficient segmentation, image-text grounding, report generation, and modular tool orchestration; however, they do not yet establish broad cross-tracer generalization or prospective clinical benefit. We therefore propose MOSAIC-PET, an author-developed heuristic six-domain evaluation framework for PET/CT foundation models encompassing Molecular fidelity, Organ and anatomic grounding, Semantic faithfulness, Adaptability, Integration and clinical impact, and Continuous governance. MOSAIC-PET has not undergone Delphi consensus or formal validation and is intended to organize PET-specific evidence requirements rather than function as a validated clinical-readiness tool. The near-term translational priority is the development of modular, auditable systems in which validated quantitative tools and evidence-linked language outputs remain under specialist oversight, with progression from external testing to silent evaluation, assisted-use studies, clinical-impact assessment, and continuous lifecycle monitoring.
zh_abstract: [核医学前沿] PET/CT 中的人工智能正从狭窄优化的系统向可复用的预训练表征和多模态模型演进。PET/CT 是一个要求很高的检验场景，因为具有临床意义的解读必须在整合解剖 CT、采集元数据、纵向检查和自由文本影像报告的同时，保留定量分子信息。本聚焦性叙述性综述综合了 2021 年 1 月至 2026 年 7 月报道的文献，涵盖 PET 重建与增强、衰减校正、分割、结局建模、预训练表征、视觉-语言系统和智能体（agentic）工作流。我们根据已证实的能力，区分了任务特异性模型、可复用的预训练表征、可提示模型、视觉-语言系统、通用基础模型候选以及智能体系统，同时另行考量评估基准。任务特异性深度学习在低计数成像和全身肿瘤分析中已展现出有前景的技术性能，但大多数证据仍为回顾性，并受限于放射性示踪剂、疾病、扫描仪、机构或终点。新兴的 PET 原生研究展示了标签高效分割、图像-文本对应（grounding）、报告生成和模块化工具编排；然而，这些研究尚未证实广泛的跨示踪剂泛化能力或前瞻性临床获益。因此，我们提出 MOSAIC-PET，这是一个由作者自行开发的、启发式的六领域 PET/CT 基础模型评估框架，包括分子保真度（Molecular fidelity）、器官与解剖对应（Organ and anatomic grounding）、语义忠实性（Semantic faithfulness）、适应性（Adaptability）、整合与临床影响（Integration and clinical impact）以及持续治理（Continuous governance）。MOSAIC-PET 尚未经过德尔菲共识或正式验证，其目的在于梳理 PET 特有的证据要求，而非作为经过验证的临床就绪度工具。近期转化的优先事项是开发模块化、可审计的系统，使经过验证的定量工具和有证据关联的语言输出始终处于专科医师的监督之下，并按照从外部测试到静默评估、辅助使用研究、临床影响评估以及持续生命周期监测的路径推进。

abstract: [Acta medica Okayama] Peroral cholangioscopy (POCS) enables direct intraductal visualization and targeted biopsies for indeterminate biliary strictures. However, its diagnostic performance remains operator-dependent and is limited by sampling error. As artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly advanced in gastrointestinal endoscopy, AI-assisted cholangioscopy has progressed from proof-of-concept image classification to multicenter validation, feature detection, and real-time application. Recent studies using digital single-operator cholangioscopy have reported diagnostic accuracy comparable to that of experts in differentiating malignant from benign strictures, and feature-based approaches can automatically detect tumor vessels and other key visual characteristics. Beyond classification, generative models may enhance mucosal and margin visualization through virtual chromoendoscopy, potentially improving lesion-margin assessment. Furthermore, new models compatible with multiple systems are emerging to address device heterogeneity, which is a key barrier to routine practice. This review summarizes the current evidence on AI-assisted POCS, discusses practical considerations for clinical translation, and highlights future directions, including real-time integration and multimodal decision support.
zh_abstract: [Acta medica Okayama] 经口胆道镜检查（POCS）可直接观察胆管腔内并对不明原因的胆管狭窄进行靶向活检。然而，其诊断性能仍依赖于操作者，并受取样误差的限制。随着人工智能（AI）在胃肠内镜领域的迅速发展，AI辅助胆道镜已从概念验证性的图像分类发展到多中心验证、特征检测和实时应用。近期采用数字化单操作者胆道镜的研究报告称，其在鉴别恶性与良性狭窄方面的诊断准确性与专家相当，基于特征的方法可自动检测肿瘤血管及其他关键视觉特征。除分类之外，生成模型可通过虚拟染色内镜增强黏膜和边缘的可视化，有望改善病变边缘的评估。此外，为应对设备异质性这一阻碍常规实践的关键障碍，兼容多种系统的新模型正在涌现。本综述总结了AI辅助POCS的现有证据，讨论了临床转化的实际考量，并强调了未来方向，包括实时整合和多模态决策支持。

abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] The translation of nanomedicines is frequently bottlenecked by trial-and-error optimization. Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) transforms this process into a closed-loop, experimentally grounded discovery ecosystem. This Review provides a roadmap for this paradigm, demonstrating how AI, high-throughput testing, and nanoscale design converge to generate clinically translatable nanotherapeutics. We emphasize the necessity of standardized multimodal data-spanning pharmacokinetic, biodistribution, and drug-release profiles-anchored strictly to validated biological phenomena. Furthermore, we evaluate an algorithmic spectrum, ranging from classical machine learning to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and reinforcement learning (RL), to align models with specific formulation objectives. To bridge computational design and empirical reality, we examine how high-throughput technologies, such as robotic laboratories and in vivo DNA-barcoding multiplexing, operationalize the "Design-Make-Test-Analyze" (DMTA) cycle for dynamic model recalibration. Ultimately, this review demonstrates how integrating AI, physical constraints, and automated validation accelerates the rational design of next-generation nanomedicines.

abstract: Mental-health risks such as depression, dementia, and suicidal ideation can emerge during hospitalization among chronically ill patients and may worsen without timely recognition and intervention. However, most existing mental health studies focus on patients with established psychiatric conditions rather than patients hospitalized primarily for physical illness. In this work, we investigate whether latent mental-health risk in chronically ill patients can be inferred from longitudinal clinical narratives. We construct a weakly supervised cohort around 4,000 patients from MIMIC-III using mental-health evidence extracted from discharge summaries. A hierarchical state-space framework derives mental-health representations from day-wise clinical narratives and models their temporal evolution for risk estimation throughout hospitalization. Preliminary results demonstrate improved binary risk prediction using the proposed representations and show distinct model derived risk trajectories between risk and no-risk cohorts, providing a foundation for studying emerging mental-health risks in chronically ill patients.

abstract: Clinical trial prescreening requires distinguishing unmet conditions from insufficient evidence in patient records. Given patient records, criterion questions, and predefined answer options, we retrospectively compared JEV, a non-generative decision model returning native option probabilities, with schema-constrained Qwen Flash across 2,048 test patient-condition pairs from TrialGPT and question-answer datasets derived from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, all evaluated under strict Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policies to ensure clinical data privacy. Both models assessed conditions individually or in batches sharing the same patient context, with performance measured against reference labels. In batch mode, JEV and Qwen achieved similar macro-F1 scores on TrialGPT (0.652 vs. 0.660) and MIMIC-IV (0.807 vs. 0.814), whereas JEV substantially outperformed Qwen on MIMIC-III (0.768 vs. 0.534; $Δ$ = +0.234, 95% CI: 0.187-0.281). This advantage largely reflected higher recall for conditions labeled as having insufficient information (56.3% vs. 9.9%). Across all three datasets, JEV also had lower observed median job latency (1.18-1.40 vs. 2.80-8.90 s) and 53%-74% lower estimated cost per condition. These findings position JEV as an initial assessment component that provides criterion-level judgments and flags potential information gaps for review. JEV's observed errors in interpreting clinical evidence underscore the need to verify its outputs against patient records before they inform eligibility decisions.

title: Retrospective macromolecular pool fraction mapping from conventional clinical MRI: a physics-guided self-supervised deep learning framework
zh_title: 从常规临床MRI回顾性估计大分子池分数：物理引导自监督框架
summary: 预印本提出物理引导的自监督深度学习，从常规T1、T2和FLAIR MRI估计大分子池分数（MPF），无需配对定量参考扫描。
key_points: 嵌入两池磁化传递信号模型
用自适应实例归一化适配不同采集协议
面向与髓鞘完整性相关的MPF生物标志物
reason: 物理引导自监督新方法，多站点训练，但摘要未见外部验证结果
abstract: Macromolecular pool fraction (MPF) is a quantitative imaging biomarker sensitive to myelin integrity and other changes in tissue macromolecular content, but specialized acquisitions and reconstruction methods limit its use in large-scale studies. We present a physics-guided, self-supervised deep learning framework for retrospectively estimating MPF directly from conventional clinical brain MRI ($T_1$-weighted, $T_2$-weighted, and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery [FLAIR]) without paired quantitative reference scans. The framework embeds an analytical two-pool magnetization transfer signal model that related sequence-averaged radiofrequency transmit power to apparent longitudinal relaxation. To accommodate heterogeneous clinical protocols, the network conditions intermediate features on acquisition parameters via adaptive instance normalization. It was trained and evaluated on a multisi
zh_abstract: 大分子池分数（MPF）是一种对髓鞘完整性及组织大分子含量其他变化敏感的定量成像生物标志物，但专用的采集和重建方法限制了其在大规模研究中的应用。我们提出了一种物理引导的自监督深度学习框架，可在没有配对定量参考扫描的情况下，直接从常规临床脑MRI（$T_1$加权、$T_2$加权和液体衰减反转恢复[FLAIR]）回顾性估计MPF。该框架嵌入了一个解析的双池磁化传递信号模型，将序列平均射频发射功率与表观纵向弛豫联系起来。为适应异质性的临床方案，网络通过自适应实例归一化，以采集参数对中间特征进行条件化。该模型在一个多中心

title: MedConstBench: Benchmarking How Constitutions Steer LLMs in Medical Ethics
zh_title: MedConstBench：评测“宪法”如何引导大模型的医学伦理行为
summary: 提出以部署宪法为可控变量的医学伦理基准，围绕Beauchamp四原则，含自建临床困境数据集MedDilemma，并采用人工校准的多模型互评。
key_points: 将宪法作为受控变量而非固定属性
围绕Beauchamp四项伦理原则
含MedDilemma临床困境数据集
reason: 新基准有新意，但为预印本且证据有限
abstract: As large language models advance rapidly, they are increasingly used to answer medical questions, and many such models are now deployed locally. Once a model is deployed, its behavior is governed mainly by the ethical policy written into its constitution. However, most existing work focuses on factual correctness rather than the trade-off between competing ethical values. Even benchmarks that do evaluate ethics treat it as a fixed property of the model rather than as a variable, so how a constitution reshapes medical-ethics behavior remains largely unexplored. We introduce MedConstBench, a medical-ethics benchmark that treats the deployment constitution as a controlled variable, is organized around Beauchamp's four principles, and is scored by human-calibrated multi-model peer review. It includes MedDilemma, our own dataset of clinical dilemmas, and supports a systematic analysis of how
zh_abstract: 随着大语言模型的快速发展，它们越来越多地被用于回答医学问题，许多此类模型现已在本地部署。模型一旦部署，其行为主要由写入其“宪法”（constitution）的伦理政策所决定。然而，现有工作大多关注事实正确性，而非相互竞争的伦理价值之间的权衡。即使是评估伦理的基准，也将伦理视为模型的固定属性而非变量，因此宪法如何重塑医学伦理行为在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们提出 MedConstBench，这是一个将部署宪法作为受控变量的医学伦理基准，围绕 Beauchamp 的四项原则组织，并通过经人工校准的多模型同行评审进行评分。它包含我们自建的临床两难问题数据集 MedDilemma，并支持对……如何……进行系统分析

title: MultiFair: Multimodal Balanced Fairness-Aware Medical Classification with Dual-Level Gradient Modulation
zh_title: MultiFair：双层梯度调制的多模态均衡公平医学分类
summary: 针对多模态医学分类中模态学习不均衡和群体不公平两个问题，提出双层梯度调制方法MultiFair。
key_points: 同时处理模态失衡与人群不公平
采用双层梯度调制动态调整训练梯度
面向多模态医学分类
reason: 方法有新意，摘要未见充分验证细节
abstract: Medical decision systems increasingly rely on data from multiple sources to ensure reliable and unbiased diagnosis. However, existing multimodal learning models fail to achieve this goal because they often overlook two critical challenges. First, various data modalities may learn unevenly, thereby converging to a model biased towards certain modalities. Second, the model may emphasize learning on certain demographic groups causing unfair performances. The two aspects can influence each other, as different data modalities may favor respective groups during optimization, leading to both imbalanced and unfair multimodal learning. This paper proposes a novel approach called MultiFair for multimodal medical classification, which addresses these challenges with a dual-level gradient modulation process. MultiFair dynamically modulates training gradients regarding the optimization direction and
zh_abstract: 医疗决策系统越来越依赖多源数据，以确保诊断可靠且无偏。然而，现有的多模态学习模型未能实现这一目标，因为它们往往忽视两个关键挑战。第一，不同数据模态的学习可能不均衡，从而使模型收敛到偏向某些模态的状态。第二，模型可能侧重于学习某些人口统计学群体，导致性能不公平。这两方面可相互影响，因为不同数据模态在优化过程中可能分别偏向不同群体，从而导致多模态学习既不平衡又不公平。本文提出一种用于多模态医学分类的新方法 MultiFair，通过双层梯度调制过程应对这些挑战。MultiFair 针对优化方向和……动态调制训练梯度

title: TCM-DiagCommit: A TCM-SD-Derived Benchmark for Evidence-Conditioned Syndrome Selection and Commitment
zh_title: TCM-DiagCommit：中医辨证选择与决断基准
summary: 基于公开TCM-SD资源，将1,834例转为23,842条任务行，覆盖148个证型，评测分阶段证据下的辨证、获取、推迟与弃权行为。
key_points: 含随机、近邻与全词表候选梯度
分阶段证据及舌脉扰动、证据不足变体
评分涵盖决断、获取、推迟、弃权
reason: 新基准设计有新意，但规模较小且为预印本
abstract: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) syndrome differentiation is usually evaluated as static final-label selection over complete clinical records. This setting hides three diagnostic behaviors: whether a model distinguishes semantic-neighbor syndrome labels from easy random distractors, whether it updates predictions as evidence fields are revealed, and whether it should commit under uncertainty. We introduce TCM-DiagCommit, a benchmark derived from the public TCM-SD/ZY-BERT resource while retaining its source syndrome labels; it converts 1,834 source cases into 23,842 task rows over 148 syndrome labels. The benchmark combines random, profile-neighbor, and full-vocabulary candidate ladders with staged t1/t2/t3 evidence. It also includes fixed-label tongue/pulse perturbations and insufficient-evidence variants. A benchmark-defined action contract scores commit, acquire, defer, and abstain.
zh_abstract: 中医（TCM）辨证通常被评估为基于完整临床记录的静态最终标签选择。这种设置掩盖了三种诊断行为：模型能否区分语义相近的证候标签与容易区分的随机干扰项，能否随着证据字段逐步揭示而更新预测，以及在不确定情况下是否应当作出决定。我们提出 TCM-DiagCommit，这是一个源自公开的 TCM-SD/ZY-BERT 资源的基准，并保留其原始证候标签；它将 1,834 个源病例转换为涵盖 148 个证候标签的 23,842 条任务行。该基准结合了随机、画像近邻和全词表的候选梯度，以及分阶段的 t1/t2/t3 证据。它还包括固定标签的舌象/脉象扰动和证据不足的变体。基准定义的行动契约对提交（commit）、获取（acquire）、推迟（defer）和弃权（abstain）进行评分。

title: scTREAT: Latent Diffusion for Single-Cell Drug-Response Prediction
zh_title: scTREAT：用于单细胞药物响应预测的潜空间扩散模型
summary: 提出分解细胞状态与药物引导的扩散框架，在 Tahoe-100M 图谱上预测未见细胞系-药物组合及未见药物的转录响应。
key_points: GD-Attn 注入基线表示与剂量条件分子嵌入
未见组合 12 项指标中 10 项最优
基于 Tahoe-100M 伪体表达谱
reason: 新颖方法有基线对比，无外部验证，预印本
abstract: Generating drug-induced transcriptional responses requires a model to account for cellular background together with molecular identity and dose. We present scTREAT, the first diffusion framework to factorize state and drug guidance for single-cell drug-response prediction. A shared latent expression space connects baseline and response, while Guided Decomposable Attention (GD-Attn) injects a baseline representation and a dose-conditioned molecular embedding. Independent channel dropout exposes four conditioning states during training; inference combines three conditional predictions with separately specified state and drug coefficients, and dose modulates drug-guidance strength. On condition-level pseudobulk profiles derived from the Tahoe-100M single-cell atlas, scTREAT achieves the best value on 10 of 12 metrics for unseen cell line-drug combinations (UC) and 11 of 12 for unseen drugs
zh_abstract: 生成药物诱导的转录反应，要求模型在考虑分子身份和剂量的同时，也要考虑细胞背景。我们提出 scTREAT，这是首个将状态引导与药物引导进行因子化、用于单细胞药物反应预测的扩散框架。共享的潜在表达空间连接基线与反应，而引导可分解注意力（Guided Decomposable Attention，GD-Attn）则注入基线表征和剂量条件化的分子嵌入。训练期间通过独立的通道丢弃（channel dropout）呈现四种条件状态；推理时，将三个条件预测与分别设定的状态系数和药物系数相结合，并由剂量调节药物引导强度。在源自 Tahoe-100M 单细胞图谱的条件水平伪批量（pseudobulk）谱上，scTREAT 在未见过的细胞系-药物组合（UC）上于 12 项指标中的 10 项取得最佳值，在未见过的药物上于 12 项指标中的 11 项取得最佳值

title: MM-Net: A Multimodal Multi-Task Network for Sleep Staging and Sleep Apnea Assessment After Ischemic Stroke
zh_title: MM-Net：缺血性卒中后睡眠分期与睡眠呼吸暂停评估的多模态多任务网络
summary: 提出多模态多任务框架，通过交叉拟合和岭回归嵌入对齐，联合完成卒中后睡眠分期与呼吸事件检测。
key_points: 融合适配睡眠的EEG-EOG表征与心肺特征
交叉注意力与共享时序建模联合两任务
通过交叉拟合解决预训练编码器的表征不一致
reason: 睡眠多模态方法有新意，摘要未见外部验证或规模信息
abstract: Automated polysomnography after ischemic stroke is challenging because of altered sleep-related neural activity and concurrent respiratory disturbances. Existing stroke-specific approaches mainly address sleep-stage classification, leaving joint analysis of sleep architecture and respiratory events underexplored. Moreover, adapting pretrained EEG encoders introduces a representation inconsistency when downstream models are trained on embeddings from previously seen patients but evaluated on unseen individuals. We propose MM-Net, a multimodal multi-task framework that resolves this inconsistency through cross-fitting and ridge-based embedding alignment. Sleep-adapted EEG-EOG representations and engineered neural descriptors are fused with learned cardiorespiratory features through cross-attention and shared temporal modeling for simultaneous sleep staging and respiratory-event detection.
zh_abstract: 缺血性卒中后的自动多导睡眠监测具有挑战性，原因在于与睡眠相关的神经活动发生改变，并伴有呼吸紊乱。现有针对卒中的方法主要处理睡眠分期分类，对睡眠结构与呼吸事件的联合分析研究不足。此外，适配预训练脑电图（EEG）编码器时，当下游模型使用既往见过的患者的嵌入进行训练、却在未见过的个体上评估时，会产生表示不一致的问题。我们提出 MM-Net，一种多模态多任务框架，通过交叉拟合（cross-fitting）和基于岭回归的嵌入对齐来解决这一不一致。经睡眠适配的 EEG-EOG 表示与工程化神经描述符，通过交叉注意力和共享时间建模与习得的心肺特征融合，以同时进行睡眠分期和呼吸事件检测。

title: How Reliable Is Individualized Functional-Network Attribution in Resting-State fMRI Cognitive Prediction in ADNI?
zh_title: ADNI静息态fMRI个体化网络归因的可靠性评估
summary: 在ADNI的875名受试者上评估静息态功能连接认知预测模型的个体化网络消融归因，split-half可靠性近上限，但扫描重测明显下降。

Split-half reliability is near-ceiling (Spearman p=0.948/0.950) but drops on scan-rescan (p=0.609/0.616). zh_abstract: 个体化归因用于估计哪些功能网络驱动了模型对某一受试者的预测，常被提议作为可解释的静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）生物标志物，但其重测信度很少被量化。我们针对一个冻结的静息态功能连接（FC）预测器（以 Schaefer-200 FC 预测 MMSE/ADAS-Cog13，在阿尔茨海默病神经影像学计划（ADNI）的 N=875 名受试者上训练）评估了每名受试者的网络消融归因，并使用了……（原文此处有缺失）以及（iii）受试者水平的置换零模型。折半信度接近上限（Spearman ρ=0.948/0.950），但在扫描-再扫描中下降（ρ=0.609/0.616）。在受试者错配的零模型下，相关性仍然可观（ρ约0.46–0.47），提示存在很强的人群共有结构，但匹配配对仍超出该零模型（z约6.6–6.9，p≤10-4）。因此，在 ADNI 中，个体化网络归因包含一个 m（原文此处截断）

title: PubMedCausal: A Span-Level Annotated Corpus for Causal Relation Extraction in Biomedical Text
zh_title: PubMedCausal：生物医学文本因果关系抽取的跨度级标注语料
summary: 基于PubMed摘要构建跨度级因果关系抽取语料，含3万段落行，并用判别式编码器与开源生成模型做基准评测。
key_points: 3万段落行，含3,945条因果行
6,491个经裁决的因果对，标注原因/结果跨度
评测编码器与开源生成模型的检测与抽取
reason: 新公开语料与基准，但为预印本、规模中等
abstract: Causal relation extraction (CRE) is central to biomedical text mining, but current resources often conflate causal relations with broader associations, restrict annotation to sentence-level examples, or focus mainly on explicit causal cues. This limits their usefulness for evaluating whether models can recover causal claims as they are actually expressed in biomedical text. We introduce PubMedCausal, a span-level annotated corpus for biomedical CRE built from PubMed abstracts. The corpus contains 30,000 paragraph-level rows, including 3,945 causal rows and 6,491 adjudicated cause--effect pairs. Each causal relation is annotated with full-text cause and effect spans, causality type, and sententiality, enabling evaluation of both causal detection and full-span causal extraction. We benchmark discriminative encoders and open-source generative models across detection and extraction settings.
zh_abstract: 因果关系抽取（CRE）是生物医学文本挖掘的核心，但现有资源常常将因果关系与更广泛的关联相混淆，将标注限制在句子级样本，或主要关注显式因果线索。这限制了它们在评估模型能否还原生物医学文本中实际表达的因果论断方面的用途。我们提出了 PubMedCausal，这是一个基于 PubMed 摘要构建的、用于生物医学 CRE 的片段（span）级标注语料库。该语料库包含 30,000 条段落级数据行，其中包括 3,945 条因果行和 6,491 个经裁定的因-果对。每个因果关系均标注了完整文本的原因片段和结果片段、因果类型以及是否跨句（sententiality），从而能够评估因果检测和完整片段的因果抽取。我们在检测和抽取设置下对判别式编码器和开源生成式模型进行了基准测试。

title: OpenGray: a benchmark for evaluating the decisions of radiotherapy planning agents
zh_title: OpenGray：放疗计划智能体决策评估基准
summary: 预印本提出OpenGray基准，在OpenKBP-Opt头颈部数据上加入已知正确决策的任务，评估LLM放疗计划智能体何时提交计划或请求审核，而非仅看剂量。
key_points: 在头颈部数据中加入剂量目标矛盾与可行对照任务
在30例患者上评估4种系统，含商用与本地LLM
同时分析临床智能体SAGE的39次放射外科运行日志
reason: 新基准且方向契合智能体，但规模小、预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Background and purpose: Radiotherapy planning agents based on large language models (LLMs) decide when to submit a plan or request review but are evaluated mainly by dose. This study developed OpenGray, a benchmark of planning tasks with known correct decisions. Materials and methods: OpenGray adds tasks with known answers to the OpenKBP-Opt head-and-neck dataset, including two contradictions with dose goals proven incompatible and a feasible control with a stored plan meeting every hard goal. Four systems, from a rule-based planning script to a full LLM agent, were evaluated on 30 patients, the LLM-based ones with a commercial (Terra) and a local (Ministral 3 8B) LLM. Decisions, achieved dose, problem recognition, and technical failures were recorded and also read from logs of 39 stereotactic radiosurgery runs of SAGE, a clinical LLM agent. Results: With Terra, the script preceded by an
zh_abstract: 【背景与目的】基于大语言模型（LLM）的放射治疗计划智能体需要决定何时提交计划或请求审核，但目前主要以剂量来评估。本研究开发了 OpenGray，这是一个带有已知正确决策的计划任务基准。【材料与方法】OpenGray 在 OpenKBP-Opt 头颈部数据集中增加了带有已知答案的任务，其中包括两种剂量目标被证明相互不相容的矛盾情形，以及一种可行对照情形，其存储的计划满足所有硬性目标。对四个系统（从基于规则的计划脚本到完整的 LLM 智能体）在 30 例患者上进行了评估，其中基于 LLM 的系统分别使用商用 LLM（Terra）和本地 LLM（Ministral 3 8B）。记录了决策、达到的剂量、问题识别情况和技术故障，并同样从临床 LLM 智能体 SAGE 的 39 次立体定向放射外科运行日志中读取了这些信息。【结果】使用 Terra 时，脚本在前置了一个

title: When uncertainty quantification fails: structural vulnerabilities and corrections for selective prediction under clinical class imbalance
zh_title: 不确定性量化失效：类别不平衡下选择性预测的结构缺陷与修正
summary: 预印本指出严重类别不平衡的预后任务中，常规不确定性度量会沦为类别代理、系统性惩罚少数类患者，并在合成数据及三个神经退行性疾病队列上提出修正框架。
key_points: 不确定性分数在不平衡下反映类别而非临床模糊性
覆盖56种合成条件与MS、PD、AD三个队列
提出针对选择性预测的修正框架
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，涉及神经退行性疾病，但证据有限
abstract: Background. Selective prediction systems improve the safety of clinical artificial intelligence by deferring ambiguous cases to human experts while automating high-confidence decisions. However, this safety mechanism relies entirely on the premise that uncertainty scores accurately reflect clinical ambiguity. In prognostic tasks characterized by severe class imbalance, where the clinical outcome of interest is a minority, this assumption breaks down. Standard uncertainty measures cease to capture clinically aligned ambiguity; instead, they become a proxy for class membership, systematically penalizing minority patients regardless of their individual predictive clarity. Results. title: Counting Clues: A Lightweight Probabilistic Baseline Can Match an LLM

We study this through questions from MedQA that ask for the most likely diagnosis. We introduce Frequency-Based Probabilistic Ranker (FBPR), a lightweight method that scores options with a smoothed Naive Bayes over concept-diagnosis co-occurrence statistics from a large corpus. zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在多项选择式临床诊断基准上表现出色，但这种表现在多大程度上反映了其潜在的概率推理能力尚不清楚。我们通过 MedQA 中询问最可能诊断的问题对此进行研究。我们提出了基于频率的概率排序器（Frequency-Based Probabilistic Ranker，FBPR），这是一种轻量级方法，利用来自大规模语料库的概念-诊断共现统计，通过平滑朴素贝叶斯对选项打分。当共现统计来自 OLMo 的预训练语料库 Dolma 以及 LLaMA 预训练数据配方的开放复现版本 RedPajama 时，FBPR 取得了与相应 LLM 相当的性能。此外，LLM 直接推理与 FBPR 表现出互补的优势，二者正确回答的问题子集大不相同，重叠程度仅略高于随机水平。用一种简单的混合方法将二者结合可带来……（原文此处截断）

title: EVA-Flow: Learning Shared Chemistry for Unified Environment-Aware Molecular Conformation Generation
zh_title: EVA-Flow：面向统一环境感知的分子构象生成
summary: 提出EVA-Flow，通过环境条件生成建模学习跨真空、蛋白-配体对接、溶剂化和晶体堆积的共享化学结构，用于分子构象生成。
key_points: 统一框架覆盖多种环境下的分子构象
预训练加跨环境微调，应对数据有限场景
面向药物发现与材料设计
reason: 新方法预印本，药物发现相关，证据有限
abstract: Molecular 3D structures underpin simulations of thermodynamics, kinetics, crystallization, and nucleation, making their accurate prediction central to drug discovery and materials design. However, molecular geometry can change dramatically across environments. Existing models either ignore environmental effects or train separate models for each environment. We hypothesize that transfer learning across contexts is possible for conformer generation and that a general model will perform better when training data are limited, as in ligand binding and crystallization. We introduce EVA-Flow, a unified framework for environment-aware molecular conformation generation that learns shared chemical structure and adapts it through environment-conditioned generative modeling. Across vacuum, protein-ligand docking, solvation, and crystal packing, pretraining and cross-environment finetuning provide their largest gains in the three data-scarce settings. Evaluation against multiple reference conformations shows that EVA-Flow covers a broad range of solvation conformations. Analyses of molecules shared across environments support its ability to generate different conformations for the same molecule in different environments.
zh_abstract: 分子三维结构是热力学、动力学、结晶和成核模拟的基础，因此对其进行准确预测对于药物发现和材料设计至关重要。然而，分子几何构型会随环境发生显著变化。现有模型要么忽略环境效应，要么为每种环境分别训练单独的模型。我们假设，在构象生成任务中可以实现跨环境的迁移学习，并且在训练数据有限的情形（如配体结合和结晶）下，通用模型的表现会更好。我们提出了 EVA-Flow，这是一个用于环境感知分子构象生成的统一框架，它学习共享的化学结构，并通过以环境为条件的生成建模对其进行适配。在真空、蛋白质-配体对接、溶剂化和晶体堆积四种环境中，预训练和跨环境微调在三种数据稀缺的设定下带来的提升最大。针对多个参考构象的评估表明，EVA-Flow 能够覆盖范围广泛的溶剂化构象。对跨环境共有分子的分析支持了其为同一分子在不同环境中生成不同构象的能力。

title: CellTrack-Bench: Microscopic Cell Tracking Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
zh_title: CellTrack-Bench：面向视觉语言模型的显微细胞追踪基准
summary: 提出CellTrack-Bench基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在细胞追踪任务上相对专用追踪算法的表现。
key_points: 涵盖15个标准细胞追踪数据集、4种成像模态
共1,537道题，对应9,041个细胞关联决策
对比VLM与专用追踪器，并选取较难子集
reason: 新基准，VLM评测命中偏好，但为预印本且摘要信息有限
abstract: Large language models have shown outstanding performance on text-first tasks such as coding, math, and writing. Recent efforts are shifting models' training to include scientific problems that often live in highly specialized domains beyond text, such as protein structure and biological images. However, in these scenarios, their general-purpose accuracy compared with specialized algorithms remains in question. One such domain is cell tracking, which requires spatiotemporal awareness of cell dynamics. To evaluate this, we created a new benchmark, CellTrack-Bench, which assesses Vision-Language Models' (VLMs) cell-tracking-related performance against specialized trackers. The full benchmark draws from 15 standard cell-tracking datasets across four imaging modalities and comprises 1,537 problems corresponding to 9,041 cell-linking decisions. We selected a hard subset requiring greater reasoning effort by identifying failures shared across distinct algorithmic trackers. With this proposed dataset, we: (i) evaluated different environment harnesses for VLMs; (ii) benchmarked 9 frontier closed-source models and 13 open-weight models; and (iii) provided a detailed analysis of their failure modes. Code, the stored model outputs, and a pipeline that regenerates the benchmark from the source datasets are available at https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型在编程、数学和写作等以文本为主的任务上表现出色。近期的工作正将模型训练转向包含科学问题，这些问题往往处于文本之外的高度专业化领域，如蛋白质结构和生物图像。然而，在这些场景中，其通用准确性与专用算法相比如何仍存疑问。细胞追踪就是这样一个领域，它需要对细胞动态具有时空感知能力。为评估这一点，我们创建了新的基准 CellTrack-Bench，用于评估视觉-语言模型（VLM）与专用追踪器相比在细胞追踪相关任务上的表现。完整基准取自四种成像模态下的15个标准细胞追踪数据集，包含1,537个问题，对应9,041个细胞连接决策。我们通过识别不同算法追踪器共有的失败案例，选取了需要更多推理投入的困难子集。利用该数据集，我们：（i）评估了VLM的不同环境框架（harness）；（ii）对9个前沿闭源模型和13个开放权重模型进行了基准测试；（iii）对其失败模式进行了详细分析。代码、已存储的模型输出以及可从源数据集重新生成该基准的流程可见 https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Nanobody Engineering for Pathogen Recognition: From Functional Epitope Prioritization to Multimodal Foundation Models.
zh_title: AI驱动的纳米抗体工程：从功能表位到多模态基础模型
summary: 综述 AI 在病原体靶向纳米抗体（VHH）设计中的作用，围绕结构-功能-转化链条，涵盖表位优先级、从头设计及多模态基础模型。
key_points: 聚焦抗原生物学与功能表位优先级
覆盖结构基础、数据资源与从头设计
讨论序列-结构多模态基础模型
reason: 综述上限6档；涉及蛋白设计与基础模型，契合偏好但无新实证
abstract: [Biomolecules] Nanobodies are compact and stable proteins derived from the variable domain of camelid heavy-chain-only antibodies (VHH). Advances in structural biology, molecular modeling, and artificial intelligence (AI) are shifting VHH discovery from empirical selection toward data-driven design. However, predicted binding alone does not ensure biological activity or successful translation, particularly for antigenically variable pathogens. Complementing recent reviews that broadly survey computational VHH modeling and optimization, this review focuses on how antigen biology and functional epitope prioritization can guide the design of pathogen-targeting VHHs. We organize the field along a structure-function-translation continuum, connecting the structural basis of VHH recognition and available data resources with conventional discovery, antigen-guided de novo design, and sequence-structure learning. We further examine how developability, recombinant production, multispecificity, humanization, structural dynamics, and antigenic variation shape the progression from predicted binders to functional VHHs. Finally, we discuss how multimodal foundation models could integrate these dimensions to support the design of functional, manufacturable, and escape-resilient VHHs.

title: From Isolated Intelligence to Interpretive Infrastructure in Radiology AI.
source: PubMed · The British journal of radiology
zh_title: 从孤立智能到解释性基础设施：放射学AI的架构反思
summary: 观点文章指出放射学AI获批工具多但临床影响不稳定，认为瓶颈在架构而非算法，提出基于临床框架的混合编排层。
key_points: 放射学获批AI工具最多，但临床影响不及基准表现
认为问题在于缺乏时间、情境与经验整合及反事实信号
提出基于既有临床框架的混合编排层
reason: 观点类文章，无新数据验证，属常规观点档
abstract: [The British journal of radiology] Radiology has more regulatory-cleared artificial intelligence tools than any other medical specialty, yet they have delivered less consistent clinical impact than their benchmark performance suggested. We argue that the dominant response, scaling perceptual models and extending them toward autonomous agency, mistakes the nature of the problem. The limitation is architectural, not algorithmic: current systems perform isolated perception while remaining disconnected from the temporal, contextual, and experiential integration that interpretation requires. We trace this to a fundamental simulation gap, the absence of the counterfactual signal that lets AI reach superhuman performance in other domains, and argue that scaling alone cannot close it. In response, we outline a hybrid orchestration layer, grounded in established clinical frameworks, that assembles a comprehensive evidence base for the radiologist while keeping generative components constrained and interpretive judgment human. The shift is one of design paradigm: from isolated tools deployed alongside the radiologist to interpretive infrastructure that composes validated outputs into coherent evidence without anchoring the reader's own assessment.

title: Evaluating Bayesian deep learning for robust biomedical time-series classification under distribution shift: A sleep scoring case study
zh_title: 分布偏移下贝叶斯深度学习的生物医学时序分类：睡眠评分案例
summary: 以啮齿类睡眠评分为例，比较九种近似推断方法，评估贝叶斯模型平均在基因型、实验室、物种偏移下的稳健性。
key_points: 比较九种近似推断与两种骨干网络
多盆地方法优于基线和单盆地方法
BMA提升OOD准确率与校准，ID仅小幅提升
reason: 预印本，有系统基线对比和多个OOD数据集，但为动物睡眠数据
abstract: In biomedical time-series classification, machine learning models often suffer from deteriorating accuracy and calibration due to distribution shift. We investigate to what degree Bayesian-inspired deep learning improves robustness through Bayesian model averaging (BMA). Using rodent sleep scoring as a case study, we evaluate BMA under distribution shifts in genotype, laboratory, and species. We systematically compare nine approximate inference methods spanning single- and multi-basin approaches across two neural network backbones on in-distribution (ID) data and five out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. In our results, multi-basin methods perform best, outperforming baselines and single-basin methods. Compared with point estimates, BMA generally improves OOD accuracy and calibration across both architectures, while yielding only modest ID gains. It also often improves selective prediction and OOD and artifact detection, but, interestingly, not inter-rater disagreement detection.
zh_abstract: 在生物医学时间序列分类中，机器学习模型常因分布偏移而出现准确性和校准性下降。我们研究了受贝叶斯启发的深度学习通过贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）在多大程度上提高鲁棒性。以啮齿动物睡眠评分为案例，我们在基因型、实验室和物种的分布偏移下评估 BMA。我们在分布内（ID）数据和五个分布外（OOD）数据集上，针对两种神经网络骨干，系统比较了涵盖单盆地和多盆地方法的九种近似推断方法。结果显示，多盆地方法表现最佳，优于基线方法和单盆地方法。与点估计相比，BMA 在两种架构上总体上提高了 OOD 准确性和校准性，而 ID 方面仅有适度提升。BMA 还常常改善选择性预测以及 OOD 和伪迹检测，但有趣的是，并未改善评分者间分歧的检测。

title: Targeted Deep Regression - Initial Applications in Whole-Body Water-Fat MRI in UK Biobank
zh_title: 靶向深度回归：UK Biobank全身水脂MRI的初步应用
summary: 提出基于ResNet50的图像回归方法，将参考扫描中定义的解剖子区域传播到3万余例颈-膝水脂MRI，估计数值型影像表型。
key_points: ResNet50处理多通道子区域拼图
手动子区域经配准传播到>30,000例扫描
用于扩展UK Biobank影像衍生表型
reason: 大规模队列预印本，方法常规，摘要无外部验证
abstract: UK Biobank is a British clinical study which, in addition to large amounts of medical data collected, plans to include detailed Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) examina- tions from 100,000 participants. The image data can be analyzed for example by auto- mated analysis with neural networks for image segmentation or classification to expand the collection of image-derived phenotypes for medical research. In this work, we pro- pose, present and evaluate a methodology that uses image-based regression to estimate numerical properties from the collected neck-to-knee water-fat MRI scans. It applies a ResNet50-style network to 2D multi-channel collages that represent targeted and study- specific anatomical sub-regions from the MRI scan. The targeted sub-region sampling is achieved by propagating manually defined subregions from a reference scan to the other >30,000 analyzed scans using image registration. The resulting collages can be compact while retaining high-resolution, for example by providing multiple slices of kidney tissue for a kidney volume regression network. This approach also enables group-wise saliency analysis that highlight image and anatomical regions used by the network for the pre- dictions. The method was applied for the regression endpoints of kidney volume, heart volume, and age. Predictive performance was found between R2 = 0.731-0.984 and the group-wise saliency maps were found to highlight medically relevant regions. We con- clude that the method can be used to standardize and restrict the information presented to a deep regression analysis pipeline, increasing information density and opening up a wide range of future medical inference studies.

title: Domain-Adapted Latent Diffusion Models for CT-to-PET Image Translation
zh_title: 用于CT到PET图像转换的域适应潜在扩散模型
summary: 提出域适应潜在扩散框架，用21,930对CT/PET切片迁移自然图像先验，在重建和肿瘤保真度上优于CPDM基线。
key_points: 迁移自然图像先验缓解配对数据稀缺
