reason: 有基线对比的新方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) provides important metabolic information for tumor detection and staging but remains significantly less accessible than Computed Tomography (CT) due to its high cost, infrastructure requirements, and reliance on injected radioactive tracers. CT-to-PET image translation using generative models aims to address this disparity, yet state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods are limited by the scarcity of paired training data. To overcome this, we propose a domain-adapted latent diffusion framework that transfers natural-image priors using a relatively small dataset of 21,930 paired CT/PET slices, incorporating a signed power transform to resolve extreme intensity sparsity in PET data. Compared to CPDM, a state-ofthe-art baseline for CT-to-PET image translation, our approach yields superior performance in pixel-wise reconstruction and localized tumor fidelity, demonstrating effective transfer of natural-image priors to the medical domain. We further provide a systematic analysis of evaluation metric reliability for sparse PET data, showing that standard full-image metrics can be misleading indicators of translated image quality, and propose background-filtered and mask-restricted metrics as more clinically meaningful alternatives.
zh_abstract: 正电子发射断层扫描（PET）为肿瘤检测和分期提供重要的代谢信息，但由于成本高、基础设施要求高以及依赖注射放射性示踪剂，其可及性仍明显低于计算机断层扫描（CT）。利用生成模型进行CT到PET的图像转换旨在缓解这一差距，然而最先进的基于扩散的方法受限于配对训练数据的稀缺。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种领域适应的潜在扩散框架，利用包含21,930对CT/PET切片的相对较小的数据集迁移自然图像先验，并引入带符号幂变换以解决PET数据中极端的强度稀疏问题。与CT到PET图像转换的最先进基线CPDM相比，我们的方法在逐像素重建和局部肿瘤保真度方面表现更优，证明了自然图像先验可有效迁移至医学领域。我们还对稀疏PET数据评价指标的可靠性进行了系统分析，表明标准的全图指标可能会误导对转换图像质量的判断，并提出经背景过滤和掩膜限定的指标作为更具临床意义的替代方案。

title: TransECG-SSL: Hybrid Self-Supervised Representation Learning for ECG Arrhythmia Classification
zh_title: TransECG-SSL：用于心律失常分类的混合自监督表征学习
summary: 提出结合掩码重建与对比学习的Transformer自监督框架，在三个公开ECG数据库的七种源-目标设置下做线性探测评估。
key_points: Transformer编码器用混合目标预训练后冻结
按患者划分，跨三个公开数据库评估
优于随机初始化Transformer，平衡准确率更高
reason: 预印本，有跨数据集评估但仅公开数据，属值得一看档
abstract: Cross-dataset generalisation remains a major challenge for automated electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia classification because of differences in patient populations, acquisition protocols, annotation practices, and class distributions. Learning representations that remain informative across independent datasets could reduce reliance on dataset-specific labelled data. We propose TransECG-SSL, a self-supervised framework for transferable heartbeat representation learning from unlabelled ECG data. A Transformer encoder is pretrained using a hybrid objective combining masked signal reconstruction and contrastive learning, then frozen and evaluated by linear probing under patient-disjoint evaluation. Experiments across three public ECG databases and seven source--target settings show that Hybrid SSL consistently outperforms randomly initialised Transformers and achieves higher balanced accuracy than architecture-matched source-supervised pretraining. Reconstruction-only SSL remains competitive with Hybrid SSL, whereas contrastive-only pretraining performs substantially worse, highlighting the importance of masked reconstruction for transferability. Cross-dataset transfer nevertheless reduces balanced accuracy relative to target-specific self-supervised pretraining, while minority arrhythmia classes remain challenging under severe class imbalance. These findings demonstrate the potential of label-efficient self-supervised learning for cross-dataset ECG representation transfer while highlighting persistent limitations from domain shift and class imbalance.
zh_abstract: 由于患者群体、采集方案、标注实践和类别分布的差异，跨数据集泛化仍是心电图（ECG）心律失常自动分类的一大挑战。学习在独立数据集之间仍具信息量的表征，可减少对特定数据集标注数据的依赖。我们提出TransECG-SSL，一个从未标注ECG数据中学习可迁移心搏表征的自监督框架。Transformer编码器采用结合掩码信号重建与对比学习的混合目标进行预训练，随后冻结，并在患者不重叠的评估下通过线性探测进行评价。在三个公共ECG数据库和七种源—目标设置下的实验表明，混合自监督学习（Hybrid SSL）始终优于随机初始化的Transformer，并且比结构匹配的源域监督预训练取得更高的平衡准确率。仅重建的自监督学习与混合自监督学习相比仍具竞争力，而仅对比学习的预训练表现明显更差，突显了掩码重建对可迁移性的重要性。然而，与针对目标域的自监督预训练相比，跨数据集迁移会降低平衡准确率，同时在严重类别不平衡下少数类心律失常仍具挑战性。这些发现表明，标签高效的自监督学习在跨数据集ECG表征迁移方面具有潜力，同时也凸显了领域偏移和类别不平衡带来的持续局限。

配套开源工具包LumenMorph
reason: 新基准且开源，但为合成数据，医疗关联间接
abstract: Evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction requires ground truth linking camera motion, surface deformation, material correspondence and image appearance. We introduce the Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark, generated with LumenMorph, an open-source toolkit for creating, annotating and evaluating tubular scenes. The release contains 5,580 RGB images. Its baseline crosses three surface-motion conditions with moving and stationary cameras in six scene families; matched appearance variants cover only moving-camera finite-element actions in four families. Documented public and evaluation interfaces expose camera poses, geometry, depth, deformation fields, persistent material correspondences and discrete finite-element records. Persistent triangle identities and material weights let users track the same surface location across frames and query its three-dimensional trajectory. Separately implemented geometric and mechanical checks assess annotation consistency with the generating models. Structure-from-motion, optical-flow and supplied-geometry displacement-interpolation studies demonstrate how the resource distinguishes registration coverage from geometric accuracy, exposes camera- and surface-motion effects, and tests the benefits and mismatch of mechanical priors. Public readers, evaluation contracts and the configurable generator support reuse and extension. Data integrity, fixed-environment repeatability and retained-prediction score replay have distinct verification scopes. The benchmark provides a controlled synthetic reference without claiming anatomical or clinical realism.
zh_abstract: 评估可变形三维重建需要将相机运动、表面形变、材料对应关系和图像外观相联系的真值。我们提出了合成可变形管状基准（Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark），该基准由LumenMorph生成，LumenMorph是一个用于创建、标注和评估管状场景的开源工具包。本次发布包含5,580张RGB图像。其基线在六个场景族中将三种表面运动条件与移动相机和静止相机交叉组合；匹配的外观变体仅涵盖四个场景族中移动相机的有限元动作。文档完备的公共接口和评估接口提供相机位姿、几何、深度、形变场、持久的材料对应关系以及离散的有限元记录。持久的三角形标识和材料权重使用户能够跨帧追踪同一表面位置并查询其三维轨迹。独立实现的几何与力学检查用于评估标注与生成模型之间的一致性。运动恢复结构（structure-from-motion）、光流以及基于所提供几何的位移插值研究表明，该资源能够区分配准覆盖率与几何精度，揭示相机运动和表面运动的影响，并检验力学先验的益处及其失配情况。公共读取器、评估约定和可配置的生成器支持复用与扩展。数据完整性、固定环境下的可重复性以及基于保留预测的评分重放具有各自不同的验证范围。该基准提供了受控的合成参照，但不声称具有解剖学或临床真实性。

title: High Scores, Hidden Failures: Evaluating Codebook-Based LLM Content Analysis
zh_title: 高分之下的隐患：评估基于编码手册的LLM内容分析
summary: 在四个数据集、五个模型上系统分析LLM编码流程的稳定性、鲁棒性与概念效度，发现标准指标下难以察觉的失败模式。
key_points: 覆盖四个数据集与五个模型
高总体分数下存在标签级差异与运行不稳定
存在领域敏感性与标签解释漂移
reason: 计算社会科学类LLM评测，系统但为预印本
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for codebook-based content analysis in computational social science, where codebooks translate theoretical concepts into labeling schemes. While prior work reports strong predictive performance, it remains unclear whether these systems produce reliable and robust text annotations. We conduct a large-scale empirical failure-mode analysis of LLM-based coding pipelines across four datasets and five models by systematically evaluating their stability, robustness, and conceptual validity under controlled perturbations, domain shifts, and optimization procedures. We uncover multiple failure modes that are largely invisible under standard metrics, showing that high aggregate scores frequently coexist with severe label-level disparities, instability across runs, domain sensitivity, and shifts in label interpretation. Importantly, these failure modes persist under widely used optimization strategies and remain largely invisible under standard metrics such as accuracy and micro-F1. Our results demonstrate that current LLM-based coding pipelines cannot be treated as stable measurement tools without targeted validation beyond aggregate performance.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于计算社会科学中基于编码手册的内容分析，其中编码手册将理论概念转化为标注方案。尽管既往研究报告了较强的预测性能，但这些系统能否产生可靠且稳健的文本标注仍不明确。我们针对基于LLM的编码流程开展了大规模实证失效模式分析，涉及四个数据集和五个模型，在受控扰动、领域迁移和优化流程下系统评估其稳定性、稳健性和概念效度。我们发现了多种在标准指标下基本不可见的失效模式，表明较高的总体得分常常与严重的标签层面差异、多次运行间的不稳定性、领域敏感性以及标签解释的偏移同时存在。重要的是，这些失效模式在广泛使用的优化策略下依然存在，并且在准确率和micro-F1等标准指标下基本不可见。我们的结果表明，若不进行超越总体性能的针对性验证，当前基于LLM的编码流程不能被视为稳定的测量工具。

title: SAP-ViT: A Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer for Medical Image Classification
zh_title: SAP-ViT：用于医学图像分类的自归因补丁视觉Transformer
summary: 提出SAP-ViT，以末层补丁嵌入直接聚合替代CLS token，使预测可分解为补丁级贡献，并加稀疏正则；在多个医学图像分类数据集上评估。
key_points: 用补丁嵌入聚合取代CLS token分类
对补丁权重施加稀疏正则以获得简洁证据
引入输入空间回映射估计输入补丁贡献
reason: 有新意的可解释ViT方法预印本，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers commonly rely on a global classification (CLS) token for image-level prediction, which is poorly aligned with local interpretability requirements in medical imaging. We propose SAP-ViT, a Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer that replaces CLS-based classification with direct aggregation of last-layer patch embeddings. This design makes class predictions decomposable into patch-level contributions as part of the forward pass. To encourage concise and readable evidence, SAP-ViT applies sparsity regularization to the patch-weight distribution. Since self-attention mixes information across patch tokens, we further introduce an input-space back-mapping mechanism to estimate which input patches contribute to influential output patch embeddings. We evaluate SAP-ViT qualitatively and quantitatively on multiple medical image classification datasets spanning different imaging modalities. The results show that SAP-ViT maintains strong classification performance while providing consistent and interpretable patch-level explanations across datasets. Ablation results further show that both sparsity regularization and the alignment component of input-space back-mapping contribute to the final explanation quality. Overall, SAP-ViT provides a favorable trade-off between predictive accuracy and interpretability for ViT-based medical image classification.
zh_abstract: 视觉Transformer（ViT）分类器通常依赖全局分类（CLS）token进行图像级预测，这与医学影像中对局部可解释性的要求不相符。我们提出SAP-ViT（自归因补丁视觉Transformer），其以对最后一层补丁嵌入的直接聚合取代基于CLS的分类。该设计使类别预测在前向传播过程中即可分解为补丁级贡献。为获得简洁易读的证据，SAP-ViT对补丁权重分布施加稀疏性正则化。由于自注意力会在补丁token之间混合信息，我们进一步引入输入空间回映射机制，以估计哪些输入补丁对具有影响力的输出补丁嵌入有贡献。我们在涵盖不同成像模态的多个医学图像分类数据集上对SAP-ViT进行了定性和定量评估。结果显示，SAP-ViT在保持较强分类性能的同时，能够在各数据集上提供一致且可解释的补丁级解释。消融结果进一步表明，稀疏性正则化和输入空间回映射的对齐部分均有助于提升最终解释质量。总体而言，SAP-ViT在基于ViT的医学图像分类中，在预测准确性与可解释性之间实现了良好的权衡。

title: EXCISE: Locating and Excising Distracting Sentences in Medical Question Answering
zh_title: EXCISE：定位并剔除医学问答中的干扰句
summary: 预印本提出推理时方法EXCISE，通过阻断对干扰句的注意力，减弱无关句对医学问答模型答案的影响。
key_points: 阻断已知干扰句注意力可恢复答案，而头屏蔽可能抑制正确答案
隐藏状态可将干扰句标为最不契合病例的句子
EXCISE仅在隐藏状态判定不一致时阻断最具影响的句子
reason: 预印本新方法有机制分析，但摘要截断、证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Language models are increasingly considered for clinical decision support, where their answers should be grounded in clinical evidence and remain robust to irrelevant information. Prior work shows that a single irrelevant sentence can lower the accuracy of medical models, but not where inside the model its effect can be removed, or how to do so without knowing which sentence it is. We find that blocking attention to a known distractor restores the answer, whereas head masking can suppress correct answers. We also show that the model's hidden states mark the distractor as the sentence that least fits the case even when the model follows it. To remove a distractor's effect without knowing which sentence it is, we propose EXCISE, an inference-time method that blocks the sentence most influencing the answer, but only if the model's hidden states mark it as inconsistent with the case. On MedQA-TD (MedQA with Targeted Distractors), a benchmark we construct in which each distractor targets a specific wrong option, EXCISE gains 16.7-22.8 accuracy points at a 1.5-2.1-point cost on the same questions without distractors, outperforming prompting, rewriting, and steering baselines for all three models. Its gains extend to MedDistractQA and BiasMedQA, as well as chain-of-thought generation.
zh_abstract: 语言模型越来越多地被考虑用于临床决策支持，在这类场景中，其回答应当以临床证据为依据，并且对无关信息保持稳健。既往研究表明，仅一句无关的句子就可能降低医学模型的准确率，但尚不清楚其影响可以在模型内部的何处被消除，也不清楚在不知道是哪一句的情况下如何消除。我们发现，阻断对已知干扰句的注意力可以恢复答案，而注意力头屏蔽（head masking）则可能抑制正确答案。我们还表明，即使模型遵循了干扰句，其隐藏状态仍会将该干扰句标记为与病例最不相符的句子。为了在不知道干扰句是哪一句的情况下消除其影响，我们提出了 EXCISE，一种推理阶段的方法：它会阻断对答案影响最大的句子，但仅当模型的隐藏状态将该句标记为与病例不一致时才执行。在我们构建的 MedQA-TD（MedQA with Targeted Distractors，带靶向干扰的 MedQA）基准上（其中每条干扰句都针对一个特定的错误选项），EXCISE 使准确率提高了 16.7–22.8 个百分点，而在相同的无干扰问题上仅损失 1.5–2.1 个百分点，在全部三个模型上均优于提示（prompting）、改写（rewriting）和引导（steering）基线方法。其增益也可推广到 MedDistractQA 和 BiasMedQA，以及思维链（chain-of-thought）生成。

title: MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine
zh_title: MedJev：评估医学中零样本“系统一”决策
summary: 评估可在笔记本本地运行的单次前向传播模型MedJev，在十个医学基准及MIMIC-IV任务上与LLM和监督模型比较。
key_points: MedQA 72.5%、USMLE 75.4%、NEJM 80.1%
院内死亡AUROC 0.926，高于XGBoost 0.902
ED分诊等运营类结局弱于监督模型
reason: 有多基准与基线对比的预印本，开源本地模型，证据有限
abstract: System One decision models such as Jev answer structured questions in a single forward pass without generating text, offering fast and computationally efficient clinical decision support. We evaluate MedJev, an open System One model that runs locally on a laptop, across ten medical benchmarks spanning medical knowledge, diagnosis, and patient level prediction using MIMIC IV and MIMIC IV ED. We compare MedJev against zero shot LLM baselines, published GPT results, and supervised models. MedJev achieves accuracies of 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM, approaching published GPT 4 performance while maintaining well calibrated confidence estimates (ECE 0.028 to 0.063). On patient level tasks, MedJev achieves an AUROC of 0.926 for In Hospital Mortality, exceeding XGBoost (0.902), but underperforms supervised models on operational outcomes such as ED Triage
zh_abstract: 诸如 Jev 之类的“系统一”（System One）决策模型无需生成文本，只需一次前向传播即可回答结构化问题，可提供快速且计算高效的临床决策支持。我们评估了 MedJev，这是一种可在笔记本电脑上本地运行的开放“系统一”模型，评估涵盖十个医学基准，涉及医学知识、诊断以及基于 MIMIC IV 和 MIMIC IV ED 的患者水平预测。我们将 MedJev 与零样本大语言模型基线、已发表的 GPT 结果以及监督模型进行了比较。MedJev 在 MedQA 上的准确率为 72.5%，在 USMLE 上为 75.4%，在 NEJM 上为 80.1%，接近已发表的 GPT-4 表现，同时保持了校准良好的置信度估计（ECE 为 0.028 至 0.063）。在患者水平任务中，MedJev 的院内死亡率 AUROC 为 0.926，超过 XGBoost（0.902），但在急诊分诊等运营性结局上表现不及监督模型

title: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
zh_title: 本体引导的多智能体推理用于可解释鉴别诊断
summary: 提出本体引导的多智能体鉴别诊断框架，模拟医生迭代推理，以缓解LLM推理不透明和缺乏临床证据支撑的问题。
key_points: 多智能体框架模拟医生迭代推理
用本体提供结构化、可解释依据
针对LLM生成无依据诊断的问题
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未见评估结果；智能体偏好小幅上调
abstract: Effective differential diagnosis depends on well structured and unambiguous patient case descriptions, since incomplete or ambiguous clinical information readily leads to diagnostic errors and inconsistent reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promising capabilities in medical question answering and clinical reasoning; however, even when achieving competitive performance on medical benchmarks, they often rely on pattern recognition learned from training data rather than grounded clinical evidence, and can generate plausible yet unsupported diagnostic conclusions. Their reasoning remains largely opaque, making it difficult for clinicians to assess the evidence and rationale behind a given recommendation. To address this gap, we propose an ontology-guided, multiagent differential diagnosis framework that replicates the iterative reasoning process of physicians. The fr
zh_abstract: 有效的鉴别诊断依赖于结构良好、表述明确的患者病例描述，因为不完整或含糊的临床信息很容易导致诊断错误和推理不一致。大语言模型（LLMs）近来在医学问答和临床推理方面显示出良好的能力；然而，即使在医学基准测试中取得有竞争力的表现，它们往往依赖从训练数据中习得的模式识别，而非有依据的临床证据，并可能生成看似合理但缺乏支持的诊断结论。其推理过程在很大程度上不透明，使临床医生难以评估某一建议背后的证据和理由。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种由本体引导的多智能体鉴别诊断框架，该框架复现了医生的迭代推理过程。该框架

title: Evaluating Federated Vision-Language and Vision-Only Models for Privacy-Aware Breast Cancer Imaging
zh_title: 面向隐私的乳腺影像联邦视觉语言与纯视觉模型评估
summary: 在两个公开乳腺影像数据集上，比较联邦学习加差分隐私下的CLIP、BiomedCLIP与ViT模型，ROC-AUC为0.940-0.990。

联邦学习结合客户端级差分隐私

We investigate a privacy-aware federated learning framework combining pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with client-level differential privacy. We compare general-purpose CLIP models, biomedical BiomedCLIP, and an ImageNet-pretrained ViT-B/16 baseline on two public breast imaging datasets, with and without differential privacy. We also evaluate a CLIP ViT-B/16 ablation that removes the text pathway. Evaluation includes patient-level ROC-AUC with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, baseline comparisons, threshold sensitivity, inter-model agreement, and communication cost. title: When Slides Met Scans: Cross-Attention for Renal Cancer Prognosis
zh_title: 切片遇上扫描：跨注意力融合用于肾癌预后
summary: 通过双向跨注意力融合组织病理原型与CT标记，在210例TCGA-KIRC中C-index为0.760，在CPTAC外部队列（无CT）为0.629。
key_points: 融合冻结基础模型提取的病理与CT特征
TCGA-KIRC 210例，C-index 0.760
CPTAC 180例外部测试C-index 0.629
reason: 多模态预后方法，样本小、事件少，外部测试缺CT，属值得一看档
abstract: Histopathology and computed tomography (CT) provide complementary views of renal cancer. We connect these modalities through bidirectional cross-attention between 16 histology prototypes and up to 32 kidney-centered CT tokens from frozen foundation models. In 210 TCGA-KIRC patients with 46 disease-specific survival (DSS) events, 5-fold evaluation yielded a C-index of $0.760\pm0.081$ and 3-year AUROC of 0.773 (95\% CI 0.678--0.860), the highest averages among evaluated unimodal and fusion baselines. External testing in 180 CPTAC-CCRCC patients yielded DSS C-index of 0.629 with CT withheld. Attribution analysis linked predictions to image regions while exposing acquisition artifacts. These findings support further study of cross-scale fusion and independent multimodal validation.
zh_abstract: 组织病理学与计算机断层扫描（CT）为肾癌提供了互补的视角。我们通过16个组织学原型与最多32个以肾脏为中心的CT token（来自冻结的基础模型）之间的双向交叉注意力，将这两种模态联系起来。在210例TCGA-KIRC患者（含46例疾病特异性生存[DSS]事件）中，5折评估得到的C-index为$0.760\pm0.081$，3年AUROC为0.773（95% CI 0.678--0.860），在所评估的单模态和融合基线中平均值最高。在180例CPTAC-CCRCC患者中进行外部测试（不使用CT），DSS的C-index为0.629。归因分析将预测结果与图像区域联系起来，同时也揭示了采集伪影。这些发现支持对跨尺度融合及独立的多模态验证开展进一步研究。

title: OA-RAG: Ontology-based Agentic RAG for Faithful LLM Reasoning
zh_title: OA-RAG：基于本体的智能体式RAG以提升LLM推理忠实度
summary: 提出结合本体形式推理与LLM推理的智能体，输出本体证据及支撑程度分级，以减少生物医学等领域的幻觉。
key_points: 利用本体逻辑结构与非正式注释
报告所用本体证据
给出蕴含/支持/相关/无关四级依据
reason: 方法有新意，基于本体基准，预印本证据有限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform well across many real-world tasks but remain prone to hallucination, limiting their reliability in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare, where answers must be grounded in established knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates this problem by incorporating external information, but often overlooks logical relationships and relies heavily on the LLM's own reasoning, which can compromise answer faithfulness. We propose OA-RAG, an agent that integrates formal reasoning with LLM reasoning, drawing on both the logical structure and informal annotations of domain ontologies. For each answer, OA-RAG reports the ontology observations used as evidence and a model-assessed grounding level (entailed, supported, related, or unrelated) that characterises the strength of that evidence. Across benchmarks derived from three large-scale ontologies
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在许多现实任务中表现良好，但仍易产生幻觉，这限制了其在生物医学和医疗等领域的可靠性，因为这些领域的答案必须以既有知识为依据。检索增强生成（RAG）通过引入外部信息缓解了这一问题，但往往忽视逻辑关系，并且严重依赖LLM自身的推理，这可能损害答案的忠实性。我们提出了OA-RAG，这是一种将形式推理与LLM推理相结合的智能体，同时利用领域本体的逻辑结构和非形式化注释。对于每个答案，OA-RAG会报告用作证据的本体观察结果，以及由模型评估的依据程度（蕴含、支持、相关或无关），用以刻画该证据的强度。在源自三个大规模本体的基准测试中

title: Genotypic Triggers: Exposing Pharmacogenomic Blind Spots via Host-Specific Backdoors in Generative Antimicrobial Peptide Models

abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have accelerated drug discovery, particularly in the automated design of antimicrobial peptides (AMPs). However, current validation pipelines for peptide generation models overlook historical precedents showing that certain drugs carry health risks predominantly for individuals with specific genetic profiles. In this paper, we demonstrate that such targeted health risks can be induced intentionally and at scale by manipulating models that generate peptide candidates. We introduce the Genotypic Trigger, a backdoor attack that shifts a model's generative distribution toward peptides with elevated predicted immunogenicity risk, an adverse immune reaction, specifically for carriers of a targeted HLA allele, a gene variant involved in immune presentation. title: MedZERO: Self-Evolving Agents for Open-Ended Medical Reasoning Through Controlled Knowledge Accumulation

summary: 提出由出题Examiner与基于证据多轮推理的Reasoner组成的自进化框架，用于医学开放式推理。

Reasoner进行证据支撑的多轮推理

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering and clinical reasoning, yet their improvement remains constrained by static parametric knowledge and costly expert supervision. Self-evolving agents offer a promising alternative by enabling models to improve through iterative task generation and problem-solving. However, most existing self-evolving methods are designed for easily verifiable domains such as mathematics and coding, where solutions can be checked by exact answers or executable programs. Medical reasoning is fundamentally different: it is open-ended, knowledge-intensive, and often only partially verifiable. We present MedZERO, a self-evolving framework for open-ended medical reasoning. title: Structure, Not Sequence: Tracking and Validating Folding Mechanisms in ESMFold's Trunk with Sparse Autoencoders

abstract: Structure predictors like ESMFold fold proteins using neural network computation and have transformed structural biology. However, the driving mechanism from amino-acid (AA) sequence to 3D structure is insufficiently understood, and biological meaning remains locked in the dense network. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have shown promising results in obtaining interpretable concept features over an overcomplete basis of intermediate protein sequence-model representations. Yet folding models, which predict physical shape from AA sequence semantics, have no such account. We hypothesize that the features carrying the folding computation evolve in the 3D structural regression process. In this paper, we interpret the folding trunk in three steps. zh_abstract: ESMFold 等结构预测器利用神经网络计算折叠蛋白质，已经改变了结构生物学。然而，从氨基酸（AA）序列到三维结构的驱动机制尚未被充分理解，生物学含义仍被锁在稠密的网络之中。稀疏自编码器（SAE）在蛋白质序列模型中间表示的过完备基上获得可解释的概念特征方面已显示出良好前景。然而，从氨基酸序列语义预测物理形状的折叠模型尚无此类解释。我们假设，承载折叠计算的特征在三维结构回归过程中不断演化。本文分三步解释折叠主干（folding trunk）。第一，对各模块和各次循环（recycle）中的表示分布进行预分析，定位主干中不同的空间计算。第二，字典……

title: Reliability-Aware Short-Term Glycemic Risk Prediction Using an Anchor-Based Comparative Framework of Sequence, Multimodal, and State-Updating Digital-Twin Models
zh_title: 基于锚点框架的短期血糖风险可靠性预测与数字孪生模型比较
summary: 基于T1DiabetesGranada数据集构建550余万个预测锚点，在736名1型糖尿病患者上比较三种神经网络预测低/高血糖风险，并评估可靠性。

abstract: Anticipating short-term hypoglycemic and hyperglycemic risk is essential for proactive diabetes management. However, existing machine learning approaches often use inconsistent evaluation protocols and emphasize predictive performance over reliability. This study introduces an anchor-based benchmarking framework integrating longitudinal glucose sequences and multimodal patient information. Using the T1DiabetesGranada dataset, 5,503,441 standardized prediction anchors were constructed from 736 individuals with type 1 diabetes to evaluate hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia prediction at 30-, 60-, and 120-minute horizons. Three neural architectures, a Hybrid LSTM-Transformer, a Multimodal Digital Twin, and a State-Updating Digital Twin with gap-aware longitudinal state progression, were compared under identical patient-level validation protocols. zh_abstract: 预判短期低血糖和高血糖风险对于主动式糖尿病管理至关重要。然而，现有机器学习方法常采用不一致的评估方案，且更强调预测性能而非可靠性。本研究提出一种基于锚点（anchor）的基准测试框架，整合纵向血糖序列与多模态患者信息。利用 T1DiabetesGranada 数据集，从 736 名 1 型糖尿病患者中构建了 5,503,441 个标准化预测锚点，用于评估 30、60 和 120 分钟预测时程下的低血糖和高血糖预测。在相同的患者层面验证方案下，比较了三种神经网络架构：混合 LSTM-Transformer、多模态数字孪生（Multimodal Digital Twin），以及具有间隔感知纵向状态演进的状态更新数字孪生（State-Updating Digital Twin）。除预测性能之外，评估还……

title: UniPro: Unified Multi-Mode Medical Image Segmentation from 2D Images to 3D Volumes via Propagation
zh_title: UniPro：通过传播统一2D到3D的多模式医学图像分割
summary: 提出统一模型UniPro，用传播机制把语义、上下文和交互式分割范式及2D/3D数据维度整合，将2D分割扩展到3D体数据（预印本）。
key_points: 统一语义、上下文、交互式分割范式

reason: 新颖统一分割方法，预印本，摘要未见外部验证细节
abstract: Medical image segmentation remains fragmented along two axes: segmentation paradigms and data dimensionality. Existing methods are typically developed separately for semantic, in-context, and interactive segmentation, and are further specialized to either native 2D images or 3D volumetric data. In clinical practice, however, segmentation workflows take many forms: a case may be initialized by semantic prediction, reference-guided segmentation, or user interaction. Regardless of how it begins, fine-grained refinement is naturally performed on 2D views; for volumetric scans, such 2D edits must propagate coherently to the rest of the volume. We present UniPro, a unified model that bridges segmentation paradigms and data dimensionality, using propagation to extend 2D segmentation to 3D volumes. Our key insight is that volumetric propagation and in-context segmentation share the same referenc
zh_abstract: 医学图像分割在两个维度上仍然是割裂的：分割范式和数据维度。现有方法通常分别针对语义分割、上下文内（in-context）分割和交互式分割单独开发，并进一步专门针对原生二维图像或三维容积数据。然而在临床实践中，分割工作流程形式多样：一个病例可能由语义预测、参考引导分割或用户交互来初始化。无论如何开始，精细化修正自然是在二维视图上进行的；对于容积扫描，这类二维编辑必须连贯地传播到容积的其余部分。我们提出 UniPro，这是一个统一模型，通过传播将二维分割扩展到三维容积，从而桥接分割范式与数据维度。我们的核心见解是，容积传播与上下文内分割共享相同的参考

title: MoveBench: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Sports and Health Coaching

abstract: Despite rapid advances in large language models (LLMs), their deployment in the sports and health domain remains high-risk due to the absence of domain-specific evaluation benchmarks. Existing general-purpose benchmarks (e.g., MMLU and HELM) primarily assess broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities, but fail to capture critical domain requirements such as exercise safety, physiological appropriateness, personalization, and actionable coaching quality. This gap is particularly concerning in fitness and health applications, where incorrect or unsafe recommendations can lead to physical harm. To address this limitation, we introduce MoveBench, the first comprehensive benchmarking framework specifically designed for evaluating LLMs in sports and health coaching. zh_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）发展迅速，但由于缺乏针对特定领域的评估基准，其在运动与健康领域的部署仍然风险很高。现有的通用基准（如 MMLU 和 HELM）主要评估广泛的知识和推理能力，却无法涵盖运动安全、生理适宜性、个性化以及可操作的指导质量等关键领域要求。这一差距在健身与健康应用中尤其令人担忧，因为不正确或不安全的建议可能造成身体伤害。为弥补这一不足，我们提出 MoveBench，这是首个专为评估 LLM 在运动与健康指导中的表现而设计的综合基准框架。该基准整合了异构的任务形式，包括多项选择题（MCQ）和开放式问题

title: Faithful Explanations under Missing Modalities in Multimodal Dementia Prognosis
zh_title: 多模态痴呆预后中缺失模态下解释的忠实性
summary: 在ADNI 307名参与者上，通过遮蔽淀粉样PET、脑脊液等模态，检验LLM生成的预后解释是否忠实，区分幻影归因与不忠实叙述两类失败。

abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to turn the feature attributions of multimodal prognostic models into narratives for clinicians, yet costly modalities such as amyloid PET and cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers are often missing, and whether these explanations stay faithful under missing evidence has not been tested. We separate two failure points: phantom attribution, in which the model credits modalities that were never observed, and unfaithful narration, in which the report omits, cites or misjudges missing modalities. Using 307 participants of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative with complete data, we masked every subset of four costly modalities, predicted 36-month conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease, and restored the masked data to obtain interventional ground truth. zh_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于将多模态预后模型的特征归因转化为面向临床医生的叙述，然而淀粉样蛋白 PET 和脑脊液生物标志物等成本高昂的模态常常缺失，这些解释在证据缺失时是否仍保持忠实尚未得到检验。我们区分了两个失效环节：幻影归因（phantom attribution），即模型将贡献归于从未被观测到的模态；以及不忠实叙述（unfaithful narration），即报告遗漏、引用或错误判断缺失的模态。我们使用阿尔茨海默病神经影像学计划（Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative）中数据完整的 307 名参与者，对四种高成本模态的每一个子集进行遮蔽，预测从轻度认知障碍到阿尔茨海默病的 36 个月转化，并恢复被遮蔽的数据以获得干预性真实标准。全部五种缺失数据处理策略均将 12% 至 23% 的归因

title: KnowMT-Bench: Benchmarking Knowledge-Intensive Long-Form Question Answering in Multi-Turn Dialogues
zh_title: KnowMT-Bench：多轮对话中知识密集型长文问答基准
summary: 提出覆盖医学、金融、法律的多轮长文问答基准，动态生成对话历史；实验显示多轮下事实性与信息传达效率下降。

abstract: Multi-Turn Long-Form Question Answering (MT-LFQA) is a key application paradigm of Large Language Models (LLMs) in knowledge-intensive domains. However, existing benchmarks are limited to single-turn dialogue, while multi-turn dialogue benchmarks typically assess other orthogonal capabilities rather than knowledge-intensive factuality. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce \textbf{KnowMT-Bench}, a new benchmark designed to systematically evaluate MT-LFQA for LLMs across knowledge-intensive fields, including medicine, finance, and law. zh_abstract: 多轮长文本问答（MT-LFQA）是大语言模型（LLM）在知识密集型领域中的一种关键应用范式。然而，现有基准仅限于单轮对话，而多轮对话基准通常评估的是其他正交能力，而非知识密集型的事实性。为弥补这一关键空白，我们提出了 \textbf{KnowMT-Bench}，这是一个旨在系统评估 LLM 在医学、金融和法律等知识密集型领域中 MT-LFQA 能力的新基准。为了如实评估模型在真实世界中的表现，KnowMT-Bench 采用动态评估设置，即在给定逻辑递进的问题序列的情况下，由模型自行生成其多轮对话历史。我们在多种 LLM 上的实验显示，在多轮

title: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
zh_title: CohortFlow：可引导的临床队列筛选智能体与局部语义修正
summary: CohortFlow将自然语言修正表示为结构化队列规格的局部更新，并选择性重算受影响部分；在100个试验入排标准场景中降低延迟，准确率无显著差异。

abstract: Language model agents for clinical cohort curation should accommodate evolving eligibility criteria without repeatedly processing unchanged requirements. We introduce CohortFlow, a steerable agent that represents natural language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification and reconciles them with a persistent execution graph. Explicitly recorded semantic dependencies enable affected computations to be selectively invalidated while preserving valid prior results. On 100 scenarios derived from clinical-trial eligibility criteria, comprising 126 correction turns, localized steering achieves 77.0% requirement micro-F1 versus 76.4% for full regeneration using the same 8B model, a small numerical advantage that is not statistically significant ($p=0.493$). It reduces mean correction latency by 64.8% after completion and 44.3% during execution, with 38.1% fewer model
zh_abstract: 用于临床队列整理的语言模型智能体应能适应不断变化的入选标准，而无需反复处理未改变的要求。我们提出 CohortFlow，这是一种可引导的智能体，它将自然语言修正表示为对结构化队列规范的局部更新，并将其与持久化的执行图进行协调。通过显式记录的语义依赖关系，可以选择性地使受影响的计算失效，同时保留仍然有效的先前结果。在源自临床试验入选标准的 100 个场景（共包含 126 轮修正）上，局部引导在要求层面的 micro-F1 为 77.0%，而使用同一 8B 模型的完全重新生成为 76.4%，该微小的数值优势无统计学显著性（$p=0.493$）。该方法使完成后的平均修正延迟降低 64.8%，执行期间降低 44.3%，且模型

title: Shared clones make random cell halves look reproducible in pooled screens
zh_title: 混池筛选中共享克隆使随机细胞对半拆分看似可重复
summary: 指出Perturb-seq等混池筛选中，随机对半拆分的细胞来自相同克隆，造成伪重复；以空扰动为对照，随机拆分一致性几乎总是很高，而独立重复仅约一半。
key_points: 随机对半拆分共享克隆，构成伪重复
用空扰动对照比较拆分与独立转导重复

reason: 指出扰动模型评估的方法学偏差，有实证对照；预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Single-cell perturbation screens are used to train and evaluate models of perturbation effects, and model scores are judged against the reproducibility of the measured effects. Reproducibility is usually judged by splitting each perturbation's cells into two random halves, assumed to be independent replicates. In pooled screens such as Perturb-seq, the cells carrying a guide RNA descend from a limited number of transduced cells, so two random halves contain the same clones: pseudoreplication whose unit is not marked in the data. Using null perturbations (no expected effect) as controls, we compared random halves with independent replicates from separate transductions, and tested directly with halves that differ only in their clones. In a genome-scale screen of primary T cells, null perturbations agreed between random halves almost always and between independent replicates only half the t
zh_abstract: 单细胞扰动筛选被用于训练和评估扰动效应模型，而模型得分则以所测效应的可重复性作为判断标准。可重复性通常通过将每个扰动的细胞随机分成两半来评估，并假定这两半是相互独立的重复。在Perturb-seq等混池筛选中，携带某一向导RNA（guide RNA）的细胞来源于数量有限的被转导细胞，因此随机分出的两半含有相同的克隆：这是一种伪重复，其单位并未在数据中标注。我们以无效扰动（预期无效应）作为对照，将随机分半与来自独立转导的独立重复进行比较，并直接检验了仅在克隆上存在差异的分半。在一项针对原代T细胞的全基因组规模筛选中，无效扰动在随机分半之间几乎总是一致，而在独立重复之间仅有约一半的情况下一致（原文此处截断）。

title: Escaping cells dilute CRISPR screen responses unequally across cell types

abstract: Single-cell CRISPR screens run in many cell types are used to compare how cell types respond to perturbation, to train models that transfer effects between them and to score such models. These uses assume that cells carrying a guide RNA had their target knocked down. Yet cells grow for days before sequencing: when an essential gene is knocked down, knocked-down cells are depleted or stop dividing while cells that escaped knockdown keep growing, and the measured response, an average over all cells carrying the guide, is diluted. We define the escape fraction of a perturbation as the share of its measured cells whose target was not effectively knocked down, and estimate it from each cell's counts of the targeted gene with a two-group mixture that recovers known fractions in simulated mixtures. title: Xenograft supervision and joint methylation-fragment-end encoding define a reusable molecular scoring layer for cell-free tumor DNA
zh_title: ctDNA-BERT：异种移植监督与甲基化-片段末端联合编码的游离肿瘤DNA评分层
summary: 提出Transformer模型ctDNA-BERT，联合编码CpG甲基化、核苷酸上下文与片段3'端，对单条亚硫酸氢盐测序读段评分，用于游离肿瘤DNA分析。
key_points: 以异种移植提供分子水平肿瘤监督
冻结模型在独立肝癌与III期泛癌血浆中无需重训
在1,477份回顾性样本中区分I期癌症与健康对照
reason: 新方法含独立队列验证，但为回顾性预印本
abstract: Circulating tumor DNA is often scarce in plasma, and regional methylation summaries can obscure informative differences between individual molecules. Here we present ctDNA-BERT, a Transformer that scores individual bisulfite reads without predefined differentially methylated regions by jointly encoding CpG methylation state, nucleotide context and the fragment 3' end. Xenografts provide molecule-level tumor supervision. The resulting frozen scorer supported tumor-fraction estimation in synthetic and patient-derived xenograft mixtures and enriched tumor-concordant methylation and chromatin-accessibility signals in independent hepatocellular carcinoma and stage III pan-cancer plasma without cohort-specific retraining. Features derived from selected reads discriminated stage I cancers from healthy controls in a retrospective cohort of 1,477 specimens, achieving an out-of-fold area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.884. By separating molecular scoring from sample-level inference, ctDNA-BERT provides a reusable read-level scoring layer for cell-free DNA methylation analysis.
zh_abstract: 循环肿瘤 DNA 在血浆中往往含量稀少，而区域性甲基化汇总可能掩盖单个分子之间的信息性差异。在此我们提出 ctDNA-BERT，这是一种 Transformer 模型，通过联合编码 CpG 甲基化状态、核苷酸背景和片段 3′ 端，在无需预先定义差异甲基化区域的情况下对单条亚硫酸氢盐测序读段进行评分。异种移植模型提供了分子水平的肿瘤监督信号。由此得到的冻结评分器支持在合成混合样本和患者来源异种移植混合样本中估计肿瘤分数，并且无需针对特定队列重新训练，即可在独立的肝细胞癌血浆和 III 期泛癌种血浆中富集与肿瘤一致的甲基化和染色质可及性信号。在一项包含 1,477 份样本的回顾性队列中，由所选读段衍生的特征可区分 I 期癌症与健康对照，折外（out-of-fold）受试者工作特征曲线下面积为 0.884。通过将分子评分与样本水平推断分离，ctDNA-BERT 为游离 DNA 甲基化分析提供了一个可重复使用的读段水平评分层。

title: Asking the Data: Conversational Interrogation of LC-MS/MS Proteomics Data Sets with an LLM Agent
zh_title: 向数据提问：用LLM智能体对LC-MS/MS蛋白质组数据集进行对话式审查
summary: 提出数据集审查框架，研究者通过LLM智能体将问题转为可执行检验并留存记录；回顾性应用于四个数据集，发现影响三项自有研究解读的问题。
key_points: 对话式LLM智能体生成可执行检验并对照控制
记录代码、输入与决策
发现数据库缺失、TMT通道互换等问题
reason: 预印本，智能体用于生物医学发现，仅四个数据集回顾性应用
abstract: Proteomics workflows are designed to answer predefined questions, leaving analytical problems that emerge after first results difficult to investigate without additional bioinformatics work. We introduce data set interrogation, a conversational framework in which a researcher uses a large language model (LLM) agent to translate emerging questions into executable tests, check the answers against controls, and keep the code, inputs, and decisions in a dated record. Applied retrospectively to four LC-MS/MS data sets, the framework exposed problems that changed the interpretation of three in-house studies: a search database lacking one of two symbionts, a swapped pair of tandem mass tag (TMT) channels, statistics inflated by non-host proteins, and false deamidation assignments caused by selection of the 13C isotope peak as monoisotopic; the same question asked of every data set revealed failed or partial cysteine alkylation in all three. A public TMT data set was reanalyzed from raw files in 24 min, a feasibility measure without a human comparison; among spectra identified by both workflows, 99.2% received the same peptide assignment as in Proteome Discoverer, and protein fold changes correlated (r = 0.93). In seeded tests, a purpose built channel assignment check detected all 216 between strain channel swaps and none of 90 within-strain swaps. The framework couples natural language interaction with executable analyses, explicit controls, and traceable decisions, enabling researchers to investigate questions not anticipated by the original pipeline. These results establish feasibility in a limited retrospective setting with one researcher; broader evaluation across users, models, and data sets is required to determine general performance.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质组学工作流程旨在回答预先设定的问题，因此在首批结果出来之后才出现的分析问题，若无额外的生物信息学工作则难以研究。我们提出了数据集质询（data set interrogation），这是一种对话式框架：研究者借助大语言模型（LLM）智能体将新出现的问题转化为可执行的检验，对照对照组核查答案，并将代码、输入和决策保存在带日期的记录中。将该框架回顾性应用于四个LC-MS/MS数据集后，揭示了改变三项内部研究解读的问题：搜索数据库缺少两种共生体之一、串联质谱标签（TMT）的一对通道被调换、非宿主蛋白导致统计量虚高，以及因选择13C同位素峰作为单同位素峰而造成的错误脱酰胺归属；对每个数据集提出同一问题后，发现三者均存在半胱氨酸烷基化失败或不完全。一个公开的TMT数据集从原始文件重新分析仅用24分钟，这是一项没有人工对照的可行性指标；在两种工作流程均鉴定到的谱图中，99.2%获得了与Proteome Discoverer相同的肽段归属，蛋白质倍数变化具有相关性（r = 0.93）。在植入式测试中，专门构建的通道归属检查检出了全部216个菌株间通道调换，而90个菌株内调换均未被检出。该框架将自然语言交互与可执行分析、明确的对照和可追溯的决策相结合，使研究者能够研究原有流程未预料到的问题。这些结果确立了其在有限的、由一名研究者进行的回顾性情境中的可行性；要确定其总体性能，仍需在不同用户、模型和数据集上进行更广泛的评估。

title: BLOOM: Biologically Informed Flow Matching for Transcriptomic Virtual Embryo Modeling
zh_title: BLOOM：用于转录组虚拟胚胎建模的生物学先验流匹配
summary: BLOOM通过条件流匹配结合发育与调控先验，生成不同发育阶段的细胞表达分布，在三个小鼠单细胞图谱上评估。
key_points: 在三个小鼠单细胞图谱上评估
与22个时间序列预测基线比较，相关性指标均排名第一
可在时间正反两个方向生成细胞表达分布
reason: 新方法对比基线充分，但为预印本，仅小鼠数据
abstract: Constructing a virtual embryo requires a generative representation of how heterogeneous cell populations change across developmental time. Here we introduce BLOOM, a biologically informed framework for conditional generation of developmental cell populations. BLOOM integrates temporal population context with developmental and regulatory priors through conditional flow matching to generate cell-expression distributions at queried stages in either temporal direction. Evaluation spans three mouse single-cell atlases covering prenatal development, visual-cortex maturation and multi-organ endothelial specialization. In comparisons with 22 time-series forecasting baselines, BLOOM ranks first for gene- and cell-expression correlations across all three datasets. Measured-stage evaluations support recovery of developmental expression patterns, population organization and marker-specific temporal relationships. Biological analyses connect these predictions to cell-state identities, gene programmes and regulatory associations. At unmeasured stages, interpolation and autoregressive history and future rollouts extend simulated expression dynamics between and beyond measured timepoints. Analyses of marker genes and temporal descriptors identify candidate differences in the timing of muscle-associated, neural and vascular-specialization programmes. Input-based gene perturbations further probe predicted responses of edited genes and associated molecular programmes across time. Together, BLOOM supports transcriptomic virtual embryo modeling by bridging temporal sampling gaps, exploring extended developmental trajectories and prioritizing gene-dependent hypotheses for experimental investigation.
zh_abstract: 构建虚拟胚胎需要对异质性细胞群体如何随发育时间变化进行生成式表示。在此我们提出 BLOOM，一个基于生物学信息的、用于条件生成发育细胞群体的框架。BLOOM 通过条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）将时间群体背景与发育和调控先验整合，从而在所查询的阶段沿任一时间方向生成细胞表达分布。评估涵盖三个小鼠单细胞图谱，分别覆盖产前发育、视皮层成熟和多器官内皮特化。与22个时间序列预测基线相比，BLOOM 在所有三个数据集中的基因表达和细胞表达相关性均排名第一。已测量阶段的评估支持其能够恢复发育表达模式、群体组织结构和标志物特异性的时间关系。生物学分析将这些预测与细胞状态身份、基因程序和调控关联联系起来。在未测量阶段，插值以及自回归的历史和未来推演可将模拟的表达动态扩展到已测量时间点之间及其之外。对标志基因和时间描述符的分析识别出肌肉相关、神经和血管特化程序在时间上的候选差异。基于输入的基因扰动进一步探查了被编辑基因及相关分子程序随时间的预测响应。总体而言，BLOOM 通过弥合时间采样空白、探索延伸的发育轨迹并优先筛选依赖基因的假设以供实验研究，支持转录组虚拟胚胎建模。

title: Artificial intelligence in modern medicine: a comprehensive review of technologies, applications, and future directions.
zh_title: 现代医学中的人工智能：技术、应用与未来方向综述
summary: 综述检索 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science（2016–2024），区分回顾性算法表现与前瞻性临床有效性，涵盖影像、药物发现与多组学等。
key_points: 仅纳入同行评审研究与临床试验
DL、NLP、基础模型在回顾性队列中准确率高
AI 加速药物发现并支持多组学整合
reason: 泛泛综述，受综述上限约束，增量有限
abstract: [Personalized medicine] We evaluated the transformative impact of AI modalities on clinical practice, distinguishing between retrospective algorithmic performance and prospective clinical effectiveness. Comprehensive searches were executed [databases searched: January 2016 to October 2024] across PubMed/Medline, Scopus, and Web of Science, identifying peer-reviewed original research and clinical trials. Non-peer-reviewed materials and commercial web sources were strictly excluded. AI technologies-particularly deep learning (DL), natural language processing (NLP), and foundation models-demonstrate high diagnostic accuracy in retrospective cohorts across radiology, dermatology, and pathology. In precision therapeutics, AI accelerates drug discovery and facilitates multi-omics integration for individualized treatment planning. Furthermore, autonomous AI systems have proven cost-effective in nationwide diabetic retinopathy screening programs. However, significant gaps remain between in-silico success and real-world clinical utility. Primary barriers include the lack of prospective randomized trials, pervasive risks of algorithmic bias threatening health equity, the "black box" nature of deep neural networks, and stringent interoperability challenges. AI serves as a potent computational catalyst for advancing personalized medicine. To transition from retrospective experimental success to standard-of-care clinical integration, future research endeavors must prioritize Explainable AI (XAI), federated learning frameworks for privacy preservation, and rigorous prospective clinical validation under standardized regulatory oversight.
zh_abstract: [个体化医学] 我们评估了人工智能（AI）各类模式对临床实践的变革性影响，并区分了回顾性算法性能与前瞻性临床有效性。我们在 PubMed/Medline、Scopus 和 Web of Science 中进行了全面检索［检索时间范围：2016年1月至2024年10月］，纳入经同行评审的原创研究和临床试验；未经同行评审的资料和商业网络来源被严格排除。AI 技术——尤其是深度学习（DL）、自然语言处理（NLP）和基础模型（foundation models）——在放射学、皮肤病学和病理学的回顾性队列中显示出较高的诊断准确性。在精准治疗方面，AI 可加速药物研发，并促进多组学整合以制定个体化治疗方案。此外，自主式 AI 系统已在全国性糖尿病视网膜病变筛查项目中被证明具有成本效益。然而，计算机模拟（in-silico）层面的成功与真实世界临床实用性之间仍存在显著差距。主要障碍包括：缺乏前瞻性随机试验、普遍存在的算法偏倚风险威胁健康公平、深度神经网络的“黑箱”特性，以及严格的互操作性挑战。AI 是推动个体化医学发展的有力计算催化剂。要从回顾性实验成功过渡到标准诊疗中的临床整合，未来研究必须优先发展可解释 AI（XAI）、用于隐私保护的联邦学习框架，并在标准化监管下开展严格的前瞻性临床验证。

title: Artificial intelligence in rational drug discovery: optimization of lead compounds and in-silico prediction of molecular interactions for faster pharmaceutical development.
zh_title: AI在理性药物发现中的应用：先导优化与分子相互作用预测
summary: 综述深度学习与生成模型在药物发现中的应用，包括蛋白-配体相互作用预测、QSAR、虚拟筛选及ADMET预测。
key_points: 涵盖蛋白-配体相互作用与QSAR
涉及虚拟筛选与先导化合物优化
早期预测ADMET以优先排序候选物
reason: 泛泛综述，无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [In silico pharmacology] The conventional drug discovery process is intricate, expensive and time-consuming with high attrition rates. Addressing these inefficiencies has spelled the dawn of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) as game-changers in rational drug design. The review highlights the revolutionary potential of AI techniques such as deep learning and generative models in drug discovery and development. We discuss how AI improves protein-ligand interaction predictions and quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) modelling, as well as virtual screening, in drug discovery. In addition, AI can significantly accelerate lead optimization by predicting critical absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) properties early in the process, allowing for prioritization of promising candidates before time-consuming experimental testing. Although these advancements have been made there still remain several limitations to how broad AI systems are applied in the real world, ranging from data bias and model reliability to the non-interpretability of "black box" neural networks. To overcome these regulatory and ethical challenges, Explainable AI (XAI) must be implemented. In the end, the combination of AI with multi-omics and other technologies such as quantum computing will bring personalized therapy at a much more specific level and significantly shorten the development and research times and costs.
zh_abstract: [In silico pharmacology] 传统药物发现过程复杂、昂贵、耗时，且淘汰率高。为解决这些低效问题，人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）作为合理药物设计的变革者应运而生。本综述强调了深度学习和生成模型等AI技术在药物发现与开发中的革命性潜力。我们讨论了AI如何在药物发现中改进蛋白质-配体相互作用预测、定量构效关系（QSAR）建模以及虚拟筛选。此外，AI可通过在早期预测关键的吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）性质，显著加速先导化合物优化，从而在耗时的实验测试之前对有前景的候选物进行优先排序。尽管已取得这些进展，AI系统在现实世界中的广泛应用仍存在若干局限，包括数据偏倚、模型可靠性以及“黑箱”神经网络的不可解释性。为应对这些监管和伦理挑战，必须采用可解释AI（XAI）。最终，AI与多组学以及量子计算等其他技术的结合，将在更为精准的层面实现个体化治疗，并显著缩短研发时间、降低成本。

title: Deep learning-based breast lesion classification using treatment response assessment maps with uncertainty quantification.
source: PubMed · Journal of medical imaging (Bellingham, Wash.)
zh_title: 基于治疗反应评估图与不确定性量化的乳腺病灶深度学习分类
summary: 利用TCIA的乳腺MRI数据集，以3D ResNet18处理多期DCE-MRI与TRAM图像，并用测试时增强估计不确定性，用于乳腺病灶分类。
key_points: TRAM由延迟增强成像衍生，旨在提升特异性
3D ResNet18提取特征并接全连接分类器
测试时增强估计偶然不确定性并对比影像组学

abstract: [Journal of medical imaging (Bellingham, Wash.)] Dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI) is widely used for breast cancer diagnosis due to its high sensitivity; however, limited specificity often leads to false positives and unnecessary biopsies. Treatment response assessment maps (TRAMs), derived from delayed contrast-enhanced imaging, characterize contrast accumulation and clearance and may improve diagnostic specificity. We utilized the Advanced MRI Breast Lesions dataset from The Cancer Imaging Archive to develop deep learning-based models for breast lesion classification using both multiphase DCE-MRI and TRAM images. A 3D convolutional residual network (ResNet18) was employed for feature extraction, followed by a fully connected classifier. To assess prediction reliability, test-time augmentation was used to estimate aleatoric uncertainty. Radiomics-based models were also implemented for comparison. The TRAM-based deep learning model achieved numerically higher area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (0.870 versus 0.835), sensitivity (0.848 versus 0.818), and specificity (0.823 versus 0.759) compared with DCE-MRI. Radiomics analysis showed similar trends. Uncertainty stratification demonstrated improved performance in low-uncertainty predictions for both modalities, where high-uncertainty DCE-MRI predictions showed a marked performance decline compared with TRAM. These results suggest that TRAM-based deep learning models may provide a promising complementary imaging approach for breast lesion classification. Integration of uncertainty quantification could further enhance reliability, showing the potential of this framework for improving breast cancer diagnosis.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical imaging (Bellingham, Wash.)] 动态对比增强磁共振成像（DCE-MRI）因其高敏感性而被广泛用于乳腺癌诊断；然而，其特异性有限，常导致假阳性和不必要的活检。由延迟对比增强成像得到的治疗反应评估图（TRAM）可表征对比剂的蓄积与清除，可能提高诊断特异性。我们利用癌症影像档案库（The Cancer Imaging Archive）中的 Advanced MRI Breast Lesions 数据集，开发了同时使用多期相 DCE-MRI 和 TRAM 图像的基于深度学习的乳腺病灶分类模型。我们采用三维卷积残差网络（ResNet18）进行特征提取，随后接全连接分类器。为评估预测可靠性，使用测试时增强来估计偶然不确定性。同时还实现了基于影像组学的模型作为比较。与 DCE-MRI 相比，基于 TRAM 的深度学习模型在受试者工作特征曲线下面积（0.870 对 0.835）、敏感性（0.848 对 0.818）和特异性（0.823 对 0.759）上数值更高。影像组学分析显示出相似趋势。不确定性分层显示，两种模态在低不确定性预测中的性能均有所提高，其中高不确定性的 DCE-MRI 预测的性能较 TRAM 明显下降。这些结果提示，基于 TRAM 的深度学习模型可能为乳腺病灶分类提供一种有前景的补充成像方法。整合不确定性量化可进一步提高可靠性，显示出该框架在改善乳腺癌诊断方面的潜力。

title: Health-SCORE: Towards Scalable Rubrics for Improving Health-LLMs
zh_title: Health-SCORE：可扩展的评分细则以改进健康LLM
summary: 提出可扩展的rubric训练与评估框架，降低rubric构建成本，可作为强化学习奖励信号或上下文提示，以改进开放式医疗回答质量。

abstract: Rubrics are essential for evaluating open-ended LLM responses, especially in safety-critical domains such as healthcare. However, creating high-quality and domain-specific rubrics typically requires significant human expertise time and development cost, making rubric-based evaluation and training difficult to scale. In this work, we introduce Health-SCORE, a generalizable and scalable rubric-based training and evaluation framework that substantially reduces rubric development costs without sacrificing performance. We show that Health-SCORE provides two practical benefits beyond standalone evaluation: it can be used as a structured reward signal to guide reinforcement learning with safety-aware supervision, and it can be incorporated directly into prompts to improve response quality through in-context learning. Across open-ended healthcare tasks, Health-SCORE achieves evaluation quality c
zh_abstract: 评分细则（rubric）对于评估大语言模型的开放式回答至关重要，在医疗等安全关键领域尤其如此。然而，创建高质量且针对特定领域的评分细则通常需要大量的人类专家时间和开发成本，使得基于评分细则的评估和训练难以扩展。在这项工作中，我们提出了Health-SCORE，一个可泛化、可扩展的基于评分细则的训练与评估框架，在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅降低了评分细则的开发成本。我们表明，除独立评估之外，Health-SCORE还带来两项实际益处：它可作为结构化奖励信号，通过具备安全意识的监督来指导强化学习；也可直接纳入提示词中，通过上下文学习提升回答质量。在各类开放式医疗任务中，Health-SCORE的评估质量达到

title: CANDOR: Chance-Calibrated Neighborhood Discordance in Frozen Encoders for Medical Imaging
zh_title: CANDOR：冻结医学影像编码器的机会校正邻域不一致性度量
summary: 提出无需训练分类头、通过邻域不一致率评估冻结基础编码器类别可分性的指标，并在11个胸部影像编码器上比较。
key_points: 不依赖AUROC与训练头评估编码器
设计机会水平为1/2的校正不一致率D
在11个胸部编码器上得到0.732–0.927
reason: 影像基础模型评估的新方法，预印本，证据有限；基础模型方向小幅加分
abstract: In medical imaging, one frozen foundation encoder is often reused for many tasks. The encoder is usually chosen by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of a head trained on its features. The AUROC does not measure whether the encoder separates positive from negative images in its feature space. Chance-calibrated neighborhood discordance (CANDOR) measures this separation without training a head. Among images acquired the same way, a positive image is discordant when its k nearest negatives are more similar to it on average than its k nearest positives are. The discordance rate D is the share of discordant positives. When the neighbors come from positive and negative candidate sets of equal size, D has the chance level 1/2 for features without information about the label. With unequal candidate sets, all 11 chest encoders have rates above 1/2 (0.732 to 0.927)

title: PIT-GCL: Protein Interaction using Topological Graph Contrastive Learning
zh_title: PIT-GCL：基于拓扑图对比学习的蛋白质相互作用预测

abstract: Protein binding prediction is central to target identification, therapeutic binder design, and large scale screening, yet remains challenging because binding depends on sequence, three dimensional geometry, and global structural organization. Recent folding models such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 have substantially improved structure prediction, but their confidence outputs (pLDDT, pTM, ipTM) are not specifically designed for binary binding prediction, and dedicated structure aware predictors often require bound complex structures that are unavailable at screening scale. We introduce PIT-GCL, a dual tower structure aware framework that encodes each protein independently from its amino acid sequence, Cα point cloud, and a global persistent homology descriptor. Each tower combines residue ESM-2 embeddings with a topological summary computed from the H0 and H1 persistence landscapes of a Viet
zh_abstract: 蛋白质结合预测对于靶点识别、治疗性结合剂设计和大规模筛选至关重要，但仍具挑战性，因为结合取决于序列、三维几何结构和整体结构组织。近期的折叠模型如 AlphaFold3 和 Boltz-2 显著改进了结构预测，但其置信度输出（pLDDT、pTM、ipTM）并非专为二元结合预测而设计，而专用的结构感知预测器往往需要在筛选规模下无法获得的结合复合物结构。我们提出 PIT-GCL，这是一个双塔结构感知框架，可根据氨基酸序列、Cα 点云和全局持续同调描述符独立编码每个蛋白质。每个塔将残基级 ESM-2 嵌入与由 Viet（原文截断）的 H0 和 H1 持续景观（persistence landscapes）计算得到的拓扑摘要相结合

title: NucShare: A Shared-Decoder Framework for Lightweight Nuclei Instance Segmentation
zh_title: NucShare：共享解码器的轻量细胞核实例分割
summary: 提出共享单一解码器的细胞核分割框架，以UNI2-h教师蒸馏至34.7M参数学生模型，在PanNuke上保留99.1%教师mPQ。

abstract: Nuclei instance segmentation underpins quantitative pathology, yet its accuracy currently comes at a large parameter cost, and both the encoder and the per-task decoders must shrink where compute or latency is constrained. We present NucShare, centred on a single U-Net-style decoder shared by the nuclear pixel, horizontal-vertical, and classification tasks, with only a lightweight head per task. Sharing matches or slightly exceeds three independent decoders using 37% of their parameters. With a UNI2-h encoder it forms the teacher NucShare-T, with 690.5M parameters; the student NucShare-S keeps the decoder and adopts an off-the-shelf ConvNeXt V2-Tiny encoder, totalling 34.7M, transferring knowledge through output-level distillation. On PanNuke, NucShare-S retains 99.1% of the teacher's mPQ at 0.519, above CFR-SAM-H's 0.511; it runs 27.5x faster per tile than the teacher and reaches a zero
zh_abstract: 细胞核实例分割是定量病理学的基础，但其精度目前以巨大的参数量为代价，在算力或延迟受限的场景中，编码器和各任务解码器都必须缩减。我们提出NucShare，其核心是一个类U-Net的单一解码器，由细胞核像素、水平-垂直方向和分类三项任务共享，每项任务仅配备一个轻量级头部。共享解码器的性能与三个独立解码器相当或略优，而参数量仅为后者的37%。以UNI2-h作为编码器时构成教师模型NucShare-T，参数量为690.5M；学生模型NucShare-S保留该解码器，并采用现成的ConvNeXt V2-Tiny编码器，总计34.7M参数，通过输出层面的蒸馏迁移知识。在PanNuke上，NucShare-S保留了教师模型99.1%的mPQ，为0.519，高于CFR-SAM-H的0.511；其每个图块的运行速度比教师模型快27.5倍，并达到零（原文此处截断）

title: From Presence Labels to Bounding Boxes: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Scale Surgical Instrument Localization?
zh_title: 从有无标签到边界框：多模态大模型能否规模化手术器械定位
summary: 提出基于MLLM的标注框架，将手术帧与已有器械存在标签转为边界框，在Cholec80腹腔镜胆囊切除上用六个MLLM评估其可靠性、成本与设计敏感性。
key_points: 以现有器械存在标签为输入生成边界框

reason: 预印本，新颖的MLLM手术标注方法，有系统分析，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Spatial localization of surgical instruments through bounding-box annotations is a foundational component of surgical scene understanding, supporting detection, tracking, interaction analysis, and grounded vision-language applications. Yet existing annotations often cover selected frames, video subsets, or dataset variants rather than complete procedures. Manual extension is time-consuming and expert-dependent. Additionally, weakly supervised and detector-based pseudo-labels require task-specific training and may be imprecise. In this study, we design a scalable MLLM-based annotation framework that converts surgical frames and existing instrument-presence labels into accurate bounding boxes, and systematically analyze its reliability, cost, and design sensitivity. We instantiate the framework using six MLLMs and a multi-call configuration on laparoscopic cholecystectomy in Cholec80. Usin
zh_abstract: 通过边界框标注对手术器械进行空间定位，是手术场景理解的基础组成部分，支持检测、跟踪、交互分析以及基于视觉-语言的定位应用。然而，现有标注往往仅覆盖选定的帧、视频子集或数据集变体，而非完整的手术过程。人工扩展标注耗时且依赖专家。此外，弱监督和基于检测器的伪标签需要针对特定任务进行训练，且可能不够精确。在本研究中，我们设计了一个可扩展的、基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的标注框架，将手术帧和现有的器械存在标签转换为准确的边界框，并系统分析其可靠性、成本和设计敏感性。我们使用六种MLLM及多次调用配置，在Cholec80的腹腔镜胆囊切除术数据上实例化该框架。使用（原文此处截断）

summary: 在9个医学影像数据集、11个跨域场景中评估10种UDA算法与13种无标签选择方法，共训练超8万个模型；发现存在良好适应模型，但无标签下难以选出。预印本，未经同行评审。

评估10种UDA算法、13种验证器、超8万模型

abstract: Deploying unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) in clinical practice requires choosing which algorithm to use and which of its trained models to ship. However, the deployment (target) domain is unlabeled, so models cannot be evaluated directly on it, leaving it unclear which to select. We address this by evaluating the complete UDA pipeline, considering both adaptation and label-free selection together. Our study covers eleven clinically relevant cross-domain scenarios from nine medical imaging datasets, with ten UDA algorithms and 13 label-free selection methods (validators), evaluating over 80,000 trained models in total. By this, we find that a capable adapted model usually exists, but identifying it without target labels is difficult: the validator-selected models leave a large and structural target performance gap to the best available one, with no evaluated validator consistently re
zh_abstract: 在临床实践中部署无监督域适应（UDA），需要选择使用哪种算法以及采用其训练得到的哪个模型。然而，部署（目标）域没有标签，无法直接在其上评估模型，因此难以确定应选择哪一个。我们通过评估完整的 UDA 流程来解决这一问题，同时考虑域适应和无标签选择。我们的研究涵盖来自九个医学影像数据集的十一个临床相关跨域场景，包含十种 UDA 算法和 13 种无标签选择方法（验证器），共评估了超过 80,000 个训练模型。由此我们发现，通常存在性能良好的适应后模型，但在没有目标域标签的情况下识别它十分困难：验证器所选模型与可得最佳模型之间在目标域性能上存在较大且具有结构性的差距，且没有任何被评估的验证器能够持续……（原文此处截断）

title: MicroWorld: Empowering Multimodal Large Language Models to Bridge the Microscopic Domain Gap with Multimodal Attributed Property Graph
zh_title: MicroWorld：用多模态属性属性图弥合显微领域差距

key_points: 用scispaCy或LLM抽取生物医学实体与关系

abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show remarkable potential for scientific reasoning, yet their performance in specialized domains such as microscopy remains limited by the scarcity of domain-specific training data and the difficulty of encoding fine-grained expert knowledge into model parameters. To bridge the gap, we introduce MicroWorld, a framework for structured-knowledge augmentation with a complementary visual retrieval pathway, using a multimodal attributed property graph (MAPG) without domain-specific fine-tuning. MicroWorld extracts biomedical entities and relations via scispaCy or LLM-based triplet mining, aligns images and entities in a shared embedding space using Qwen3-VL-Embedding, and assembles a knowledge graph comprising approximately 106K nodes and 2.62M typed edges spanning eight relation categories. At inference time, a graph-augmented retrieval pipeline match
zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在科学推理方面展现出显著潜力，但在显微成像等专业领域，其表现仍受限于领域特定训练数据的稀缺，以及难以将细粒度的专家知识编码进模型参数。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 MicroWorld，这是一个利用多模态属性属性图（MAPG）、并配合互补视觉检索通路的结构化知识增强框架，无需领域特定微调。MicroWorld 通过 scispaCy 或基于 LLM 的三元组挖掘提取生物医学实体及关系，利用 Qwen3-VL-Embedding 在共享嵌入空间中对齐图像与实体，并构建了一个包含约 10.6 万个节点和 262 万条带类型边、涵盖八类关系的知识图谱。在推理时，图增强检索流程匹配

title: FRIGID: Scaling Diffusion-Based Molecular Generation from Mass Spectra at Training and Inference Time
zh_title: FRIGID：基于质谱的扩散式分子生成及训练与推理扩展
summary: 提出以扩散语言模型从串联质谱生成分子结构的框架，在数亿无标注结构上训练，并用正向碎裂模型在推理时通过重掩码与去噪进行迭代优化。

abstract: Tandem mass spectrometry is prominent in scientific discovery workflows for identifying unknown small molecules, yet high-throughput structural elucidation remains challenging. While recent autoregressive and graph diffusion models have shown promise in de novo elucidation, performance remains limited by poor scalability during both training and inference time. In this work, we present FRIGID, a framework with a novel diffusion language model that generates molecular structures conditioned on mass spectra via intermediate fingerprint representations and determined chemical formulae, training at the scale of hundreds of millions of unlabeled structures. We then demonstrate how forward fragmentation models enable inference-time scaling by identifying spectrum-inconsistent fragments and refining them through targeted remasking and denoising. While FRIGID already achieves strong performance
zh_abstract: 串联质谱在用于鉴定未知小分子的科学发现工作流程中地位突出，但高通量结构解析仍具挑战性。尽管近期的自回归模型和图扩散模型在从头解析方面显示出前景，其性能仍受限于训练和推理阶段较差的可扩展性。在本工作中，我们提出 FRIGID，这是一个采用新型扩散语言模型的框架，该模型以质谱为条件，通过中间的指纹表示和已确定的化学式生成分子结构，并在数亿个未标注结构的规模上进行训练。随后我们展示了前向碎裂模型如何通过识别与谱图不一致的碎片，并通过有针对性的重新掩码和去噪对其进行优化，从而实现推理时扩展。尽管 FRIGID 已经取得了很强的性能

title: Artificial Intelligence for Therapeutic Peptide Discovery and Development.
zh_title: 人工智能用于治疗性多肽的发现与开发
summary: 批判性综述AI在多肽药物各类别中的应用，比较序列、化学、图、结构感知及多模态表示，强调多肽开发不止于序列生成。
key_points: 覆盖受体激动剂、抗菌肽、大环肽等类别
比较预测、生成与实验整合的方法
指出稳定性、递送、安全性等限制因素
reason: 有信息量的综述，命中药物发现方向，综述上限6
abstract: [Biomolecules] Therapeutic peptides combine biological specificity with chemical versatility, and artificial intelligence (AI) now contributes to their identification, design, and optimisation. Peptide discovery, however, cannot be reduced to generating amino-acid sequences: therapeutic performance also depends on chemistry, conformation, assay context, stability, delivery, safety, manufacturability, and in vivo exposure. This critical review examines AI use across the major peptide classes: receptor agonists, protein-protein interaction inhibitors, oncology and tumour-targeting peptides, antimicrobial and phenotype-driven peptides, delivery peptides, vaccine epitopes, self-assembling materials, and chemically constrained macrocycles. It compares sequence-based, chemical, graph, structure-aware, and multimodal representations across predictive, generative, and experimentally integrated workflows. Coverage spans recent general protein foundation, prediction, and design systems (ProtGPT2, ESM-2/ESM3, ProGen/ProGen2, ProteinMPNN, RFdiffusion, and AlphaFold 3) and peptide-focused methods (RFpeptides, PepFlow, and PepGLAD). Particular attention is given to benchmark integrity, the limits of structure prediction for short and non-canonical molecules, and the gap between retrospective and prospective evidence. To make claims comparable, the review adapts established reporting, validation, and readiness concepts into a peptide-specific, two-dimensional Peptide-AI Evidence Grid that separates methodological rigour (M0-M3) from translational depth (T0-T3), applies it to representative studies, and provides a checklist extending DOME, TRIPOD + AI, and FAIR guidance with the chemistry- and assay-specific items peptide work requires.
zh_abstract: [Biomolecules] 治疗性肽兼具生物学特异性和化学多样性，人工智能（AI）目前已用于其识别、设计和优化。然而，肽类药物发现不能简化为生成氨基酸序列：治疗效果还取决于化学性质、构象、检测情境、稳定性、递送、安全性、可制造性和体内暴露。本批判性综述考察了AI在主要肽类中的应用：受体激动剂、蛋白-蛋白相互作用抑制剂、肿瘤学和肿瘤靶向肽、抗菌肽和表型驱动肽、递送肽、疫苗表位、自组装材料以及受化学约束的大环化合物。综述比较了预测性、生成性和实验整合工作流中基于序列、化学、图、结构感知和多模态的表示方法。内容涵盖近期通用蛋白质基础模型、预测和设计系统（ProtGPT2、ESM-2/ESM3、ProGen/ProGen2、ProteinMPNN、RFdiffusion和AlphaFold 3）以及聚焦肽的方法（RFpeptides、PepFlow和PepGLAD）。特别关注基准的完整性、结构预测对短肽和非经典分子的局限性，以及回顾性证据与前瞻性证据之间的差距。为使各项主张具有可比性，本综述将既有的报告、验证和成熟度概念调整为肽特异性的二维“肽-AI证据网格”（Peptide-AI Evidence Grid），将方法学严谨性（M0-M3）与转化深度（T0-T3）区分开来，并将其应用于代表性研究，同时提供了一份清单，在DOME、TRIPOD + AI和FAIR指南的基础上扩展了肽类研究所需的化学和检测特异性条目。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Acute Coronary Syndromes: From Early Diagnosis to Culprit Lesion Characterization, Coronary Physiology, and Risk Stratification.
zh_title: 急性冠脉综合征中的人工智能：从早期诊断到风险分层
summary: 综述AI在ACS全流程的应用，包括AI心电图检测OMI、结合肌钙蛋白的早期排除、冠脉影像斑块量化及风险预测。
key_points: AI心电图可提高OMI检出
模型结合临床数据与高敏肌钙蛋白
AI辅助OCT/IVUS判读与斑块量化
reason: 叙述性综述，上限6，内容泛泛属增量档
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is being investigated across the acute coronary syndrome (ACS) care pathway, including early diagnosis, coronary lesion characterization, procedural guidance, and risk prediction. This comprehensive review examines the current evidence across the entire ACS trajectory, with particular emphasis on clinically actionable and interventional applications. AI-enabled electrocardiography (ECG) may improve detection of myocardial infarction, including occlusion myocardial infarction (OMI) that does not meet conventional STEMI criteria. Models combining clinical data and high-sensitivity troponin may improve early rule-out and rule-in. In coronary imaging, AI can quantify plaque characteristics and assist with the interpretation of OCT and IVUS, while image-derived physiology may help assess non-culprit lesions. However, better diagnostic accuracy does not necessarily translate into better revascularization decisions. AI-based models can also estimate post-ACS ischemic, bleeding, and mortality risk, although evidence that their use improves treatment or outcomes remains limited. The next priority is prospective evaluation of whether these tools improve decisions, workflow, and patient outcomes across diverse clinical settings.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能（AI）正被广泛研究应用于急性冠脉综合征（ACS）诊疗全流程，包括早期诊断、冠状动脉病变特征分析、操作指导和风险预测。本综述全面审视了贯穿ACS整个病程的现有证据，并特别强调具有临床可操作性及介入相关的应用。基于AI的心电图（ECG）可能改善心肌梗死的检出，包括不符合传统STEMI标准的闭塞性心肌梗死（OMI）。结合临床数据与高敏肌钙蛋白的模型可能改善早期排除和确诊。在冠状动脉影像方面，AI可以量化斑块特征并辅助解读OCT和IVUS，而基于影像的生理学评估可能有助于评估非罪犯病变。然而，更高的诊断准确性并不一定转化为更好的血运重建决策。基于AI的模型还可以估计ACS后的缺血、出血和死亡风险，但关于其应用能否改善治疗或结局的证据仍然有限。下一步的重点是开展前瞻性评估，检验这些工具能否在多样化的临床环境中改善决策、工作流程和患者结局。

title: Artificial intelligence and machine learning for magnetic nanoparticles and nanocarriers in cancer imaging, drug delivery, and magnetic control: a systematic review.
zh_title: 磁性纳米颗粒癌症成像与递送中的AI/机器学习：系统综述
summary: PRISMA系统综述纳入65项研究，梳理AI/ML在MRI可见磁性纳米颗粒的成像、药物递送、热疗和磁控中的应用，证据集中于边界明确的任务。
key_points: 7个数据库2,283条记录筛选出65项研究
预测稳定性、毒性、弛豫率、SAR、药物释放等
磁性与弛豫率预测、SPION成像等任务证据最强
reason: 系统综述但纳入研究多为孤立终点，领域偏窄，属增量档
abstract: [Beilstein journal of nanotechnology] We reviewed artificial intelligence and machine learning in magnetic resonance imaging-visible magnetic nanoparticles, nanocarriers, and systems for imaging, drug delivery, hyperthermia, targeting, transport, and control. Using "preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analyses (PRISMA) 2020" methods, 2,283 records from seven databases yielded 65 studies. Predicted outcomes were colloidal stability, toxicity, uptake, magnetic descriptors, specific absorption rate, relaxivity, MRI signal, superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticle (SPION) quantification, drug release, biodistribution, and magnetic navigation. Evidence was strongest in bounded tasks: magnetic-property and relaxivity prediction, image-derived SPION mapping, hyperthermia modelling, and controlled magnetic transport. Most studies optimised isolated endpoints rather than integrating stability, MRI visibility, drug loading, release, tumour delivery, safety, and therapeutic response. External validation across datasets, laboratories, particle batches, biological models, scanners, and patient cohorts remains limited.
zh_abstract: [Beilstein纳米技术杂志] 我们综述了人工智能和机器学习在磁共振成像可视的磁性纳米颗粒、纳米载体及系统中的应用，涉及成像、药物递送、热疗、靶向、转运和控制。采用“系统评价和荟萃分析优先报告条目（PRISMA）2020”方法，从七个数据库检索到 2,283 条记录，最终纳入 65 项研究。被预测的结果包括胶体稳定性、毒性、摄取、磁性描述符、比吸收率、弛豫率、MRI 信号、超顺磁性氧化铁纳米颗粒（SPION）定量、药物释放、生物分布和磁导航。证据在边界明确的任务中最为充分：磁性和弛豫率预测、基于图像的 SPION 图谱绘制、热疗建模以及受控磁转运。大多数研究优化的是孤立的终点，而非整合稳定性、MRI 可视性、载药量、释放、肿瘤递送、安全性和治疗反应。跨数据集、实验室、颗粒批次、生物学模型、扫描仪和患者队列的外部验证仍然有限。

title: Fusion of Deep Learning Radiomics and Clinical Features for Individualized Prediction of Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Response in Osteosarcoma.
zh_title: 融合深度学习影像组学与临床特征预测骨肉瘤新辅助化疗反应
summary: 回顾性纳入198例骨肉瘤患者，用治疗前T2加权MRI与临床数据，比较12种CNN，DenseNet121交叉验证AUC最高（0.775），并与临床变量融合建模。
key_points: 回顾性研究，198例，治疗前T2 MRI
DenseNet121平均交叉验证AUC 0.775
用Grad-CAM++与SHAP提供可解释性
reason: 单中心小样本回顾性，仅交叉验证；治疗反应预测略加分
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Stage IIB conventional osteosarcoma exhibits highly heterogeneous responses to neoadjuvant chemotherapy, necessitating reliable, noninvasive pre-treatment evaluation systems. Methods: This retrospective study of 198 patients utilized pre-treatment T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and baseline clinical data. Twelve classical convolutional neural network architectures were benchmarked to identify the optimal imaging backbone. This selected radiomics score was then integrated with core clinical variables using logistic regression to construct a multimodal model. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping++ (Grad-CAM++) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) algorithms provided image- and feature-level interpretability. Results: DenseNet121 achieved the highest mean cross-validated area under the curve (AUC; 0.775) and was selected, with AUCs of 0.797 (95% CI: 0.716-0.877) and 0.701 (95% CI: 0.513-0.877) in the training and test cohorts. Adding the clinical variables improved discrimination, yielding a test-cohort AUC of 0.827 (95% CI: 0.661-0.992) with significant reclassification gain over the radiomics-only model (NRI = 1.28, IDI = 0.177; DeLong p = 0.011). Grad-CAM++ activation concentrated on the solid medullary and extraosseous soft-tissue components, and SHAP ranked the radiomics score as the strongest contributor. Conclusions: Integrating deep learning radiomics with key clinical features provides a noninvasive tool for the individualized prediction of neoadjuvant chemosensitivity in osteosarcoma.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景】IIB期经典型骨肉瘤对新辅助化疗的反应高度异质，因此需要可靠的无创治疗前评估系统。【方法】这项回顾性研究纳入198例患者，利用治疗前T2加权磁共振成像（MRI）和基线临床数据。对12种经典卷积神经网络架构进行基准测试，以确定最优的影像主干网络。随后将所选的影像组学评分与核心临床变量通过逻辑回归整合，构建多模态模型。梯度加权类激活映射++（Grad-CAM++）和SHapley加性解释（SHAP）算法提供了图像层面和特征层面的可解释性。【结果】DenseNet121取得了最高的平均交叉验证曲线下面积（AUC；0.775）并被选用，其在训练集和测试集中的AUC分别为0.797（95% CI：0.716-0.877）和0.701（95% CI：0.513-0.877）。加入临床变量后区分能力提高，测试集AUC为0.827（95% CI：0.661-0.992），相较仅用影像组学的模型具有显著的重分类增益（NRI = 1.28，IDI = 0.177；DeLong p = 0.011）。Grad-CAM++激活集中于实性髓内成分和骨外软组织成分，SHAP将影像组学评分列为贡献最大的因素。【结论】将深度学习影像组学与关键临床特征相结合，可为骨肉瘤新辅助化疗敏感性的个体化预测提供一种无创工具。

title: Evaluation of Large Language Model Concordance With AAOS Clinical Practice Guidelines for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome.
zh_title: 大语言模型与AAOS腕管综合征指南的一致性评估
summary: 四种LLM对252条腕管综合征推荐的回答由两名盲评者分级，72.6%与AAOS指南一致。
key_points: 评估ChatGPT-4、Gemini、Claude-3、Mistral-7B
共252条推荐，72.6%一致
采用χ2检验与Cohen's κ
reason: 单病种问答评估，无临床结局，属增量档
abstract: [Hand (New York, N.Y.)] Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Mistral are increasingly used to obtain medical information, but their accuracy in carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS) management is uncertain. This study evaluated whether LLM-generated recommendations align with American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS) clinical practice guidelines (CPGs). Four LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Gemini, Claude-3, Mistral-7B) were queried with standardized prompts derived from AAOS CTS CPGs. Each prompt was asked 3 times per model, and responses were synthesized. Two blinded reviewers graded outputs as concordant, discordant, or indeterminate, with disagreements resolved by consensus. Concordance distributions were compared using χ2 testing with Bonferroni correction. Inter-rater reliability was measured with Cohen's κ. Across 252 recommendations, 72.6% were concordant, 11.5% discordant, and 15.9% indeterminate. ChatGPT achieved the highest concordance (92.1%) and lowest discordance (1.6%), while Mistral performed poorest (52.4% concordance, 17.5% discordance). Reviewer agreement was excellent (κ = 0.91). Over 1 in 4 LLM-generated CTS recommendations were not concordant with AAOS CPGs. ChatGPT outperformed other models, though variable performance underscores the need for clinician oversight and careful validation before clinical use.
zh_abstract: [Hand (New York, N.Y.)] 大型语言模型（LLM），如ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude和Mistral，越来越多地被用于获取医学信息，但其在腕管综合征（CTS）管理方面的准确性尚不确定。本研究评估了LLM生成的建议是否与美国矫形外科医师学会（AAOS）临床实践指南（CPG）一致。使用源自AAOS CTS CPG的标准化提示词向四种LLM（ChatGPT-4、Gemini、Claude-3、Mistral-7B）提问。每个提示词对每个模型询问3次，并对回答进行综合。两名盲法评审者将输出分级为一致、不一致或不确定，分歧通过协商解决。采用χ2检验并进行Bonferroni校正比较一致性分布。以Cohen's κ衡量评审者间信度。在252条建议中，72.6%一致，11.5%不一致，15.9%不确定。ChatGPT的一致性最高（92.1%）、不一致率最低（1.6%），而Mistral表现最差（一致性52.4%，不一致率17.5%）。评审者间一致性极佳（κ = 0.91）。超过四分之一的LLM生成的CTS建议与AAOS CPG不一致。ChatGPT优于其他模型，但表现的差异凸显了在临床使用前需要临床医生监督和审慎验证。

title: Demystifying Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Health care: Is AI Friend or Foe?
zh_title: 揭开医疗AI的神秘面纱：是朋友还是敌人？
summary: 通过对AI相关文献的元综合，探讨AI在医疗领域的应用及公众对隐私、安全与信任的担忧。

指出公众对网络安全与隐私的担忧

reason: 泛泛综述性观点文章，无新数据
abstract: [Professional case management] The literature review is saturated with positive tones about the use of AI not only in health care but also in all aspects of our daily lives as well. The positivity range is extensive, ranging from increased accuracy, efficiency, productivity, profitability to creativity, equity, and advancement. Yet, the public is circumspect with continual exposure to news about cybersecurity threats or attacks, identity theft, violations of privacy, and challenges of establishing trust in their daily encounters with technology amidst prevalence of deep fakes, voice cloning, and AI-generated images or videos of people. A meta-synthesis of AI-related literature inclusive of expert panels is examined as an exploratory search for AI applicability and use in the health care landscape. The purpose of this article is to demystify AI highlighting areas of its use in health care, ways for clinicians specifically, care managers to bridge that divide and ascertain key practice standards with emphasis on its ethical use in health care. The settings using AI that were considered in this article include Health plans, Hospitals, medical practices or clinics, and Hospitals' Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). Implications and recommendations for case management engagement in AI are addressed relative to the standards of practice (SOPs).
zh_abstract: 【专业病例管理】文献综述中充斥着对人工智能（AI）应用的积极论调，这不仅限于医疗保健领域，也涉及我们日常生活的各个方面。这种积极性涵盖范围广泛，从准确性、效率、生产力、盈利能力的提升，到创造力、公平性和进步。然而，公众仍持审慎态度，因为他们不断接触到有关网络安全威胁或攻击、身份盗窃、隐私侵犯的新闻，并且在深度伪造、语音克隆以及AI生成的人物图像或视频盛行的情况下，在日常接触技术时面临建立信任的挑战。本文对包括专家小组在内的AI相关文献进行了元综合分析，作为对AI在医疗保健领域适用性和使用情况的探索性检索。本文旨在揭开AI的神秘面纱，重点介绍其在医疗保健中的应用领域，探讨临床医生（特别是照护管理者）如何弥合这一鸿沟，并确定关键的实践标准，重点关注其在医疗保健中的伦理使用。本文所考虑的使用AI的场景包括健康计划、医院、医疗机构或诊所，以及医院的收入周期管理（RCM）。本文结合实践标准（SOPs）阐述了病例管理参与AI的意义和建议。

abstract: [npj metabolic health and disease] Glucose homeostasis depends on coordinated genetic and epigenetic regulation of pancreatic beta-cells, insulin-sensitive tissues, and neuroendocrine circuits. This review synthesises evidence from over 600 GWAS loci and the primary literature published between 2008 and 2026, and emerging single-cell functional genomics, CRISPR-based perturbation screens, deep-learning variant-effect predictors (DeepSEA, Enformer, AlphaGenome), and polygenic risk frameworks to explain insulin secretion, insulin signalling, and diabetes susceptibility, converting GWAS associations into mechanistic insight and genotype-guided precision therapies.
zh_abstract: [npj metabolic health and disease] 葡萄糖稳态依赖于胰腺β细胞、胰岛素敏感组织和神经内分泌回路的遗传与表观遗传协同调控。本综述综合了600多个GWAS位点的证据以及2008年至2026年间发表的原始文献，并结合新兴的单细胞功能基因组学、基于CRISPR的扰动筛选、深度学习变异效应预测工具（DeepSEA、Enformer、AlphaGenome）和多基因风险框架，以阐释胰岛素分泌、胰岛素信号转导和糖尿病易感性，将GWAS关联转化为机制性认识和基因型指导的精准治疗。

title: Explainable Multimodal AI Approach to Reduce Unnecessary Breast Biopsies
zh_title: 可解释多模态AI减少不必要的乳腺活检
summary: 提出结合ViT影像与DeBERTa报告文本的多模态模型，用Grad-CAM解释，预测BI-RADS 4/5患者活检是否为良性。
key_points: ViT提取乳腺X线特征，DeBERTa-V3-Large提取报告文本

reason: 单中心院内数据，仅内部评估，预印本；多模态VLM略加分
abstract: Recently, there has been rise in multimodal vision-language models for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD), yet their application in breast diagnosis, particularly for predicting biopsy outcomes remains limited. This study presents a multimodal vision-language approach, incorporating Grad-CAM as an Explainable AI (XAI) technique, to predict benign tumors in patients recommended for biopsy, especially those classified as BI-RADS 4 and 5. A novel multimodal framework was devel- oped using Vision Transformer (ViT) for imaging feature extraction and DeBERTa-V3-Large for textual embeddings. The model was trained and evaluated on a comprehensive in-house dataset comprising 1,632 patients, each with four mammography views and a corresponding radiology report. The features of both modalities were extracted independently and fused by late fusion before classification. Grad-CAM was used to generate visual explanations highlighting key regions influencing model predictions. The proposed model demonstrated high sensitivity 90%, 95%, 99%, and 100% with corresponding specificities of 40%, 36%, 18%, and 11%, respectively. The best AUC achieved was 0.72 by multimodal approach on the test set, outperforming the image only (0.66) and text-only (0.68) baselines. The proposed multimodal architecture, enhanced with Grad-CAM, demonstrates a strong potential to identify benign tumors among high-risk patients, offering interpretable insights and thereby helping reduce unnecessary biopsies, patient anxiety, and healthcare costs.
zh_abstract: 近来，用于计算机辅助诊断（CAD）的多模态视觉-语言模型日益增多，但其在乳腺诊断中的应用，尤其是预测活检结果方面仍然有限。本研究提出一种多模态视觉-语言方法，并结合 Grad-CAM 作为可解释 AI（XAI）技术，用于预测被建议活检的患者（尤其是 BI-RADS 4 类和 5 类患者）中的良性肿瘤。我们开发了一种新型多模态框架，采用视觉 Transformer（ViT）提取影像特征，采用 DeBERTa-V3-Large 生成文本嵌入。模型在一个包含 1,632 例患者的综合性内部数据集上进行训练和评估，每例患者均有四个乳腺X线摄影体位及相应的放射学报告。两种模态的特征分别独立提取，并在分类前通过后期融合（late fusion）进行整合。Grad-CAM 用于生成视觉解释，突出显示影响模型预测的关键区域。所提出的模型表现出 90%、95%、99% 和 100% 的高敏感度，对应的特异度分别为 40%、36%、18% 和 11%。在测试集上，多模态方法取得的最佳 AUC 为 0.72，优于仅用图像（0.66）和仅用文本（0.68）的基线。结合 Grad-CAM 的所提多模态架构在识别高风险患者中的良性肿瘤方面显示出较强潜力，可提供可解释的见解，从而有助于减少不必要的活检、患者焦虑和医疗费用。

abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is routinely used to diagnose spinal disorders, but surgical planning often requires Computed Tomography (CT) for better visualization of vertebral bone anatomy. Synthesizing CT from MRI could avoid additional radiation exposure and streamline preoperative assessment. We propose a three-stage framework for spine MRI-to-CT synthesis. First, an anatomy-guided vertebral matching system identifies similar sagittal MRI and CT slices using spine segmentations and aligns them through rigid registration, creating pseudo-paired data from unpaired scans. Second, these pairs train an adversarial diffusion model for MRI-to-CT translation. Third, synthesized slices are assembled into 3D volumes and refined by a network that improves inter-slice continuity and structural coherence. zh_abstract: 磁共振成像（MRI）常规用于诊断脊柱疾病，但手术规划往往需要计算机断层扫描（CT）以更好地显示椎骨解剖结构。由 MRI 合成 CT 可避免额外的辐射暴露，并简化术前评估。我们提出了一个用于脊柱 MRI 到 CT 合成的三阶段框架。第一，基于解剖引导的椎骨匹配系统利用脊柱分割结果识别相似的矢状位 MRI 和 CT 切片，并通过刚性配准对其进行对齐，从而由非配对扫描生成伪配对数据。第二，利用这些配对数据训练用于 MRI 到 CT 转换的对抗扩散模型。第三，将合成的切片组装成三维体积，并通过一个网络进行优化，以改善切片间的连续性和结构一致性。该框架在超过 10,000 张非配对的矢状位 MRI 和 CT 切片上进行了训练并评估

title: TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information

abstract: Many real-world decisions require teams to integrate information distributed across participants. Yet AI agents are still primarily trained and benchmarked in isolation. We introduce TeamGym, an environment for evaluating and training language model-based agents on team decision-making problems constructed from real-world legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora. TeamGym introduces a method to identify a minimal set of facts, each element of which is necessary and all of which are collectively sufficient for a correct final decision, which we call pivotal information. This enables TeamGym to both control the distribution of pivotal information and track how well agents identify and integrate pivotal information when making team decisions. Examining 8 language models on 12 source corpora, we find that current AI agents often fail to effectively share information: Distribu
zh_abstract: 现实世界中的许多决策需要团队整合分散在不同参与者之间的信息。然而，AI 智能体目前仍主要是在孤立环境中进行训练和基准测试。我们提出了 TeamGym，这是一个用于评估和训练基于语言模型的智能体的环境，其团队决策问题由真实世界的法律、金融、医学和软件工程语料构建而成。TeamGym 引入了一种方法，用于识别一个最小事实集合，其中每个元素都是必要的，且这些事实合在一起足以得出正确的最终决策，我们称之为关键信息（pivotal information）。这使得 TeamGym 既能控制关键信息的分布，又能追踪智能体在做出团队决策时识别和整合关键信息的能力。通过在 12 个来源语料上考察 8 个语言模型，我们发现当前的 AI 智能体常常无法有效地共享信息：分布

Conventionally, it is measured by adding membrane-impermeable dyes to a sample (a process called staining), which allows compromised cell membranes to be distinguished from intact ones. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) are widely used for medical image segmentation. However, they lack an inherent measure of confidence. Existing methods for estimating prediction uncertainty often require a custom network architecture and/or dedicated training setups and need to be trained from scratch. In addition, the deduction of a single confidence score per input from the uncertainty maps is not always straightforward. In this study, we explore voxel-based uncertainty estimation methods that can be added to existing segmentation pipelines without training from scratch. We also propose a novel method to estimate a single confidence score from the uncertainty maps. Our evaluations on different ROIs and modalities suggest that our confidence score can predict segmentation performance in unseen data.
zh_abstract: 卷积神经网络（CNN）被广泛用于医学图像分割。然而，它们缺乏内在的置信度度量。现有的预测不确定性估计方法通常需要定制的网络架构和/或专门的训练设置，并且需要从头开始训练。此外，从不确定性图中为每个输入推导出单一置信度分数并不总是直截了当。在本研究中，我们探索了可添加到现有分割流程中而无需从头训练的基于体素的不确定性估计方法。我们还提出了一种从不确定性图中估计单一置信度分数的新方法。我们在不同感兴趣区域（ROI）和成像模态上的评估表明，我们的置信度分数可以预测在未见数据上的分割性能。

abstract: LLM agents in interactive entertainment and social applications, including companions, role-play characters, and persona clones, need decisions grounded in personality and past experiences.
