In the main evaluation, models receive character IDs and occupations, scenarios, and options, with retrieved memories added in memory-augmented settings. abstract: [Journal of imaging] Automated lesion segmentation can support rapid and reproducible quantitative assessment and long-term monitoring of multiple sclerosis. Ultra-high-field 7T MRI provides increased spatial resolution and lesion visibility but introduces challenges for automated analysis, including field inhomogeneity, susceptibility-related artifacts, and spatially varying image contrast. Although deep learning methods perform well at conventional field strengths, their application to 7T MRI remains underexplored. We evaluated nnUNet using FLAIR alone, MP2RAGE alone, and combined MP2RAGE+FLAIR. The dataset included 115 longitudinal 7T MRI scans from 57 patients with MS, with 20 scans from 11 independent patients reserved for testing. DeepMedic was included as a comparative architecture. On the test set, nnUNet achieved mean DSC values of 0.72, 0.71, and 0.66 for combined, MP2RAGE-only, and FLAIR-only inputs, respectively. No significant DSC differences were observed between nnUNet and DeepMedic. For both architectures, adding FLAIR to MP2RAGE did not show a statistically significant additional benefit in the present test cohort, whereas MP2RAGE-containing inputs significantly outperformed FLAIR-only input. The findings of the present study provide preliminary evidence suggesting that the observed voxel-level segmentation performance was primarily associated with the inclusion of MP2RAGE. However, lesion-level performance depended on lesion size, indicating further investigation of contrast-specific effects on small-lesion detection.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging] 自动化病灶分割可支持多发性硬化的快速、可重复的定量评估和长期监测。超高场7T MRI提供了更高的空间分辨率和病灶可见度，但也给自动化分析带来了挑战，包括场不均匀性、磁化率相关伪影以及空间上变化的图像对比度。尽管深度学习方法在常规场强下表现良好，但其在7T MRI中的应用仍研究不足。我们评估了nnUNet分别使用单独FLAIR、单独MP2RAGE以及MP2RAGE+FLAIR联合输入的表现。数据集包括来自57例MS患者的115份纵向7T MRI扫描，其中来自11例独立患者的20份扫描留作测试。DeepMedic作为对比架构纳入。在测试集上，nnUNet在联合输入、仅MP2RAGE输入和仅FLAIR输入下的平均DSC值分别为0.72、0.71和0.66。nnUNet与DeepMedic之间未观察到显著的DSC差异。对于两种架构，在本测试队列中，在MP2RAGE基础上加入FLAIR并未显示出具有统计学意义的额外获益，而包含MP2RAGE的输入显著优于仅FLAIR输入。本研究结果提供了初步证据，提示所观察到的体素水平分割性能主要与是否包含MP2RAGE相关。然而，病灶水平的表现取决于病灶大小，提示需要进一步研究不同对比度对小病灶检测的影响。

title: DeepAVPred: A Deep Learning Framework Integrating RECM-DWT and BiGRU for Accurate Antiviral Peptide Prediction.
source: PubMed · International journal of molecular sciences
zh_title: DeepAVPred：融合RECM-DWT与BiGRU的抗病毒肽预测
summary: 提出深度学习框架DeepAVPred，结合残基能量矩阵小波特征与BiGRU识别抗病毒肽，旨在提升预测准确性。
key_points: 提出RECM-DWT新特征表示
整合理化性质与残基对相互作用描述符
用于抗病毒肽计算识别
reason: 增量档：新特征的肽预测方法，摘要未见外部验证细节
abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] Viral infections continue to pose a significant global health challenge. Antiviral peptides (AVPs) have emerged as promising therapeutic agents owing to their high specificity, favorable safety profiles, and broad-spectrum antiviral activity. However, experimental AVP identification is time-consuming and costly, while existing computational predictors often have limitations in predictive accuracy and feature representation. Here, we propose DeepAVPred, a deep learning-based framework for AVP identification. DeepAVPred integrates complementary sequence descriptors to capture physicochemical properties and pairwise residue interactions. We present a novel feature representation, the Residue Energy Content Matrix augmented with a Discrete Wavelet Transform (RECM-DWT). RECM-DWT characterizes multi-scale patterns in residue-energy information and complements conventional sequence descriptors by providing wavelet-derived features across multiple resolution levels. The integrated features are then modeled using an attention-based Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) network to learn contextual dependencies and informative sequence patterns. On the AVPtrain dataset, DeepAVPred achieved strong performance in 10-fold cross-validation, with an accuracy of 0.990, a Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) of 0.980, and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.993. On the independent test dataset, AVPtest, DeepAVPred achieved an accuracy of 0.942, an MCC of 0.886, and an AUC of 0.949. These results demonstrate the predictive performance of DeepAVPred and support its potential as a computational framework for prioritizing candidate antiviral peptides for further experimental validation.
zh_abstract: [国际分子科学杂志] 病毒感染仍然是全球面临的重大健康挑战。抗病毒肽（AVPs）因其高特异性、良好的安全性和广谱抗病毒活性，已成为有前景的治疗药物。然而，AVP 的实验鉴定耗时且成本高昂，而现有的计算预测方法在预测准确性和特征表示方面往往存在局限。在此，我们提出 DeepAVPred，一种基于深度学习的 AVP 识别框架。DeepAVPred 整合了互补的序列描述符，以捕捉理化性质和残基对之间的相互作用。我们提出了一种新的特征表示方法，即结合离散小波变换的残基能量含量矩阵（Residue Energy Content Matrix augmented with a Discrete Wavelet Transform，RECM-DWT）。RECM-DWT 可刻画残基能量信息中的多尺度模式，并通过提供跨多个分辨率层级的小波衍生特征，对传统序列描述符形成补充。随后，整合后的特征由基于注意力机制的双向门控循环单元（BiGRU）网络建模，以学习上下文依赖关系和具有信息量的序列模式。在 AVPtrain 数据集上，DeepAVPred 在 10 折交叉验证中表现优异，准确率为 0.990，马修斯相关系数（MCC）为 0.980，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为 0.993。在独立测试数据集 AVPtest 上，DeepAVPred 的准确率为 0.942，MCC 为 0.886，AUC 为 0.949。这些结果证明了 DeepAVPred 的预测性能，并支持其作为一种计算框架，用于对候选抗病毒肽进行优先排序以便进一步开展实验验证。

title: DocTalk: Enhancing Medical Knowledge Retrieval via Fine-tuned Large Language Models with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Robust Clinical Decision Support
zh_title: DocTalk：基于LoRA微调与思维链的出院小结问答系统
summary: 预印本提出面向医生的出院小结问答系统DocTalk，构建500个QA对，并对六个开源LLM做LoRA指令微调前后评估。
key_points: 基于去标识化出院小结生成有据可依的回答
构建500对问答，含专家审核与思维链提问
评估3个通用与3个生物医学开源模型的LoRA微调
reason: 预印本，数据仅500对QA，规模小，属增量档
abstract: Objective: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) in healthcare has opened new possibilities for AI-assisted clinical decision-making; however, safe and effective deployment remains challenging because of hallucination and domain misalignment. This study introduces DocTalk, a doctor-assistive question-answering (QA) system designed to generate concise, chart-grounded responses from de-identified discharge summaries. Methods: We developed a high-fidelity data generation pipeline that produces 500 clinically relevant QA pairs through sentence-level decomposition, chain-of-thought-guided question formulation, and expert review. Six open-source LLMs, including three general-purpose and three biomedical models, were evaluated before and after parameter-efficient instruction tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). The framework integrates prompt engineering, in-context learning, and medically aligned evaluation to support factual and interpretable responses. Results: On DocTalk-QA, instruction tuning produced consistent improvements across lexical, semantic, and clinical fidelity metrics. The best-performing tuned model, Llama-3-Med42-8B, achieved ROUGE-L = 0.40, BERTScore-F1 = 0.76, and UMLS-F1 = 0.49. To examine external generalization beyond the DocTalk-QA dataset, the two best-performing models, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-Med42-8B, were evaluated on PubMedQA before and after instruction tuning. Accuracy improved from 0.931 to 0.977 for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and from 0.935 to 0.943 for Llama-3-Med42-8B. Conclusion: DocTalk was deployed as a secure web-based platform for interactive EHR querying. These findings suggest that clinically grounded instruction tuning can improve medical QA performance and support practical clinical decision support.
zh_abstract: 【目的】大语言模型（LLM）在医疗领域的快速发展为人工智能辅助临床决策开辟了新的可能；然而，由于幻觉和领域不匹配问题，其安全有效的部署仍具挑战。本研究介绍了 DocTalk，这是一种面向医生的辅助问答（QA）系统，旨在基于去标识化的出院小结生成简洁、以病历为依据的回答。【方法】我们开发了一条高保真数据生成流程，通过句子级分解、思维链引导的问题构建和专家审核，生成了500个具有临床相关性的问答对。我们评估了六个开源 LLM（包括三个通用模型和三个生物医学模型）在使用低秩适应（LoRA）进行参数高效指令微调前后的表现。该框架整合了提示工程、上下文学习以及与医学对齐的评估，以支持生成符合事实且可解释的回答。【结果】在 DocTalk-QA 上，指令微调在词汇、语义和临床保真度指标上均带来一致的提升。表现最佳的微调模型 Llama-3-Med42-8B 取得了 ROUGE-L = 0.40、BERTScore-F1 = 0.76 和 UMLS-F1 = 0.49。为检验 DocTalk-QA 数据集之外的外部泛化能力，对表现最佳的两个模型 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Llama-3-Med42-8B 在指令微调前后于 PubMedQA 上进行了评估。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的准确率从 0.931 提高到 0.977，Llama-3-Med42-8B 的准确率从 0.935 提高到 0.943。【结论】DocTalk 已作为安全的网页平台部署，用于交互式电子病历查询。这些发现提示，以临床为基础的指令微调可以提升医学问答性能，并支持实际的临床决策支持。

title: Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence
zh_title: 超越联邦学习：面向自进化临床智能的去中心化智能体系统
summary: 预印本观点文章提出去中心化智能体系统（DAS），主张跨机构共享抽象推理轨迹而非原始数据或模型参数。
key_points: 主张从数据聚合转向经验聚合
各机构智能体共享抽象推理轨迹
对比联邦学习的梯度平均范式
reason: 预印本观点文章，无实证验证，智能体方向略加分
abstract: Clinical expertise is inherently distributed: it resides not in any single dataset or institution but in the accumulated reasoning experiences of thousands of clinicians navigating diverse patient populations, resource constraints, and evolving treatment protocols. Yet current approaches to scaling medical AI, from centralized large language models to federated learning, remain anchored to a data-centric paradigm that treats knowledge as static parameters to be aggregated. In this Perspective, we argue for a fundamental shift from data aggregation to experience aggregation. We propose Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS), a framework in which distributed AI agents operating across healthcare institutions synthesize collective clinical intelligence by sharing abstracted reasoning trajectories rather than raw data or model parameters. Unlike federated learning, which averages numerical gradients across homogeneous model architectures, DAS exchanges structured records of clinical reasoning, specifically the sequence of observations, hypotheses, tool invocations, and outcome feedback that constitute diagnostic experience. We examine the architectural principles, deployment considerations, governance requirements, and critical open challenges of this framework, laying the groundwork for a collaborative medical AI ecosystem where distributed expertise autonomously adapts to the complexities of longitudinal patient care.
zh_abstract: 临床专业知识本质上是分布式的：它并不存在于任何单一数据集或机构中，而是存在于成千上万名临床医生在应对不同患者群体、资源限制和不断演变的治疗方案过程中积累的推理经验之中。然而，目前扩展医疗 AI 的方法，从集中式大语言模型到联邦学习，仍然固守以数据为中心的范式，将知识视为需要聚合的静态参数。在本观点文章中，我们主张从数据聚合转向经验聚合。我们提出去中心化智能体系统（Decentralized Agentic Systems，DAS）这一框架，其中跨医疗机构运行的分布式 AI 智能体通过共享抽象化的推理轨迹（而非原始数据或模型参数）来综合集体临床智能。联邦学习是在同质模型架构之间对数值梯度取平均，与之不同，DAS 交换的是结构化的临床推理记录，具体而言是构成诊断经验的观察、假设、工具调用和结果反馈序列。我们考察了该框架的架构原则、部署考量、治理要求和关键的未决挑战，为构建协作式医疗 AI 生态系统奠定基础，使分布式专业知识能够自主适应纵向患者照护的复杂性。

title: Low-rank MERA Decomposition of 3D OCT Image Volume for Compression, Denoising, Feature Extraction and Diagnosis of Retinal Diseases
zh_title: 基于低秩MERA分解的3D OCT体数据压缩、去噪与诊断
summary: 提出低秩MERA张量网络表示3D OCT体数据，联合实现压缩、去噪、特征提取并用于视网膜疾病诊断。
key_points: 张量网络表示全局特征与B扫描间相关性
同时支持压缩、去噪与特征提取
面向远程眼科存储与传输需求
reason: 方法新颖但为预印本，证据有限
abstract: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a non-invasive imaging modality used for visualization of retinal tissue. However, OCT volumes are affected by speckle noise, which degrades image contrast and obscures fine structural details. Furthermore, modern clinical practice requires large field-of-view, high-resolution OCT volumes, whose storage and transmission are demanding for archiving and teleophthalmology applications. To address aforementioned challenges, we propose a low-rank multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA) tensor network approximation of 3D OCT image volume, where the image volume is represented as contractions of a top core factor encoding global features and multiple interacting low-rank orthogonal or semi-orthogonal factors modeling inter- and intra-B scan correlations. This representation jointly enables compression, denoising, and feature extraction. Unlike deep learning approaches, the proposed approach is training-free and processes each OCT volume independently. We evaluate the proposed framework on OCT image volumes acquired by two different scanners and demonstrate improved visual quality and reduced retinal layer segmentation errors in comparison with several competing methods. We also extract MERA features from two clinical OCT volume datasets. They are subsequently classified using a Grassmann-manifold nearest-subspace classifier. With the subspace dimension as its only hyperparameter, the classifier is theoretically shown to be robust in small-sample clinical scenario. We demonstrate competitive accuracy of classification of retinal diseases in these small-sample settings, where deep learning methods are often limited by the scarcity of labeled data. The proposed structure-aware model-driven representation learning for high-dimensional data under limited supervision provides good generalization performance while maintaining high interpretability.
zh_abstract: 光学相干断层扫描（OCT）是一种用于视网膜组织可视化的无创成像方式。然而，OCT 体数据受散斑噪声影响，会降低图像对比度并掩盖精细的结构细节。此外，现代临床实践需要大视野、高分辨率的 OCT 体数据，其存储和传输对于归档和远程眼科应用而言要求很高。为应对上述挑战，我们提出一种对三维 OCT 图像体数据的低秩多尺度纠缠重整化拟设（MERA）张量网络近似：图像体数据被表示为一个编码全局特征的顶层核心因子，与多个相互作用、用于建模 B 扫描间及 B 扫描内相关性的低秩正交或半正交因子的收缩。该表示可同时实现压缩、去噪和特征提取。与深度学习方法不同，所提方法无需训练，并且独立处理每个 OCT 体数据。我们在两种不同扫描仪采集的 OCT 图像体数据上评估了所提框架，结果显示，与若干对比方法相比，其视觉质量有所改善，视网膜层分割误差有所降低。我们还从两个临床 OCT 体数据集中提取了 MERA 特征，随后使用 Grassmann 流形最近子空间分类器对其进行分类。该分类器以子空间维度作为唯一超参数，理论上已证明其在小样本临床场景中具有鲁棒性。在深度学习方法常因标注数据稀缺而受限的这些小样本设置下，我们展示了其在视网膜疾病分类方面具有竞争力的准确性。所提出的这种在有限监督下针对高维数据的结构感知、模型驱动的表示学习方法，在保持高可解释性的同时具有良好的泛化性能。

title: O2D-MedNet: An Optimization-Aware Dual-Domain Framework for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: O2D-MedNet：面向稳健医学图像分割的优化感知双域框架
summary: 提出融合傅里叶与小波域特征的双域分割框架，包含退化感知交互模块和跨骨干轮廓引导融合模块。
key_points: 傅里叶与小波域特征交互以抑制退化
跨骨干轮廓引导融合模块
针对复合退化与多尺度变化设计
reason: 预印本分割方法改进，摘要未见外部验证
abstract: Medical image segmentation (MIS) remains challenging due to composite degradations and multi-scale geometric variations, which jointly impair lesion-background separability, structural consistency, and optimization stability. Existing single-stream frameworks entangle heterogeneous cues within a single representation pathway, while hybrid-stream approaches often rely on generic or static fusion, limiting effective coordination across domains and failing to explicitly address optimization instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a new optimization-aware dual-domain framework for MIS (O2D-MedNet). First, a degradation-aware dualdomain interaction (DDI) module integrates Fourier - and Wavelet-domain features to suppress degradation-sensitive responses while preserving structural and fine-detail information. Second, a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module enables selective interaction between CNN-based local detail modeling and visual state-space-based global structure modeling, improving boundary accuracy and representation consistency. Third, a gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy stabilizes training by adaptively adjusting learning dynamics based on loss trends and gradient statistics, mitigating instability caused by class imbalance and heterogeneous sample difficulty. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art MIS methods across multiple imaging modalities. Further analyses confirm enhanced sensitivity, structural consistency, and optimization stability, validating the effectiveness of the proposed O2D-MedNet for robust MIS under heterogeneous conditions.
zh_abstract: 医学图像分割（MIS）仍具挑战性，原因在于复合退化和多尺度几何变化，它们共同损害病灶与背景的可分性、结构一致性和优化稳定性。现有的单流框架将异质线索纠缠在单一表示路径中，而混合流方法常依赖通用或静态融合，限制了跨域的有效协同，也未能明确解决优化不稳定问题。为克服这些局限，我们提出了一种新的面向优化的双域MIS框架（O2D-MedNet）。首先，退化感知双域交互（DDI）模块整合傅里叶域和小波域特征，以抑制对退化敏感的响应，同时保留结构和精细细节信息。其次，跨骨干轮廓引导融合（CGF）模块实现基于CNN的局部细节建模与基于视觉状态空间的全局结构建模之间的选择性交互，从而提高边界精度和表示一致性。第三，梯度-上下文优化（GCO）策略根据损失趋势和梯度统计自适应调整学习动态，从而稳定训练，缓解由类别不平衡和样本难度异质性引起的不稳定。在六个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在多种成像模态上均持续优于最先进的MIS方法。进一步分析证实了其灵敏度、结构一致性和优化稳定性的提升，验证了所提出的O2D-MedNet在异质条件下实现稳健MIS的有效性。

title: Autonomous Structural Discovery Of Bioprocess Dynamics And Kinetics Via LLM-Driven Agents
zh_title: LLM智能体驱动的生物过程动力学结构自主发现
summary: 提出LLM智能体闭环框架，结合RAG与移动时域估计，自主发现生物制造中的细胞生长动力学模型。
key_points: LLM智能体闭环发现动力学状态空间
两级RAG库与移动时域估计
通过隔离剥离分解抑制与催化速率项
reason: AI用于科学发现有新意，但属生物制造且证据有限的预印本
abstract: High-fidelity digital twins in continuous biomanufacturing are often bottlenecked by incomplete kinetic models, while standard data-driven algorithms (e.g., SINDy, PINNs) lack interpretability or impose rigid physical assumptions. This paper introduces a hybrid closed-loop architecture for autonomous kinetic state-space discovery driven by a Large Language Model (LLM) agent. The framework employs a sequential "isolation-peeling" methodology across orthogonal operational regimes. This algorithmic peeling mathematically decouples entangled multiplicative (inhibitory) and additive (catalytic) biological rate law. Grounded in a Two-Level Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) library, the framework utilizes Moving Horizon Estimation (MHE) and logarithmic decomposition to decouple complex cell growth kinetics into orthogonal multiplicative (inhibitory) and additive (regulatory) residual channel
zh_abstract: 连续生物制造中的高保真数字孪生常受限于不完整的动力学模型，而标准的数据驱动算法（如 SINDy、PINNs）要么缺乏可解释性，要么施加了僵化的物理假设。本文提出一种由大语言模型（LLM）智能体驱动的混合闭环架构，用于自主发现动力学状态空间。该框架在正交的运行工况下采用序贯的“隔离-剥离”（isolation-peeling）方法。这种算法性剥离在数学上解耦了相互纠缠的乘性（抑制性）与加性（催化性）生物速率定律。该框架以两级检索增强生成（RAG）库为基础，利用移动时域估计（MHE）和对数分解，将复杂的细胞生长动力学解耦为正交的乘性（抑制性）和加性（调节性）残差通道

title: Cross-Architectural Feature Fusion for Coronary Artery Stenosis Detection in X-ray Angiography
zh_title: 跨架构特征融合用于X线冠脉造影狭窄检测
summary: 提出Fusion-YOLOv11-L，通过通道注意力门控融合YOLOv11-L检测器与预训练UNet++血管分割特征，在ARCADE*数据集上AP@50为0.585。
key_points: 融合检测与血管分割的结构特征
UNet++在ARCADE血管分割上预训练
reason: 增量方法，性能指标一般，未见强外部验证
abstract: Coronary artery disease remains a leading cause of mortality, with stenosis detection from invasive X-ray Coronary Angiography (XCA) critical for diagnosis. Manual interpretation is time-consuming, subjective, and variable, especially under low contrast and vessel overlap. Existing deep learning methods often rely solely on detection or segmentation, limiting performance. We propose a hybrid framework, Fusion-YOLOv11-L, combining a YOLOv11-L detector with a pretrained UNet++ via a channel attention gating module. This enables fusion of semantic and vessel-aware structural features, improving localisation of stenotic regions. abstract: Invasion is an early step in the metastatic spread of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), yet cells within a single tumour or cell line differ in their capacity to invade, and it is unclear which transcriptional features distinguish cells that invade from those that do not. An initial cell-level analysis combined Wilcoxon differential expression, an XGBoost classifier with a random cell split, SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and Enrichr over-representation analysis. Because cells from the same sample are not independent, we then repeated the analysis at the sample level, using differential expression on sample means (five versus five), XGBoost with cross-validation that held out whole samples, a quality-control-metric baseline model, SHAP on held-out samples and rank-based gene-set enrichment analysis (GSEA). abstract: There exist a wide range of Neural Networks (NNs) that have modelled genomic sequences well. The architectures of these NNs consist of three steps: k-mer embedding, sequence embedding, and output mapping. The NNs are primarily differentiated from one another by their sequence embedding components. Although different NNs have been compared before, these comparisons are often either limited or involve drastically different NNs. Another issue is that some NNs are configured for a specific sequence length, and different length sequences require manual modification of the architectures. This study examines the architectures of established NNs for genomics sequences. Based on these architectures, a novel NN called Mimic is developed that provides a unified architecture for the principled comparison of NN components. Mimic was used to model two different types of genomic datasets: protein-DNA interactions and enhancer activity. Along with other architecture components, different sequence embedding strategies were tried such as recurrent layers and convolutional layers. It was found that there exist specific NN components that yield significantly better performing models. Furthermore, Mimic significantly outperformed prevailing standard NNs, Bichrom and DeepSTARR, in modelling protein-DNA interactions and enhancer activity, respectively. This study provides a framework for more extensive studies toward a general prescription of NN architecture for modelling genomics data.
zh_abstract: 目前已有多种能够很好地对基因组序列建模的神经网络（NN）。这些神经网络的架构包含三个步骤：k-mer 嵌入、序列嵌入和输出映射。各神经网络之间的区别主要在于其序列嵌入部分。尽管此前已有对不同神经网络的比较，但这些比较往往要么范围有限，要么涉及差异极大的神经网络。另一个问题是，一些神经网络是针对特定序列长度配置的，不同长度的序列需要手动修改其架构。本研究考察了已有的基因组序列神经网络的架构。基于这些架构，开发了一种名为 Mimic 的新型神经网络，它为神经网络各组件的原则性比较提供了统一的架构。Mimic 被用于对两类不同的基因组数据集建模：蛋白质-DNA 相互作用和增强子活性。除其他架构组件外，还尝试了不同的序列嵌入策略，如循环层和卷积层。研究发现，存在某些特定的神经网络组件可显著提升模型性能。此外，在蛋白质-DNA 相互作用和增强子活性的建模中，Mimic 分别显著优于当前主流的标准神经网络 Bichrom 和 DeepSTARR。本研究为开展更广泛的研究、进而形成基因组数据建模所用神经网络架构的通用规范提供了框架。

title: Identification of gene kinetics patterns improves RNA velocity and cell fate prediction using JuloVelo
zh_title: JuloVelo：基因动力学模式识别改进RNA速度与细胞命运预测
summary: 深度学习框架先识别基因动力学模式再初始化网络，用于改进单细胞RNA速度和细胞命运预测。
key_points: 区分Circle、完全诱导、完全抑制三类模式
以模式匹配的预训练权重初始化
可处理多组学multiome数据
reason: 新方法预印本，基础研究增量
abstract: Single-cell RNA velocity has transformed our capacity to predict future cell states from sequencing snapshots, but existing methods rely on constant or binary kinetic assumptions that fail to capture the heterogeneous splicing dynamics of cellular differentiation. Here we present JuloVelo, a deep learning framework that demonstrates that identifying gene kinetics patterns to initialize neural network training dramatically improves RNA velocity model performance. By pre-determining whether each gene follows a Circle, Complete induction, or Complete repression pattern across cellular differentiation, JuloVelo initializes training with pattern-matched, pre-trained network weights, effectively guiding the cell-specific kinetics optimization away from biologically implausible parameter regimes. Additionally, JuloVelo demonstrates that multiome datasets can also be processed and modeled by utilizing promoter chromatin accessibility to guide kinetics pre-determination, and integrates an in silico perturbation framework to simulate transcription factor modulation on cell fate. Validated across eight datasets spanning erythrogenesis, neurogenesis, and endocrinogenesis, JuloVelo consistently outperformed constant-rate and cell-specific models, resolving the entire five-lineage differentiation program in hippocampal neurogenesis. Multiome processing improved both intrinsic and extrinsic velocity stability, and JuloVelo reduced computational execution time by approximately 70% compared to cellDancer. JuloVelo is available as an open-source package at https://github.com/jhlabtw/JuloVelo.jl.
zh_abstract: 单细胞RNA速率（RNA velocity）极大提升了我们从测序快照预测细胞未来状态的能力，但现有方法依赖恒定或二元的动力学假设，无法刻画细胞分化过程中异质性的剪接动力学。在此，我们提出JuloVelo，一个深度学习框架，证明通过识别基因动力学模式来初始化神经网络训练，可显著提升RNA速率模型的性能。JuloVelo预先确定每个基因在细胞分化过程中遵循环状（Circle）、完全诱导（Complete induction）还是完全抑制（Complete repression）模式，并使用与模式匹配的预训练网络权重来初始化训练，从而有效引导细胞特异性动力学优化避开生物学上不合理的参数区间。此外，JuloVelo证明多组学（multiome）数据集同样可以通过利用启动子染色质可及性来指导动力学预判定而得到处理和建模，并整合了in silico扰动框架，用于模拟转录因子调控对细胞命运的影响。在涵盖红细胞生成、神经发生和内分泌发生的八个数据集上验证显示，JuloVelo始终优于恒定速率模型和细胞特异性模型，并解析了海马神经发生中完整的五谱系分化程序。多组学处理提高了内在和外在速率稳定性，且与cellDancer相比，JuloVelo将计算执行时间缩短约70%。JuloVelo以开源软件包形式提供，网址为 https://github.com/jhlabtw/JuloVelo.jl。

title: Machine Learning in Amyloidogenic Polypeptide Research: From Sequence Prediction to Drug Discovery.
zh_title: 淀粉样多肽研究中的机器学习：从序列预测到药物发现
summary: 综述系统评述机器学习在淀粉样多肽研究中的应用，涵盖序列预测、结构生物学、抑制剂设计及临床目标，并梳理从经典算法到Transformer、蛋白语言模型的架构。
key_points: 覆盖序列致淀粉样性预测与结构生物学
涉及抑制剂设计与临床相关目标
梳理经典算法至深度学习及蛋白语言模型
reason: 综述类，上限6；与神经退行性疾病和药物发现相关，但属泛泛综述
abstract: [ACS omega] Over the past decade, machine learning (ML) has established a transformative paradigm for investigating amyloidogenic polypeptides. Characterized by their propensity to form ordered, β-sheet-rich fibrillar aggregates, these polypeptides are centrally implicated in the pathogenesis of numerous neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Parkinson's disease (PD). This review systematically evaluates the application of ML across critical domains of amyloid investigation: sequence-based amyloidogenicity prediction, structural biology, inhibitor design, and amyloid-related clinical objectives. We further summarize the diverse array of ML architectures currently employed in amyloid research, spanning classical algorithms (e.g., support vector machines and random forests) to advanced deep learning frameworks, such as the transformer framework, protein language models (PLMs), etc. Additionally, we spotlight emerging frontiers, namely, the integration of ML with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, the use of generative AI for de novo inhibitor design, etc., while addressing persistent bottlenecks in the field, including data standardization, model interpretability, and rigorous experimental validation for in silico predictions. Ultimately, this review serves as a foundational roadmap for emerging researchers and a definitive reference for established investigators operating at the intersection of artificial intelligence and amyloid biology.
zh_abstract: [ACS omega] 在过去十年中，机器学习（ML）为淀粉样多肽的研究确立了一种变革性范式。这些多肽的特点是倾向于形成有序的、富含β-折叠的纤维状聚集体，与包括阿尔茨海默病（AD）和帕金森病（PD）在内的多种神经退行性疾病的发病机制密切相关。本综述系统评估了ML在淀粉样蛋白研究若干关键领域中的应用：基于序列的淀粉样生成倾向预测、结构生物学、抑制剂设计以及与淀粉样蛋白相关的临床目标。我们进一步总结了目前淀粉样蛋白研究中所采用的多种ML架构，涵盖从经典算法（如支持向量机和随机森林）到先进的深度学习框架（如Transformer框架、蛋白质语言模型（PLM）等）。此外，我们重点介绍了新兴前沿方向，即ML与分子动力学（MD）模拟的结合、利用生成式人工智能从头设计抑制剂等，同时探讨了该领域长期存在的瓶颈，包括数据标准化、模型可解释性，以及对计算机预测结果进行严格实验验证。总之，本综述为新入行的研究人员提供了基础性路线图，也为处于人工智能与淀粉样蛋白生物学交叉领域的资深研究者提供了权威参考。

title: Evaluating a Large Language Model for Emergency Triage Using Synthetic Clinical Dialogues: Toward a Multimodal Clinical Safety Framework.
zh_title: 用合成临床对话评估大模型的急诊分诊能力
summary: 研究以合成临床对话评估GPT-5.2在朝觐场景下的急诊分诊（ESI），并探索结合结构化电子病历与对话的多模态安全框架。
key_points: 场景为朝觐等大规模聚集活动的急诊分诊
使用合成对话结合结构化生理指标
面向概念性临床决策支持框架
reason: 合成数据评估，无真实临床验证，属增量档
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Prioritizing patient safety through accurate emergency triage is critical during mass-gathering events such as Hajj and Umrah, where high patient volumes can significantly increase the risk of clinical errors. Although the Emergency Severity Index (ESI) provides a standardized triage protocol, it remains dependent on human judgment, while traditional artificial intelligence (AI) models often struggle to capture the nuanced clinical context embedded in patient narratives. To address this gap, this study evaluates GPT-5.2 using synthetically generated dialogues as a step toward a conceptual clinical decision-support framework that bridges structured electronic health records (EHRs) with triage interactions through clinical dialogues. By combining narrative inputs with structured physiological indicators, it explores the potential to support more informed clinical decision-making under controlled simulation conditions. Methods: To evaluate this contribution, we systematically assessed the role of clinical dialogues in triage performance using a balanced and stratified dataset of 1000 simulated Hajj-context scenarios. Results: The results demonstrate that incorporating clinical dialogues can significantly improve triage performance, with a 79.7% relative reduction in under-triage across all ESI levels. A more noticeable improvement was observed in high-acuity cases, with a 91.9% relative reduction in under-triage. In addition, the model achieved a high-acuity recall of 94.5%, highlighting its ability to identify critical "red-flag" symptoms that are often not captured in structured data. These findings suggest that narrative context may contribute to more accurate triage assessment and improved identification of high-acuity cases. Conclusions: Consequently, when evaluated within a controlled decision-support setting, this study suggests that large language model (LLM)-based systems may improve triage reliability and may contribute to safer triage decision-making in high-demand clinical environments.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景/目的】在朝觐（Hajj）和副朝（Umrah）等大型聚集活动中，通过准确的急诊分诊优先保障患者安全至关重要，因为大量患者会显著增加临床差错的风险。尽管急诊严重程度指数（ESI）提供了标准化的分诊方案，但它仍依赖人的判断，而传统人工智能（AI）模型往往难以捕捉患者叙述中蕴含的细微临床背景。为弥补这一不足，本研究使用合成生成的对话评估GPT-5.2，作为迈向概念性临床决策支持框架的一步，该框架通过临床对话将结构化电子健康记录（EHR）与分诊交互联系起来。通过将叙述性输入与结构化生理指标相结合，探讨了在受控模拟条件下支持更明智临床决策的潜力。【方法】为评估这一贡献，我们使用包含1000个模拟朝觐情境的均衡分层数据集，系统评估了临床对话在分诊表现中的作用。【结果】结果表明，纳入临床对话可显著提高分诊表现，所有ESI级别的分诊不足相对减少79.7%。在高急症病例中改善更为明显，分诊不足相对减少91.9%。此外，模型的高急症召回率达到94.5%，凸显其识别结构化数据中常常无法捕捉的关键“危险信号”症状的能力。这些发现提示，叙述性背景可能有助于更准确的分诊评估，并改善对高急症病例的识别。【结论】因此，在受控的决策支持情境下评估，本研究提示基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统可能提高分诊可靠性，并可能有助于在高需求临床环境中做出更安全的分诊决策。

title: From image biomarkers to treatment decisions: multimodal AI and clinical translation in gynecologic oncology.
zh_title: 从影像生物标志物到治疗决策：妇科肿瘤多模态AI
summary: 综述AI在卵巢、子宫内膜和宫颈癌中从影像解读走向整合多模态信息的决策支持。
key_points: 涵盖风险分层、手术规划、放疗与系统治疗选择
多模态整合更贴近临床决策方式
现有应用多为影像与回顾性预测
reason: 综述类，多模态肿瘤方向略上调
abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly expanding across gynecologic oncology, but most applications remain focused on image interpretation and retrospective prediction rather than direct support of treatment decisions. This review examines how AI is progressing from imaging biomarkers toward multimodal decision-support systems that integrate radiologic, pathologic, molecular, and clinical information. We summarize current applications in ovarian, endometrial, and cervical cancers, with particular attention to preoperative risk stratification, surgical planning, radiotherapy, systemic treatment selection, treatment-response prediction, and multidisciplinary decision-making. Multimodal approaches are especially promising because they reflect the way clinical decisions are made and may provide greater value than models based on a single data source. However, the current evidence remains dominated by retrospective and often single-center studies, with limited external and prospective validation. Data heterogeneity, domain shift, incomplete multimodal datasets, bias, workflow integration, regulatory requirements, and model monitoring remain important barriers to routine implementation. We therefore outline a stepwise pathway for clinical translation, from robust multicenter validation and prospective human-AI evaluation to clinical-impact studies and post-deployment monitoring. The next phase of AI in gynecologic oncology should prioritize clinically meaningful decisions and measurable patient or workflow benefit rather than incremental gains in predictive performance alone.

title: A Survey on U-Net with Variants and Their Applications in Two-Dimensional Medical Image Segmentations.
zh_title: U-Net及其变体在二维医学图像分割中的应用综述
summary: 综述U-Net及代表性变体在二维医学图像分割中的架构演化，涵盖注意力、跳跃连接增强、可变形卷积与Transformer扩展，并讨论优缺点。
key_points: 梳理注意力、可变形卷积、Transformer等变体
汇总已发表结果，未做新基准实验
讨论各方法局限与适用边界
reason: 传统方法综述，未做新基准，综述上限内偏低
abstract: [Journal of imaging] Medical image segmentation plays a critical role in computer-assisted diagnosis, treatment planning, surgical navigation, and quantitative medical image analysis. Among deep learning-based segmentation architectures, U-Net has become one of the most influential frameworks because of its encoder-decoder structure and skip connections for integrating semantic and spatial information. This review focuses on U-Net and representative variants for two-dimensional medical image segmentation. We systematically analyze their architectural evolution, including attention-based designs, enhanced skip connections, deformable convolutions, and Transformer-based extensions and discuss their advantages, limitations, and application boundaries. Quantitative performance results are synthesized from published studies rather than reproduced through new benchmarking experiments; direct numerical comparisons are restricted to models evaluated within the same study or under clearly defined benchmark settings. We further relate architectural modifications to modality-specific challenges in MRI, CT, ultrasound, fundus imaging, dermoscopy, and microscopy. Finally, current challenges in computational efficiency, cross-domain generalization, data scarcity, interpretability, and clinical deployment are discussed, together with promising directions for future research.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging] 医学图像分割在计算机辅助诊断、治疗计划、手术导航和定量医学图像分析中发挥着关键作用。在基于深度学习的分割架构中，U-Net 因其编码器-解码器结构以及用于整合语义信息与空间信息的跳跃连接，已成为最具影响力的框架之一。本综述聚焦于 U-Net 及其用于二维医学图像分割的代表性变体。我们系统分析了其架构演进，包括基于注意力的设计、增强的跳跃连接、可变形卷积以及基于 Transformer 的扩展，并讨论了它们的优势、局限性和应用边界。定量性能结果综合自已发表的研究，而非通过新的基准实验重现；直接的数值比较仅限于在同一研究中或在明确定义的基准设置下评估的模型。我们还将架构改进与 MRI、CT、超声、眼底成像、皮肤镜和显微镜成像中特定模态的挑战相联系。最后，我们讨论了计算效率、跨域泛化、数据稀缺、可解释性和临床部署方面的当前挑战，以及未来研究的有前景方向。

title: Transformer models in cardiovascular medicine: current applications, translational challenges, and future directions.
zh_title: Transformer模型在心血管医学中的应用、转化挑战与展望
summary: 综述梳理Transformer在心电图、心脏影像、电子病历、多模态整合、数字孪生及大模型工作流中的应用与转化挑战。
key_points: 覆盖心电、影像、病历文本
涉及多模态与数字孪生
讨论转化挑战与未来方向
reason: 综述类，泛泛概述，增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Cardiovascular diseases remain a leading cause of mortality and morbidity worldwide, highlighting the need for improved early detection, accurate diagnosis, and personalized therapeutic strategies. With advances in artificial intelligence (AI), Transformer-based models have attracted increasing interest because they can model long-range dependencies, support large-scale pre-training, and integrate heterogeneous data. Originally developed for natural language processing, Transformers have been extended to medical image analysis, physiological signal interpretation, and clinical text mining. In cardiovascular medicine, these models have been applied to electrocardiogram interpretation, cardiac imaging, electronic health record analysis, multimodal data integration, digital-twin development, and large language model-enabled workflows. Although many studies report promising performance, clinical value remains contingent on data quality, external validation, calibration, workflow integration, and trustworthy governance. This narrative review provides a focused overview of Transformer-based models in cardiovascular medicine, critically evaluates their translational limitations, and outlines priorities for clinically useful and responsible cardiovascular AI.
zh_abstract: 心血管疾病仍是全球死亡和发病的主要原因，因此需要改进早期检测、准确诊断和个体化治疗策略。随着人工智能（AI）的进步，基于Transformer的模型因能够建模长程依赖关系、支持大规模预训练并整合异质数据而受到越来越多的关注。Transformer最初是为自然语言处理而开发的，现已扩展到医学图像分析、生理信号解读和临床文本挖掘。在心血管医学中，这些模型已被应用于心电图解读、心脏影像、电子健康记录分析、多模态数据整合、数字孪生开发以及基于大语言模型的工作流程。尽管许多研究报告了有前景的性能，但其临床价值仍取决于数据质量、外部验证、校准、工作流程整合以及可信赖的治理。本叙述性综述聚焦概述了心血管医学中基于Transformer的模型，批判性地评估其转化应用方面的局限，并提出了实现临床有用且负责任的心血管AI的优先事项。

title: Artificial intelligence in spinal fracture imaging: from clinical application to translational promise.
zh_title: 脊柱骨折影像中的人工智能：从临床应用到转化前景
summary: 综述梳理CNN、检测器及混合模型在脊柱骨折检测与分类中的应用，指出多为单中心回顾性研究，多数缺乏外部验证。
key_points: AI在受控、单中心回顾性设置下诊断准确率高
轻微骨折、退变脊柱和术后解剖结构下性能下降
多数模型缺乏外部验证，存在选择性报告等方法缺陷
reason: 综述类文章，信息有限，属增量档，上限6分
abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping medical imaging, and deep learning together with machine learning are now being used to detect, classify, and differentially diagnose spinal fractures. In this Review, we survey the principal AI architectures that currently support spinal imaging, including convolutional neural networks, object detectors, and hybrid models, and we assess their reported performance for osteoporotic, traumatic, and pathological vertebral fractures. Our synthesis indicates that AI can achieve high diagnostic accuracy in controlled, often single-centre retrospective settings, but its performance consistently declines for mild fractures, degenerated spines, and postoperative anatomy. Critically, the majority of published models lack external validation, and many studies suffer from methodological shortcomings such as selective reporting, insufficient sample sizes, and absence of predefined analysis plans-factors that systematically inflate apparent accuracy. Beyond detection, we explore the growing applications of AI in surgical planning, complication prediction, and functional outcome estimation, while emphasising that most evidence remains preliminary. We identify persistent gaps, including underuse of foundation models and public benchmarks, and limited independent evaluation of commercial tools. We conclude by proposing a shift from performance reporting to methodologically rigorous, prospectively designed studies that incorporate bias assessment, standardised reporting, and patient-centred endpoints-steps essential to translate technical promise into tangible patient benefit.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 人工智能（AI）正在重塑医学影像，深度学习与机器学习目前已被用于脊柱骨折的检测、分类和鉴别诊断。在本综述中，我们梳理了目前支持脊柱影像的主要AI架构，包括卷积神经网络、目标检测器和混合模型，并评估了它们在骨质疏松性、创伤性和病理性椎体骨折中的已报告性能。我们的综合分析表明，AI在受控的、通常为单中心回顾性的研究环境中可达到较高的诊断准确性，但其性能在轻度骨折、退变脊柱和术后解剖结构中持续下降。关键的是，大多数已发表的模型缺乏外部验证，许多研究存在方法学缺陷，如选择性报告、样本量不足以及缺少预先设定的分析计划，这些因素会系统性地夸大表面准确性。除检测之外，我们还探讨了AI在手术规划、并发症预测和功能结局评估中日益增多的应用，同时强调大多数证据仍属初步。我们指出了持续存在的不足，包括基础模型和公共基准的利用不足，以及对商业工具的独立评估有限。最后，我们建议从性能报告转向方法学严谨、前瞻性设计的研究，纳入偏倚评估、标准化报告和以患者为中心的终点——这些步骤对于将技术前景转化为切实的患者获益至关重要。

title: Multimodal artificial intelligence assessment of simulated cardiac arrest performance: a pilot study.
zh_title: 多模态AI评估模拟心脏骤停表现的初步研究
summary: 用Gemini 1.5 Pro对6段模拟心脏骤停视频评分，与两名ACLS讲师共识比较一致性，属小规模试点。
key_points: 6段脚本化模拟视频，共504项逐条评分
以专家共识评分为参考标准
报告kappa、AC1及敏感度/特异度

abstract: [Resuscitation plus] Assessment of simulated cardiac arrest performance is resource-intensive and subject to inter-rater variability. We evaluated whether a multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) system could score video-recorded cardiac arrest megacode simulations with agreement comparable to expert raters. Six scripted megacode simulations (three ventricular fibrillation, three pulseless electrical activity) representing exemplar, guideline-deviation and non-technical-deficiency performance were scored by two ACLS instructors using a validated team-leader checklist; consensus ratings served as the reference. Two operators analysed each video with Gemini 1.5 Pro at three temperature settings (504 item-level ratings). We calculated Cohen's kappa, Gwet's AC1, and sensitivity and specificity for identifying performed and omitted actions, and compared AI self-reported confidence between correct and incorrect ratings. Expert inter-rater agreement was κ = 0.78 (95% CI 0.64-0.93). AI-expert agreement was κ = 0.62 (95% CI 0.49-0.75; range 0.40-0.86 across configurations) and AC1 = 0.77. The AI identified performed actions with high sensitivity (0.98, 95% CI 0.96-0.99) but detected omitted actions poorly (specificity 0.58, 95% CI 0.44-0.72), particularly omissions defined by timing or sequence. Temperature had no consistent effect. Incorrect ratings of actions as performed carried lower mean self-reported confidence than correct ones (93.6 vs 98.1), but 48% were made with maximal confidence. A multimodal AI system reliably confirmed completed actions but frequently failed to detect omitted actions, yielding moderate overall agreement that was below expert-expert agreement. Current systems may support, but not replace, expert assessment of cardiac arrest simulation.

abstract: [Viruses] This work builds AAV-CapNet, a deep learning model integrating Fourier frequency enhancement and cross-attention fusion, to predict the infectivity of 20 AAV capsid variants across 52 cancer cell lines with a self-built multi-omics dataset of 392 validated measurements. Validated via stratified splitting and repeated five-fold cross-validation, it extracts dual-domain capsid features fused with host transcriptomics for joint classification and regression. The model exhibits favourable performance under low-false-positive-rate conditions suitable for high-throughput screening. Attention mapping and ablation tests validate core modules' necessity. Despite poor generalization to unseen serotypes, this interpretable tool facilitates intraserotype capsid screening and rational engineering.

title: Machine learning classification of fibromyalgia from blood transcriptomes: confounder benchmarking and implications for endometriosis-associated pain
zh_title: 血液转录组机器学习分类纤维肌痛：混杂因素基准
summary: 重分析96例患者与93例对照的PBMC RNA-seq，AUC约0.82，但性别和细胞组成等简单基线表现接近，提示信号并非纯疾病特异。

细胞组成代理AUC 0.71-0.76

abstract: Fibromyalgia (FM) lacks an objective biomarker, and blood transcriptomic signatures have been proposed to fill this gap. Here, the largest public peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) RNA-seq cohort of FM reporting expression subtypes (96 patients, 93 controls) was reanalysed using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection and scaling confined strictly to training folds. Gene expression discriminated patients from controls (ROC-AUC 0.821 for logistic regression and 0.825 for XGBoost), clearing a 100-repetition permutation-label null (p= 0.0099). Two simple, disease-agnostic baselines, however, reach nearly the same performance: sex alone reaches AUC 0.727, and a four-score PBMC cell-composition proxy reaches AUC 0.71-0.76. Restricting to females alone gives AUC 0.783 (0.705-0.858), and excluding X/Y-linked genes does not reduce performance, so the signal is not purely a sex-composition artifact; but the female-only expression model does not significantly exceed the composition-only proxy in the same females (0.783 vs. 0.712, paired 95% CI -0.025 to 0.175), so a composition contribution cannot be excluded. Preranked gene set enrichment analysis finds curated CLEAR/lysosomal and interferon/JAK-STAT gene sets, proxies for two subtype signatures of the original study, enriched among genes expressed lower in FM, also in females alone, but this enrichment disappears after adjusting for the composition proxies. Gynecological comorbidity, hormonal status, and medication are absent from the public metadata and remain plausible, untested contributors to the female-only estimate. These findings are hypothesis-generating, not a basis for clinical diagnosis: a single-cohort, correlational result consistent with, but not sufficient to establish, an FM-specific signal distinct from demographic, hormonal, and cell-composition confounds, pending independent replication. Future blood-based biomarker studies for FM, and for related nociplastic pain conditions such as endometriosis, should report performance relative to sex- and composition-based baselines as standard practice.
zh_abstract: 纤维肌痛（FM）缺乏客观的生物标志物，血液转录组特征被提出用以填补这一空白。本研究使用无信息泄漏的嵌套交叉验证（特征选择和标准化严格限定在训练折内），重新分析了报告表达亚型的最大的FM公共外周血单个核细胞（PBMC）RNA-seq队列（96例患者，93名对照）。基因表达可区分患者与对照（逻辑回归的ROC-AUC为0.821，XGBoost为0.825），超过了100次重复的置换标签零分布（p=0.0099）。然而，两个简单的、与疾病无关的基线达到了几乎相同的性能：仅用性别的AUC为0.727，由四个评分组成的PBMC细胞组成代理指标的AUC为0.71-0.76。仅限女性时AUC为0.783（0.705-0.858），排除X/Y连锁基因并未降低性能，因此该信号并非纯粹的性别构成伪影；但在同一批女性中，仅女性的表达模型并未显著优于仅细胞组成代理指标（0.783 vs. 0.712，配对95% CI -0.025至0.175），因此不能排除细胞组成的贡献。预排序基因集富集分析发现，经整理的CLEAR/溶酶体和干扰素/JAK-STAT基因集（原研究两个亚型特征的代理）在FM中表达较低的基因中富集，仅在女性中亦如此，但在对细胞组成代理指标进行校正后，这种富集消失。妇科合并症、激素状态和药物使用在公共元数据中缺失，仍是仅女性估计中看似合理但未经检验的影响因素。这些发现仅用于产生假设，不能作为临床诊断的依据：这是一项单队列、相关性的结果，与存在不同于人口学、激素和细胞组成混杂因素的FM特异性信号相一致，但不足以证实，仍有待独立重复验证。未来针对FM以及子宫内膜异位症等相关痛觉可塑性疼痛疾病的血液生物标志物研究，应将报告相对于性别和细胞组成基线的性能作为标准做法。

summary: 按PRISMA检索Scopus，纳入47项研究，综述经典机器学习、深度学习与事后特征归因在T2DM早筛及并发症风险分层中的应用。

abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) affects hundreds of millions of people worldwide, and nearly half of all cases remain undiagnosed. This technical review, conducted under conducted under the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines and structured around the Population, Intervention, Comparison, Outcome and Context (PICOC) framework, identifies and synthesises the evidence on artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms for the early detection of T2DM and the risk stratification of its complications, evaluating their performance against conventional diagnostic methods and characterising their clinical implementation contexts. A systematic search in Scopus with a four-stage screening process, synthesised across five research dimensions, yielded 255 records, of which 47 studies met the inclusion criteria (2025-2026). Ensemble methods based on gradient boosting, particularly particularly extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost), emerged as the dominant primary modelling approach, while logistic regression was the most frequently reported algorithm, predominantly as a baseline comparator, with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) values ranging from 0.63 to 0.97. AI models consistently outperformed glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c), whose reported sensitivity for prediabetes was only 49%, reaching accuracies of up to 96.7%, although that upper figure comes from a narrowly defined cohort with a high baseline prevalence and does not represent general screening performance. Multimodal approaches achieved the highest discrimination, combining wearables, continuous glucose monitoring, and genomics (AUC 0.96 internal, 0.90 external, for the separation of self-reported glycaemic states), and a real-world clinical deployment integrated into electronic health records improved glycaemic control outcomes among high-risk patients. An assessment of the eight anchor studies with thePrediction model Risk Of Bias ASsessment Tool updated for AI (PROBAST + AI) found high concern regarding quality in six of them, driven mainly by cross-sectional designs and self-reported outcomes. Overall, AI stands out as a viable and scalable complement to conventional screening, although gaps remain in multicentre prospective validation, reporting standardisation, and algorithmic equity across populations.
zh_abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] 2 型糖尿病（T2DM）影响全球数亿人，且近半数病例仍未被诊断。本技术综述按照《系统评价和荟萃分析优先报告条目》（PRISMA）指南进行，并围绕人群、干预、比较、结局和情境（PICOC）框架构建，旨在识别并综合关于人工智能（AI）算法用于 T2DM 早期检测及其并发症风险分层的证据，评估其相对于传统诊断方法的性能，并刻画其临床实施情境。我们在 Scopus 中进行了系统检索，经四阶段筛选并围绕五个研究维度进行综合，共检索到 255 条记录，其中 47 项研究符合纳入标准（2025–2026年）。基于梯度提升的集成方法，尤其是极端梯度提升（XGBoost），成为占主导地位的主要建模方法，而逻辑回归是报告最频繁的算法，主要作为基线对照，其受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC-ROC）为 0.63 至 0.97。AI 模型的表现始终优于糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）（其报告的糖尿病前期敏感度仅为 49%），准确率最高可达 96.7%，但这一上限数值来自定义狭窄、基线患病率较高的队列，并不代表一般筛查人群中的性能。多模态方法的区分能力最高，其结合了可穿戴设备、连续血糖监测和基因组学（对自报血糖状态的区分，内部验证 AUC 为 0.96，外部验证为 0.90）；此外，一项整合于电子健康记录的真实世界临床部署改善了高风险患者的血糖控制结局。使用针对 AI 更新的预测模型偏倚风险评估工具（PROBAST + AI）对八项核心研究进行评估，发现其中六项在质量方面存在高度担忧，主要原因是横断面设计和自报结局。总体而言，AI 是常规筛查中可行且可扩展的补充手段，但在多中心前瞻性验证、报告标准化以及跨人群算法公平性方面仍存在差距。

abstract: [Journal of imaging] Platelets undergo significant morphological transformations during activation influenced by chemical compounds such as zinc and milrinone. Manual classification methods are subjective, time-consuming, and prone to error. This research aimed to apply and evaluate the efficacy of different pre-trained deep learning Convolution Neural Networks, used for automated binary (treated vs untreated) and multiclass classification (control vs zinc vs milrinone vs combination) of platelet morphological changes induced by these solvents, addressing the limitations of manual classification methods. A dataset of 176 microscopic platelet images from Hull York Medical School was processed, comprising control (n = 43), zinc-treated (n = 45), milrinone-treated (n = 40), and combination treatment (n = 48) samples. Ten pre-trained CNN architectures were evaluated across 166 individual training iterations for both binary and multiclass classification tasks. Progressive optimisation strategies included contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalisation (CLAHE) enhancement, selective layer unfreezing, cross-validation, and hyperparameter tuning. For binary classification, Xception achieved optimal balanced performance (81% accuracy, 76% precision, 74% recall) with proper inter-class discrimination, despite higher numerical metrics (91% accuracy) showing classification bias. For multiclass classification, InceptionV3 and Xception demonstrated superior effectiveness with 72% accuracy. This study demonstrated that Xception and InceptionV3 architectures effectively capture subtle morphological features distinguishing treated platelets, offering reproducible alternatives to subjective manual methods.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging] 在锌和米力农等化合物的影响下，血小板在活化过程中会发生显著的形态学转变。人工分类方法主观性强、耗时且易出错。本研究旨在应用并评估不同预训练深度学习卷积神经网络（Convolution Neural Networks, CNN）的效能，用于对这些溶剂所诱导的血小板形态变化进行自动化二分类（处理组与未处理组）和多分类（对照组、锌、米力农、联合处理），以解决人工分类方法的局限性。研究处理了来自赫尔约克医学院（Hull York Medical School）的176幅血小板显微图像数据集，包括对照组（n = 43）、锌处理组（n = 45）、米力农处理组（n = 40）和联合处理组（n = 48）样本。针对二分类和多分类任务，共对10种预训练CNN架构进行了166次独立训练迭代评估。逐步优化策略包括对比度受限自适应直方图均衡化（CLAHE）增强、选择性解冻网络层、交叉验证和超参数调优。在二分类中，Xception取得了最优的均衡性能（准确率81%、精确率76%、召回率74%），类间区分良好；尽管另有模型数值指标更高（准确率91%），但存在分类偏倚。在多分类中，InceptionV3和Xception表现更优，准确率为72%。本研究表明，Xception和InceptionV3架构能够有效捕捉区分处理后血小板的细微形态特征，为主观的人工方法提供了可重复的替代方案。

abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] Intelligent tongue diagnosis demands high-precision segmentation on resource-constrained mobile devices. All deep learning models outperform conventional approaches, improving mean intersection over union (mIoU) by approximately 9% and accelerating inference by more than two orders of magnitude. Among the evaluated models, UNet++ achieves the highest test mIoU (0.9543) and Dice (0.9764), with paired bootstrap analysis confirming statistically significant advantages over BiSeNet, PP-LiteSeg, and HRNet. BiSeNet achieves the fastest inference speed (310.03 FPS) and the highest mPA (0.9766), making it the most efficient model for real-time deployment. HRNet and PP-LiteSeg provide a favorable accuracy-efficiency balance, suitable for mobile-based tongue diagnosis. Deployment of PP-LiteSeg on three Android devices achieved inference latency of 233-262 ms and throughput of 3.2-3.4 FPS, demonstrating the feasibility of lightweight models on commodity mobile hardware. These findings establish an evidence-based framework for model selection in mobile tongue diagnosis, supporting AI deployment on portable devices for clinical assistance and remote monitoring.
zh_abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] 智能舌诊需要在资源受限的移动设备上实现高精度分割。所有深度学习模型均优于传统方法，平均交并比（mIoU）提高约 9%，推理速度加快两个数量级以上。在所评估的模型中，UNet++ 取得了最高的测试 mIoU（0.9543）和 Dice（0.9764），配对 bootstrap 分析证实其相对于 BiSeNet、PP-LiteSeg 和 HRNet 具有统计学显著优势。BiSeNet 的推理速度最快（310.03 FPS），mPA 最高（0.9766），使其成为实时部署中效率最高的模型。HRNet 和 PP-LiteSeg 在精度与效率之间取得了良好平衡，适用于基于移动端的舌诊。将 PP-LiteSeg 部署于三台 Android 设备上，推理延迟为 233–262 ms，吞吐量为 3.2–3.4 FPS，证明了轻量级模型在普通移动硬件上的可行性。这些发现为移动舌诊中的模型选择建立了循证框架，支持在便携式设备上部署人工智能以用于临床辅助和远程监测。

abstract: Deep learning shows promise for breast cancer diagnosis, but limited interpretability hinders clinical adoption. We benchmark ten ImageNet-pretrained models (ResNet50, VGG19, InceptionV3, DenseNet121, Xception, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, ViT, and Swin Transformer) for benign-versus-malignant classification on the BreakHis histopathology dataset using a patient-level split, and explain their predictions with Grad-CAM, LIME, Integrated Gradients, and LRP. DenseNet121 performed best, with 99.4% test accuracy and an AUC-ROC of 0.999, and significantly outperformed all other models (p < 0.001). Transformer-based models trailed the CNNs. The explanations consistently highlighted nuclei-rich and glandular regions of diagnostic relevance. Combining transfer learning with explainable AI can thus yield accurate, interpretable tools for breast cancer diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 深度学习在乳腺癌诊断中显示出前景，但可解释性有限阻碍了其临床应用。我们在 BreakHis 组织病理学数据集上，采用患者水平划分，对十种 ImageNet 预训练模型（ResNet50、VGG19、InceptionV3、DenseNet121、Xception、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet、ConvNeXt、ViT 和 Swin Transformer）进行良性与恶性分类的基准测试，并使用 Grad-CAM、LIME、Integrated Gradients 和 LRP 解释其预测。DenseNet121 表现最佳，测试准确率为 99.4%，AUC-ROC 为 0.999，且显著优于所有其他模型（p < 0.001）。基于 Transformer 的模型落后于 CNN。这些解释一致突出了具有诊断相关性的富含细胞核区域和腺体区域。因此，将迁移学习与可解释人工智能相结合，可以产生准确且可解释的乳腺癌诊断工具。

abstract: Disseminating synthetic data in place of original ones is a promising way to enforce privacy while complying with open science principles, especially in the healthcare domain. To keep pace with the rate at which researchers collect such data, there is a need for fast and flexible synthesis procedures. A popular class of such procedures is based on models of conditional distributions induced by decision trees. Such models can be combined into a synthetic distribution following two main approaches: sequential specification and fully conditional specification. However, there is currently no recommendation on which specification to use to optimize the risk-utility tradeoffs. In this work, we use both specifications to synthesize medical datasets by combining tree-based models of conditional distributions. We compare the quality of the resulting synthetic data using several metrics of risk and utility. Our results indicate no general superiority of either specification over the other. Sequential synthesis seems sensitive to the ordering of the variables, while the fully conditional specification involves more hyperparameters and incurs higher computational costs, which may limit its suitability for off-the-shelf synthesis procedures.

abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is often diagnosed after the opportunity for curative treatment has passed. Blood-based biomarkers offer opportunities for earlier detection and serial molecular assessment, but their value depends on the intended clinical use. This nonsystematic narrative review critically examines circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), circulating tumor cells, extracellular vesicles, circulating RNAs, proteins and multimodal panels, including models developed using artificial intelligence. We distinguish population screening, high-risk surveillance, diagnostic evaluation, molecular profiling, treatment monitoring and postoperative recurrence assessment. High discrimination in selected case-control cohorts does not establish performance in asymptomatic populations or clinical benefit. Differences in disease stage, comparator groups, sample handling and validation design preclude reliable ranking of biomarker classes using published area-under-the-curve values. ctDNA has a more established role in selected molecular-profiling situations than in early detection; postoperative detection and longitudinal changes provide prognostic information, but do not by themselves justify treatment modification. Multimodal assays require comparison with clinical assessment and CA19-9 at prespecified thresholds, external validation, calibration and evaluation of downstream harms and costs. This review presents an intended-use framework and a summary of representative prospective studies. Limitations include purposive, non-exhaustive evidence selection and the absence of formal risk-of-bias or certainty grading. Clinical translation requires reproducible assays and evidence that biomarker-informed decisions improve outcomes. Liquid biopsy should therefore be evaluated within defined clinical pathways alongside imaging, pathology and established molecular testing.

abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] Toxicogenomics integrates high-throughput genomic technologies with toxicology to evaluate molecular responses to chemical and pharmaceutical exposures. The increasing volume and complexity of multi-omics data necessitate advanced computational approaches capable of extracting meaningful and predictive insights. In this context, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) techniques-including support vector machines, random forests, and deep learning architectures-are increasingly employed for early toxicity prediction and risk assessment, with reported improvements in predictive accuracy and sensitivity relative to conventional toxicological approaches. This paper explores the role of AI-driven toxicogenomics in enhancing predictive environmental and pharmaceutical safety. It highlights the application of ML-based and data-driven models for the integrative analysis of transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic datasets to identify toxicity-associated biomarkers, elucidate mechanisms of action, and predict adverse drug and environmental effects prior to clinical manifestation. Notably, AI-driven models have demonstrated significant improvements in prediction accuracy, sensitivity, and scalability compared to traditional toxicological approaches, reducing reliance on animal testing and accelerating decision-making processes. Furthermore, the paper discusses the significance of AI-based toxicogenomics in drug development, environmental contaminant screening, and regulatory toxicology, while addressing key challenges such as data heterogeneity, model interpretability, and regulatory acceptance. The convergence of computer science and toxicogenomics represents a robust framework for next-generation predictive toxicology, facilitating safer pharmaceutical development, more precise environmental risk assessment, and evidence-based public health and regulatory decision-making.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] 毒理基因组学将高通量基因组技术与毒理学相结合，用于评估化学物质和药物暴露引起的分子反应。多组学数据的数量和复杂性不断增加，需要能够提取有意义且具预测性见解的先进计算方法。在此背景下，人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）技术——包括支持向量机、随机森林和深度学习架构——越来越多地用于早期毒性预测和风险评估，据报道其预测准确性和敏感性相较传统毒理学方法有所提高。本文探讨了 AI 驱动的毒理基因组学在增强环境与药物安全性预测中的作用。文章重点介绍了基于 ML 和数据驱动的模型在转录组、蛋白质组和代谢组数据集整合分析中的应用，以识别与毒性相关的生物标志物、阐明作用机制，并在临床表现出现之前预测药物及环境的不良效应。值得注意的是，与传统毒理学方法相比，AI 驱动的模型在预测准确性、敏感性和可扩展性方面表现出显著改进，减少了对动物试验的依赖，并加快了决策过程。此外，本文讨论了基于 AI 的毒理基因组学在药物研发、环境污染物筛查和监管毒理学中的意义，同时探讨了数据异质性、模型可解释性和监管认可等关键挑战。计算机科学与毒理基因组学的融合为下一代预测毒理学提供了稳健的框架，有助于更安全的药物研发、更精确的环境风险评估，以及基于证据的公共卫生和监管决策。

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming public health surveillance by enabling the integration of epidemiological, clinical, environmental, mobility, genomic, and digital data to detect emerging threats and anticipate disease transmission. However, the expansion from detecting outbreaks to predicting individual or group-level behaviors raises important ethical concerns related to privacy, autonomy, discrimination, transparency, accountability, and public trust. This mini-review examines the ethical limits of AI-powered public health surveillance, with particular attention to the transition from population-level epidemic prediction toward individual-level inference and profiling. It highlights how extensive data integration, algorithmic bias, unequal predictive errors, opaque models, and mission creep can undermine both equity and the legitimacy of surveillance systems. The review argues that predictive capability alone cannot establish ethical legitimacy. Instead, AI surveillance should be governed by necessity, proportionality, purpose limitation, data minimization, equity, transparency, meaningful human oversight, and mechanisms for accountability and redress. A lifecycle governance approach is further required to ensure continuous assessment of data quality, subgroup performance, model drift, unintended harms, and changing public-health needs. Ultimately, the ethical boundary of AI surveillance should be defined not by what can technically be predicted, but by what can be predicted and acted upon without compromising fundamental rights, equity, and public trust.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 人工智能（AI）通过整合流行病学、临床、环境、人群流动、基因组和数字数据，以检测新发威胁并预测疾病传播，正在改变公共卫生监测。然而，从发现疫情扩展到预测个体或群体层面的行为，引发了涉及隐私、自主性、歧视、透明度、问责制和公众信任的重要伦理问题。这篇迷你综述探讨了 AI 驱动的公共卫生监测的伦理界限，特别关注从人群水平的疫情预测向个体水平的推断和画像的转变。文章强调，广泛的数据整合、算法偏倚、不均衡的预测误差、不透明的模型以及使命蔓延（mission creep）会如何损害公平性和监测系统的正当性。综述认为，仅凭预测能力不能确立伦理正当性。相反，AI 监测应受必要性、相称性、目的限制、数据最小化、公平、透明、有意义的人工监督以及问责与救济机制的约束。此外还需要生命周期治理方法，以确保持续评估数据质量、亚组表现、模型漂移、意外危害以及不断变化的公共卫生需求。归根结底，AI 监测的伦理边界不应由技术上能预测什么来界定，而应由在不损害基本权利、公平和公众信任的前提下能够预测并据以采取行动的内容来界定。

abstract: [Frontiers in physiology] Coronary artery disease, driven by the progressive accumulation of atherosclerotic plaque within the epicardial coronary arteries, remains a leading cause of myocardial ischemia and global morbidity. A fundamental challenge in the clinical management of the disease has been the reliance on anatomic stenosis severity alone, a metric that frequently dissociates from the hemodynamic significance of a lesion and thus offers limited guidance for optimal revascularization. The advent of invasive measurements marked a transformative paradigm shift, enabling the development of a diverse functional indices for the evaluation of coronary physiology. Recently, the development of computational science and artificial intelligence has accelerated the translation of these physiological assessments into the non-invasive domain, primarily through high-fidelity numerical simulations and efficient machine learning algorithms. This review systematically examines the evolution of coronary functional assessment across several pivotal frontiers. It begins by contextualizing the diagnostic landscape prior to the widespread adoption of functional indices, where clinical decisions were predominantly informed by imaging-derived anatomical parameters. Subsequently, it traces the historical evolution of invasive coronary functional indices, critically evaluating the comparative effectiveness of pressure-derived metrics against flow-derived metrics in the detection of hemodynamically significant ischemia. Furthermore, a critical evaluation of emerging artificial intelligence methodologies for the non-invasive evaluation of functional significance were employed. By synthesizing these technological methodologies, this review aims to elucidate the appropriate clinical application of each functional index, thereby providing a road-map for clinicians to achieve precise, individualized ischemia evaluation and guide therapeutic decision-making in the contemporary era of precision cardiovascular medicine.

abstract: [Medical review (2021)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming medical imaging, reshaping the field as it does everyday life. As imaging data grow in complexity and clinical workloads continue to rise, AI has become increasingly essential for improving diagnostic efficiency and precision. However, despite these technical advances, the clinical adoption of AI in medical imaging remains fragmented, with limited generalizability, insufficient interpretability, and unclear clinical responsibility. In this review, we critically examine the evolution of AI in medical imaging, with a particular focus on its functional roles across the imaging workflow and its actual contributions to contemporary clinical needs. We systematically analyze current application paradigms, identify methodological and translational bottlenecks, and discuss emerging strategies to improve model robustness, interpretability, and clinical integration. In addition, we identify key barriers to the practical implementation of AI in medical imaging, including challenges related to cross-domain generalizability, data privacy issues and regulatory compliance. By examining these opportunities and challenges, this review aims to guide future research directions and foster deeper interdisciplinary collaboration among AI, clinical medicine, and biomedical engineering.
zh_abstract: [医学综述（2021）] 人工智能（AI）正在迅速改变医学影像，正如它改变日常生活一样。随着影像数据的复杂性增加和临床工作量持续上升，AI 对于提高诊断效率和精确性变得愈发重要。然而，尽管技术不断进步，AI 在医学影像中的临床应用仍然碎片化，存在泛化能力有限、可解释性不足以及临床责任不明确等问题。在本综述中，我们批判性地审视了医学影像中 AI 的演进，特别关注其在影像工作流程中的功能作用及其对当代临床需求的实际贡献。我们系统分析了当前的应用范式，指出了方法学和转化方面的瓶颈，并讨论了提升模型稳健性、可解释性和临床整合的新兴策略。此外，我们还指出了 AI 在医学影像中实际应用的主要障碍，包括跨领域泛化、数据隐私问题和法规合规方面的挑战。通过审视这些机遇与挑战，本综述旨在指导未来的研究方向，并促进 AI、临床医学和生物医学工程之间更深入的跨学科合作。

abstract: Antioxidant peptides (AOPs) offer significant therapeutic potential in counteracting oxidative damage associated with chronic diseases. As AOPs gain market traction in cosmeceuticals, functional foods, and clinical trials for disease intervention, efficient computational methods are essential to accelerate their discovery. In this study, a systematic attempt has been made to develop a highly accurate and reliable method for predicting AOPs from their primary sequences. The dataset comprises 1,511 experimentally validated AOPs and 1,511 randomly generated non-AOPs, partitioned into 2,417 sequences for training and 606 for testing. First, we developed machine learning-based models using one-hot encoded (OHE) representations, sequence-derived compositional features, protein language model (PLM) embeddings, and feature fusion. Our CatBoost model, developed using selected fused features, achieved the best performance, with an AUC of 0.945 and an MCC of 0.788 on the independent testing dataset. An ensemble model combining CatBoost with BLAST achieved a peak AUC of 0.956 on the same testing dataset. Furthermore, our method outperformed existing state-of-the-art predictors when benchmarked on two external validation datasets comprising 150 peptides (75 AOPs and 75 non-AOPs) and 248 peptides (124 AOPs and 124 non-AOPs). AntiOxiPred (https://webs.iiitd.edu.in/raghava/antioxipred/) is freely available as an interactive web server, a standalone package, and a pip-installable tool to support the scientific community.
zh_abstract: 抗氧化肽（AOPs）在对抗与慢性疾病相关的氧化损伤方面具有显著的治疗潜力。随着 AOPs 在药妆品、功能性食品及疾病干预临床试验中的市场关注度不断上升，亟需高效的计算方法来加速其发现。本研究系统地尝试开发一种可根据一级序列高度准确且可靠地预测 AOPs 的方法。数据集包含1,511条经实验验证的 AOPs 和1,511条随机生成的非 AOPs，被划分为2,417条序列用于训练和606条用于测试。首先，我们使用独热编码（OHE）表示、源自序列的组成特征、蛋白质语言模型（PLM）嵌入以及特征融合，构建了基于机器学习的模型。我们使用筛选后的融合特征开发的 CatBoost 模型表现最佳，在独立测试数据集上的 AUC 为0.945，MCC 为0.788。将 CatBoost 与 BLAST 结合的集成模型在同一测试数据集上的 AUC 峰值达到0.956。此外，在包含150条肽（75条 AOPs 和75条非 AOPs）和248条肽（124条 AOPs 和124条非 AOPs）的两个外部验证数据集上进行基准测试时，我们的方法优于现有的最先进预测工具。AntiOxiPred（https://webs.iiitd.edu.in/raghava/antioxipred/）以交互式网络服务器、独立软件包和可通过 pip 安装的工具形式免费提供，以支持科学界使用。

abstract: Accurate prediction of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) is fundamental for elucidating cellular mechanisms and accelerating drug discovery. Although experimental techniques provide extensive interaction maps, their high cost and time requirements necessitate robust computational alternatives. In this study, we present an interpretable machine-learning framework that integrates sequence-derived descriptors, specifically 120 Auto-Covariance (AC) features, 686 Conjoint Triad (CT) features, and 1,820 Local Descriptors (LD) features, with classical classification algorithms, including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forests (RF), and XGBoost (XGB). Evaluated on a gold-standard sequence-based PPI benchmark dataset using stratified five-fold cross-validation, the models achieved robust classification accuracies: 86.92% (SVM), 97.75% (RF), and a peak cross-validation accuracy of 97.97% with XGBoost (Rec: 98.09%, Pr: 98.10%, F1: 98.09%). Furthermore, rigorous evaluation on an independent unseen (Human-PPI) test set demonstrated exceptional generalization capabilities. The Random Forest model emerged as the top-performing architecture, yielding an outstanding accuracy of 99.51%, a precision of 99.72%, a recall of 99.29%, an F1-score of 99.50%, an Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.9990, and an Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC) of 0.9989 (closely followed by XGBoost with 98.54% accuracy, AUROC 0.9979, and AUPRC 0.9974). Feature-importance analysis revealed that short-range physicochemical correlations (such as polarity and hydrophobicity lags in Protein 2), regional amino-acid compositions, and specific triad patterns (e.g., A/G/V-M/S/T/YM/S/T/Y) drive accurate PPI discrimination. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of domain-informed, handcrafted sequence features combined with machine-learning classifiers for PPI prediction, providing biologically interpretable insights with minimal computational overhead and enabling efficient, scalable interactome screening.
zh_abstract: 准确预测蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）对于阐明细胞机制和加速药物发现至关重要。尽管实验技术可提供广泛的相互作用图谱，但其成本高、耗时长，因此需要可靠的计算替代方法。在本研究中，我们提出了一种可解释的机器学习框架，将序列衍生的描述符——具体为 120 个自协方差（Auto-Covariance，AC）特征、686 个联合三联体（Conjoint Triad，CT）特征和 1,820 个局部描述符（Local Descriptors，LD）特征——与经典分类算法相结合，这些算法包括支持向量机（SVM）、随机森林（RF）和 XGBoost（XGB）。在一个金标准的基于序列的 PPI 基准数据集上，采用分层五折交叉验证进行评估，模型取得了稳健的分类准确率：SVM 为 86.92%，RF 为 97.75%，XGBoost 的交叉验证准确率最高，为 97.97%（召回率：98.09%，精确率：98.10%，F1：98.09%）。此外，在独立的未见（Human-PPI）测试集上的严格评估显示出卓越的泛化能力。随机森林模型表现最佳，准确率为 99.51%，精确率为 99.72%，召回率为 99.29%，F1 分数为 99.50%，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为 0.9990，精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）为 0.9989（XGBoost 紧随其后，准确率 98.54%，AUROC 0.9979，AUPRC 0.9974）。特征重要性分析表明，短程理化相关性（如蛋白质 2 中的极性和疏水性滞后）、区域氨基酸组成以及特定的三联体模式（如 A/G/V-M/S/T/YM/S/T/Y）推动了对 PPI 的准确区分。这些发现证明了结合领域知识的手工序列特征与机器学习分类器用于 PPI 预测的有效性，能够以极小的计算开销提供具有生物学可解释性的见解，并实现高效、可扩展的相互作用组筛选。
